plugins.description: DSH Web 右下角悬浮聊天按钮：独立聊天面板、多话题并行，不打断当前工作会话
plugins.zh: DSH Web 右下角悬浮聊天按钮：独立聊天面板、多话题并行，不打断当前工作会话

plugins.name: dsh-compat-gate
plugins.description: Check whether your installed dsh plugins still work before you install a dsh update.
plugins.zh: 在安装 dsh 更新前，检查已安装的 dsh 插件是否仍然可用。

plugins.name: dsh-dev-workflow
plugins.description: /dev-pre-check 、 /dev-feat 、 /dev-fix 、 /dev-refactor 、 /dev-test 与 dev_ask 结构化提问工具。
plugins.zh: /dev-pre-check 、 /dev-feat 、 /dev-fix 、 /dev-refactor 、 /dev-test 与 dev_ask 结构化提问工具。

plugins.name: dsh-notifier
plugins.description: 用于在dsh需要用户回应时及时通知
plugins.zh: 用于在dsh需要用户回应时及时通知

plugins.name: dsh-clinepass
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for ClinePass: models, API key, and usage limits.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 插件：提供模型、API 密钥及用量限制支持。

plugins.name: dsh-edit-question
plugins.description: Edit a sent question and resend it in DeepSeek Harness: images are re-attached (paste more too), the conversation restarts from that turn, and the original session can be kept or archived.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中编辑已发送的问题并重新发送：图片会重新附加（也可粘贴更多），对话从该回合重新开始，原始会话可选择保留或归档。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-search
plugins.description: Search DSH plugins on the npm registry by a name fragment and install them from the Plugins page.
plugins.zh: 根据名称片段在 npm 注册表中搜索 DSH 插件，并从插件页面安装。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent
plugins.description: Use Qoder/QoderCN subscription CLIs as DeepSeek Harness subagents
plugins.zh: 将 Qoder/QoderCN 订阅 CLI 用作 DeepSeek Harness 子代理

plugins.name: dsh-oneclick-desktop
plugins.description: Windows: turns DSH into a desktop app. A one-click launcher and tray controller, plus a sidebar button that splits DSH and chat.deepseek.com side by side with its own taskbar button.
plugins.zh: Windows 端：将 DSH 转变为桌面应用。提供一键启动器和托盘控制器，以及一个侧边栏按钮，可将 DSH 与 chat.deepseek.com 并排显示并拥有独立的任务栏按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-writing
plugins.description: 老人与大肥鱼：Deepseek Harness超级写作增强插件，具备四种风格和五种写作严谨度的自动切换功能，并且具备任务级本地记忆和去ai味后处理、。
plugins.zh: 老人与大肥鱼：Deepseek Harness超级写作增强插件，具备四种风格和五种写作严谨度的自动切换功能，并且具备任务级本地记忆和去ai味后处理、。

plugins.name: dsh-terminal
plugins.description: Claude Code-style terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 风格的 Claude Code 终端 UI 插件

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot-native
plugins.description: WeChat-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness (Windows): freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (Windows) 类微信截图插件：冻结桌面，框选区域或点击窗口，裁切图直接进入 Composer。

plugins.name: dsh-newbe-plugins
plugins.description: 个人使用 DSH 的增强插件，包括收藏功能、输入锁和会话工具收纳等功能
plugins.zh: 个人使用 DSH 的增强插件，包括收藏功能、输入锁和会话工具收纳等功能

plugins.name: dsh-image-relay
plugins.description: Generate images from a text prompt through any OpenAI-compatible relay and attach them to the DeepSeek Harness conversation.
plugins.zh: 通过任意 OpenAI 兼容中继根据文本提示生成图像，并将其附加到 DeepSeek Harness 对话中。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-control
plugins.description: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control for DeepSeek Harness: writes the user-level .env so the launcher and the first requests are proxied, then keeps it in sync from a Plugins-page switch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 预启动与运行时 HTTP 代理控制：写入用户级 .env 文件，使启动器和初始请求均通过代理，并通过插件页面开关保持同步。

plugins.name: dsh-proteus-bridge
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 Agent 控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真并保存工程（COM / UI 双传输）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 Agent 控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真并保存工程（COM / UI 双传输）

plugins.name: dsh-recent-sessions
plugins.description: DSH sidebar plugin: a floating recent-sessions sheet that blends into the sidebar
plugins.zh: DSH侧边栏插件：一个融入侧边栏的浮动近期会话面板

plugins.name: dsh-cool-git
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 插件——在会话选项卡栏中添加 Git 管理功能，覆盖基础操作：commit | pull | push | branch | diff。

plugins.name: dsh-git
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness的GIT操作面板插件
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的GIT操作面板插件

plugins.name: DSH-Window-Title
plugins.description: 修改DSH前端的网页标题，用于在多机远程开发环境下通过窗体标题快速区分设备。
plugins.zh: 修改DSH前端的网页标题，用于在多机远程开发环境下通过窗体标题快速区分设备。

plugins.name: dsh-peak-valley
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷状态显示器：输入卡上方一条峰/谷状态带，带剩余进度；六套马卡龙主题 + 自定义 CSS。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷状态显示器：输入卡上方一条峰/谷状态带，带剩余进度；六套马卡龙主题 + 自定义 CSS。

plugins.name: dsh-fudan-status-wallpaper
plugins.description: 复旦 · 状态栏 & 壁纸 — DeepSeek Harness quota, weather status bar and campus wallpaper plugin
plugins.zh: 复旦 · 状态栏 & 壁纸 — DeepSeek Harness quota, weather status bar and campus wallpaper plugin

plugins.name: dsh-wallpaper-skin
plugins.description: DSH 动态壁纸皮肤插件（大肥鱼版）：mp4/webm 视频或 jpg/png/gif 图片作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景，设置页集成、原生文件选择、遮罩/亮度/底调调节、热切换不重启。（旧仓库，请使用 dsh-wallpaper-fish）
plugins.zh: DSH 动态壁纸皮肤插件（大肥鱼版）：mp4/webm 视频或 jpg/png/gif 图片作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景，设置页集成、原生文件选择、遮罩/亮度/底调调节、热切换不重启。（旧仓库，请使用 dsh-wallpaper-fish）

plugins.name: dsh-recued
plugins.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to your own Recued server over MCP.
plugins.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到您自己的 Recued 服务器。

plugins.name: dsh-w8-sandbox
plugins.description: W8 sandbox plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness W8 沙盒插件

plugins.name: dsh-snapshot
plugins.description: Backup / restore / rotate snapshots of ~/.dsh for DeepSeek Harness — sha256-verified archives with path-traversal protection (own-built, replacing third-party backup plugins).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ~/.dsh 快照备份/恢复/轮换——sha256 验证的归档文件，含路径遍历防护（自研，用于替换第三方备份插件）。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-pack
plugins.description: Curated engineering skills for DeepSeek Harness: handoff, grilling, teach, spec/ticket workflows, writing skills, and the DESIGN.md format. Cross-platform (pure SKILL.md text, no platform code).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 精选工程技能：交接、深度拷问、教学、规格/工单工作流、写作技能以及 DESIGN.md 格式。跨平台（纯 SKILL.md 文本，无平台相关代码）。

plugins.name: dsh-session-repair
plugins.description: Scans and repairs DSH session logs: re-encodes single-frame corrupt zstd files back to the multi-frame layout and marks unknown event types (e.g. llm/failover) as ignorable so older harnesses can load newer logs.
plugins.zh: 扫描并修复 DSH 会话日志：将损坏的单帧 zstd 文件重新编码回多帧布局，并将未知事件类型（如 llm/failover）标记为可忽略，以便旧版 harness 能加载新日志。

plugins.name: dsh-search
plugins.description: Universal search toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: unified web search provider (Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily with fallback chain + cache), page fetch, GitHub search, vector corpus, deep-web probe + local codebase semantic search (search_code).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用搜索工具箱：统一网络搜索提供商（Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily，含回退链+缓存）、页面抓取、GitHub 搜索、向量语料库、深层网络探测及本地代码库语义搜索（search_code）。

plugins.name: dsh-research-lab
plugins.description: Research lab toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: AutoSci wiki, ASI-Bench eval ledger, self-building FTS5 retrieval, arXiv digest/review, writing rewrite
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 研究实验室工具包：AutoSci 维基、ASI-Bench 评估账本、自构建 FTS5 检索、arXiv 摘要/评阅、写作改写

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-guide
plugins.description: DSH plugin: boot conformance scanner (guide_scan: plugin + profile modes) + official capability map (guide_learn)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：启动合规扫描器（guide_scan：插件与配置文件模式）+ 官方能力图谱（guide_learn）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Static pre-install vetting for DSH plugins: scans a directory or installed package for exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence and lifecycle-script red flags (own-built, replacing third-party vetting plugins).
plugins.zh: DSH 插件静态预安装审查：扫描目录或已安装包，检测数据外泄、凭据访问、混淆、持久化和生命周期脚本等危险信号（自研，替代第三方审查插件）。

plugins.name: dsh-notemap
plugins.description: Shared knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness: notes with quantified relations (weights/confidence), graph algorithms (BFS/Dijkstra/centrality/common-neighbors/PageRank), DuckLake-inspired snapshots, and a cross-session/cross-agent fusion index. Headless: agents query the graph, no canvas UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 共享知识图谱：具有量化关系（权重/置信度）的笔记、图算法（BFS/Dijkstra/中心性/共同邻居/PageRank）、DuckLake 启发的快照以及跨会话/跨智能体融合索引。无头模式：智能体查询图谱，无需画布 UI。

plugins.name: dsh-lib-analyzer
plugins.description: Library absorption analysis for DeepSeek Harness: scan reference corpora, drive absorption-report batches (tasks.jsonl to out/*.md), validate report discipline (file:line evidence, comparison markers), and keep a searchable per-library knowledge base driven by auditable reports instead of conversation recall.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 库吸收分析：扫描参考语料库，驱动吸收报告批处理（tasks.jsonl 至 out/*.md），验证报告规范（file:line 证据、对比标记），并通过可审计报告而非对话记忆维护可搜索的逐库知识库。

plugins.name: dsh-gitkit
plugins.description: Structured Git tools for DeepSeek Harness: status / diff / log / commit / branch with path validation and shell-free exec (own-built, replacing third-party git plugins).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 结构化 Git 工具：支持带路径验证的状态/差异/日志/提交/分支操作，以及免 shell 执行（自研，替代第三方 git 插件）。

plugins.name: dsh-eigenflux
plugins.description: Drive the EigenFlux agent-broadcast network from DSH tools: status, surface introspection, read-only feed, and two-step confirmed publishing. No timers, no background cadence — the human decides when the network is consulted.
plugins.zh: 从 DSH 工具驱动 EigenFlux 代理广播网络：查看状态、表面结构、只读 feed，以及两步确认发布。无定时器，无后台节奏——由人类决定何时调用网络。

plugins.name: dsh-busyloop
plugins.description: DSH agent-loop engine: host-LLM adapter + loop skeleton over host ctx (busyloop: capability, not codex style)
plugins.zh: DSH 代理循环引擎：主机 LLM 适配器 + 基于主机上下文的循环骨架（busyloop 为能力而非 codex 风格）

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description: Browser interaction for DeepSeek Harness: drive local Chrome/Edge via playwright-core (CDP). Open, snapshot, click, type, scroll, evaluate, screenshot. Real browser, local-only.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器交互：通过 playwright-core（CDP）驱动本地 Chrome/Edge。支持打开、快照、点击、输入、滚动、评估、截图。真实的本地浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-acp-memory
plugins.description: Unified local memory for DeepSeek Harness, backed by ACP graph: seven-layer memory (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules), capture→recall→inject, module-separated core (server-ready) + thin DSH adapter.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一本地记忆，基于 ACP 图谱构建：七层记忆（灵魂/用户/项目/事实/经验/主题/规则），支持捕获→召回→注入，核心模块分离（服务端就绪）+ 轻量 DSH 适配器。

plugins.name: dsh-suite
plugins.description: DSH 插件合集（聚合包）：一次安装把多个独立维护的 DSH 插件装配成一组，单个插件故障不影响其余功能。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件合集（聚合包）：一次安装把多个独立维护的 DSH 插件装配成一组，单个插件故障不影响其余功能。

plugins.name: DSH-WebSocket2HTTP
plugins.description: 魔改DSH链路传输协议层从Websocket到HTTP，解决部分网络环境无法使用Websocket的问题。
plugins.zh: 魔改DSH链路传输协议层从Websocket到HTTP，解决部分网络环境无法使用Websocket的问题。

plugins.name: dsh-closet
plugins.description: DSH 插件 · 收纳间：按工作区统一管理临时脚本与日志（登记 · 扫描 · 执行 · 清运 · 回收站 · 面板）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件 · 收纳间：按工作区统一管理临时脚本与日志（登记 · 扫描 · 执行 · 清运 · 回收站 · 面板）

plugins.name: dsh-space-background
plugins.description: 深空背景 — DeepSeek Harness 主题与外观插件：设置「通用」分区提供深空背景开关，银河/星座/行星/流星在窗口底层流动，界面经官方主题令牌半透明化
plugins.zh: 深空背景 — DeepSeek Harness 主题与外观插件：设置「通用」分区提供深空背景开关，银河/星座/行星/流星在窗口底层流动，界面经官方主题令牌半透明化

plugins.name: dsh-roboto-mono
plugins.description: DSH 字体插件：为代码块与 SSH 终端装 Roboto Mono，并用 DejaVu + Nerd Font 子集补齐框线符号与 Oh My Posh 图标。
plugins.zh: DSH 字体插件：为代码块与 SSH 终端装 Roboto Mono，并用 DejaVu + Nerd Font 子集补齐框线符号与 Oh My Posh 图标。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-theme
plugins.description: DSH 自定义主题：多套主题、配色、壁纸、背景音乐、首屏立绘与多条文案。 · Custom theme studio for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DSH 自定义主题：多套主题、配色、壁纸、背景音乐、首屏立绘与多条文案。 · Custom theme studio for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-channel-core
plugins.description: Discord and Feishu/Lark channels for DeepSeek Harness: verified identities, shared sessions, native Ask User and progress delivery.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的Discord和飞书/Lark频道：验证身份、共享会话、原生Ask User及进度推送。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-watchdog
plugins.description: Windows commit-memory watchdog for DSH Desktop: commit attribution, configurable thresholds, a fail-closed restart gate, read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline, and opt-in automatic restart / crash-resume.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 内存提交监控：内存归属分析、可配置阈值、故障关闭重启门控、只读页面文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线，以及可选自动重启/崩溃恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-wps365-plugin
plugins.description: 配合官方wps365-cli的dsh插件
plugins.zh: 配合官方wps365-cli的dsh插件

plugins.description: Deep-sea whale-girl theme for the DeepSeek Harness desktop client: deep-blue palette (light/dark) plus two corner illustrations.

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-bridge

plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话能力变成 MCP Server：Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 Agent 可创建会话、发送消息、长轮询回合、回答提问，复用 DSH 的模型、工具与工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-skillx-workflow
plugins.description: DSH 原生 SkillX 插件：从会话提取可复用能力，支持契约化调用、版本管理与自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-learning-workbench

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 学习工作台插件：讨论学习战略、查看决策依赖、验证真实反馈

plugins.zh: DSH Web 浏览器会话 Cookie 的滑动续期——一款 DSH 主机插件包。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-feishu
plugins.description: Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: CardKit 2.0 streaming cards, thinking folds, tool-call tracking, waterfall approvals and multimodal I/O over an outbound WebSocket — no public endpoint required.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 通道：支持 CardKit 2.0 流式卡片、思维折叠、工具调用追踪、瀑布流审批及多模态输入输出，通过出站 WebSocket 实现，无需公开端点。

plugins.name: @moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart
plugins.description: Sidebar-foot Reload UI and Restart App buttons: reload refreshes the interface and client plugins only, restart relaunches the DeepSeek Harness desktop app together with its Host.
plugins.zh: 侧边栏底部重新加载 UI 和重启应用按钮：重新加载仅刷新界面和客户端插件，重启则连同 Host 一起重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-manager
plugins.description: DSH 工作区管理：会话树、多源文件夹、批量归档与系统目录打开
plugins.zh: DSH 工作区管理：会话树、多源文件夹、批量归档与系统目录打开

plugins.name: dsh-time-introspect
plugins.description: A dsh plugin: after a timeout, the time distribution from the previous iteration is fed to the model, enabling the model to autonomously identify and adjust its behavior; if the introspection cost becomes too high, the plugin enters a dormant state, allowing the model to be restarted at any time.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：超时后将上一轮的时间分布反馈给模型，使模型能自主识别并调整行为；若内省开销过高则进入休眠状态，模型可随时重启

plugins.name: dsh-feishu

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-vault
plugins.description: SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent SSH 支持：主机地址、端口、账户、密码和私钥存储在加密保险箱中，对话仅使用别名。模型永远不会看到密码，密码也不会出现在命令行或远程进程列表中

plugins.name: dsh-ask-autopilot
plugins.description: DSH plugin: answers an unanswered ask_user_question after a configurable deadline (recommended option first) and plays a notification sound when a question appears.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在可配置截止期限后自动回答未处理的 ask_user_question（推荐选项优先），并在出现提问时播放通知音。

plugins.name: dsh-wo-github

plugins.zh: Workspace Overview GitHub 选项卡：简介卡片、以 Markdown 渲染的 README 以及默认分支的提交历史（含按文件补丁）。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-diff

plugins.name: @wjj-8283/dsh-temp-workspace
plugins.description: DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Adds a small icon beside the sidebar's "Add workspace" button
plugins.zh: DSH web client plugin: a temporary workspace (临时工作区) — every conversation it contains is deleted at the next Harness restart (immediately or after a delay), optionally behind a confirm dialog. Adds a small icon beside the sidebar's "Add workspace" button

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-browser-use

plugins.zh: 一个DeepSeek Harness插件，将内置的右侧栏浏览器暴露为DSH代理的stdio MCP服务器。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web-dock

plugins.name: dsh-lan-chat
plugins.description: 局域网聊天助手 — DSH 插件，隔离内网的即时通讯：单聊 / 群聊 / 文件传输 / 网段扫描加好友（零运行时依赖）
plugins.zh: 局域网聊天助手 — DSH 插件，隔离内网的即时通讯：单聊 / 群聊 / 文件传输 / 网段扫描加好友（零运行时依赖）

plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 划词翻译插件：选中英文即在浮层卡片显示中文译文，免费 Bing/MyMemory 引擎，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-web-fetch-lan
plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 在 Clash/mihomo 的 fake-ip（TUN）下可用：放行 fake-ip 段，仍拒绝回环/内网/云元数据等地址。零依赖 DSH 插件。
plugins.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 在 Clash/mihomo 的 fake-ip（TUN）下可用：放行 fake-ip 段，仍拒绝回环/内网/云元数据等地址。零依赖 DSH 插件。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-codebase-memory
plugins.description: 14 model-facing codebase-memory tools — search_graph, query_graph, trace_path, snippets, architecture, search_code, detect_changes, ADRs, and more — one-shot queries against the codebase-memory daemon; the local alternative to a stdio MCP client row.
plugins.zh: 14 个面向模型的代码库内存工具——search_graph、query_graph、trace_path、snippets、architecture、search_code、detect_changes、ADRs 等——对代码库内存守护进程进行一次性查询；作为本地替代方案，取代 stdio MCP 客户端行。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-code-runtime-kernels
plugins.description: The run_kernel_code tool for DeepSeek Harness: persistent Python and JavaScript kernels (a long-lived python3/node subprocess per session, sharing a core host driver) — a standalone plugin with no upstream harness changes required.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 run_kernel_code 工具：持久化 Python 和 JavaScript 内核（每个会话一个长生命周期的 python3/node 子进程，共享核心主机驱动）——独立插件，无需上游 Harness 改动

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-browser
plugins.description: Agentic browser plumbing for DeepSeek Harness: the host ctx.browser service (stealth launch, CDP-attach, and a relay + companion Chrome extension driving the user's own tabs) backing the browser tool in @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-browser — no harness changes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能体浏览器底层支持：宿主 ctx.browser 服务（隐身启动、CDP 附加，以及通过中继器和 Companion Chrome 扩展驱动用户自己的标签页），为 @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-browser 中的浏览器工具提供支持，无需修改 Harness。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-session-url
plugins.description: session:// internal-URL scheme handler: read a session transcript, read one event as JSON, list sessions, and search past history through internal-URL-aware read/grep tools — standalone for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: session:// 内部 URL 方案处理器：读取会话记录、以 JSON 格式读取单个事件、列出会话，并通过支持内部 URL 的 read/grep 工具搜索历史——DeepSeek Harness 独立运行。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-git
plugins.description: Agentic git plumbing for DeepSeek Harness: the host ctx.git service (diff parsing, hunk staging, commit/push/log over the subprocess seam) plus the vcs/repo-lock/worktree layers behind the commit/review/worktree tools in @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-git.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能体 Git 底层支持：宿主 ctx.git 服务（差异解析、块暂存、通过子进程接口提交/推送/日志）及 vcs/repo-lock/worktree 层，为 @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-git 中的 commit/review/worktree 工具提供支持。

plugins.name: @hy-sde-org/dsh-av
plugins.description: Read-only Automic Vault plumbing for DeepSeek Harness: the host ctx.av service (CLI resolution + probe, scan/doctor/detectors/hardeners/list over the subprocess seam) backing the vault tools in @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-av — no harness changes required.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Automic Vault 支持：host ctx.av 服务（CLI 解析与探测、通过子进程接口进行扫描/诊断/检测器/加固器/列表操作），为 @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-av 中的 vault 工具提供支持，无需修改 Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-worklog
plugins.description: DSH plugin: give the agent a cross-session development worklog (worklog_add / worklog_list). Cordis service + agent tools + bundle patch.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：为智能体提供跨会话的开发工作日志 (worklog_add / worklog_list)。Cordis 服务 + 智能体工具 + Bundle 补丁。

plugins.name: dsh_debug_web
plugins.description: 让 DSH 的 agent 在页面里执行 JS、读控制台 —— 一个模型工具 dsh_debug_web，走既有 Cordis Host→Client Inspect 通道 | Let the agent run JS inside the live DSH web page and read its console, over the existing inspect channel
plugins.zh: 让 DSH 的 agent 在页面里执行 JS、读控制台 —— 一个模型工具 dsh_debug_web，走既有 Cordis Host→Client Inspect 通道 | Let the agent run JS inside the live DSH web page and read its console, over the existing inspect channel

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-pet
plugins.description: A tiny desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — it idles, bounces while the agent works, and calls out when a task finishes. 桌宠
plugins.zh: A tiny desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — it idles, bounces while the agent works, and calls out when a task finishes. 桌宠

plugins.name: dsh-memory-shield
plugins.description: DSH preset 记忆遮蔽插件：在指定 preset 内挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，给会话一个干净上下文。默认关闭，需在目标 preset 里挂载并启用；不存记忆、只做遮蔽。
plugins.zh: DSH preset 记忆遮蔽插件：在指定 preset 内挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，给会话一个干净上下文。默认关闭，需在目标 preset 里挂载并启用；不存记忆、只做遮蔽。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin
plugins.description: Douyin toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: hot list, search, video reading with native vision frames, guarded Playwright DM/group driver, and a local HTTP API. Linux adapter included.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 抖音工具包：提供热门榜单、搜索、带原生视觉帧的视频阅读、受控的 Playwright DM/群组驱动及本地 HTTP API，含 Linux 适配。

plugins.name: dsh-superpowers
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: obra/superpowers skill library adapted to dsh tooling, plus a session-start bootstrap — brainstorming, systematic debugging, TDD, planning and more.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将 obra/superpowers 技能库适配到 dsh 工具，并添加会话启动引导——头脑风暴、系统调试、TDD、规划等。

plugins.name: dsh-always-apply
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: injects alwaysApply-marked skill bodies into sessions before the first model request — no skill tool load needed.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在首次模型请求前注入标记为 alwaysApply 的技能内容——无需加载技能工具。

plugins.name: dsh-sts2-agent
plugins.description: Let an AI play Slay the Spire 2 inside DSH: screenshot + mouse/keyboard tools, a local card database, and a readable play log. No mods, no memory reading.
plugins.zh: 让 AI 在 DSH 中游玩 Slay the Spire 2：通过截图及鼠标/键盘工具操作，结合本地卡牌数据库和可读的游戏日志。无需修改游戏，不读取内存。

plugins.name: dsh-ctx-meter
plugins.description: DSH plugin: a /ctx slash command that prints session context occupancy for zero model tokens, plus one collapsed notice each time occupancy crosses 25% / 50% / 75%. Host-only, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：一个 /ctx 斜杠命令，显示零模型令牌时的会话上下文占用量，并在占用量跨越 25% / 50% / 75% 时各显示一条折叠通知。仅主机可用，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-connect-tabbit
plugins.description: DSH 第三方 Tabbit 插件：内置网关接入 Tabbit 国内版/国际版账号池、周期额度、模型用量倍率、每日签到与工具调用
plugins.zh: DSH 第三方 Tabbit 插件：内置网关接入 Tabbit 国内版/国际版账号池、周期额度、模型用量倍率、每日签到与工具调用

plugins.name: dsh-baseline
plugins.description: A fail-closed security baseline plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): policy-gated network egress, a monotonic subagent permission ceiling, and one hash-chained audit log of every tool decision and result.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的安全基线插件：策略管控网络出站流量、单调递增的子代理权限上限，以及记录每项工具决策与结果的链式哈希审计日志。

plugins.name: @kinocode/dsh-mobile
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness host plugin for the DSH Mobile Android app: pair with a QR, use DSH on the phone through its own HTTPS gateway, answer approvals and questions from notifications, push turn completion.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 针对 DSH Mobile Android 应用的宿主插件：扫码配对，通过独立 HTTPS 网关在手机上使用 DSH，从通知中回复审批与问题，推送回合完成状态。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-failover
plugins.description: DSH plugin: a loopback failover relay becomes the process-wide proxy route, so web_fetch works under Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip and falls back to direct inside the same request when the local proxy stops. / DSH 插件：把容错 relay 装成进程级代理路由，修复 TUN fake-ip 下的 web_fetch；本地代理关闭时同一请求内改走直连。
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: a loopback failover relay becomes the process-wide proxy route, so web_fetch works under Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip and falls back to direct inside the same request when the local proxy stops. / DSH 插件：把容错 relay 装成进程级代理路由，修复 TUN fake-ip 下的 web_fetch；本地代理关闭时同一请求内改走直连。

plugins.name: dsh-agents-md-settings
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: a Settings row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in your system editor.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 套件：一个 Settings 行，用于在系统编辑器中打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-click
plugins.description: 让 Agent 用鼠标和键盘操作 Windows：Windows OCR 定位界面文字 → 真实点击/拖动/滚轮/键入 → 像素与文字双重复核。DSH 插件，无需视觉大模型，F6+F7 急停。
plugins.zh: 让 Agent 用鼠标和键盘操作 Windows：Windows OCR 定位界面文字 → 真实点击/拖动/滚轮/键入 → 像素与文字双重复核。DSH 插件，无需视觉大模型，F6+F7 急停。

plugins.name: dsh-cinematic-wallpaper
plugins.description: Cinematic intro and live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI: a character awakens on every page load, then stays behind the UI as an animated background with adaptive text colours.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 的电影片头与动态壁纸：每次页面加载都有角色苏醒，随后停留在 UI 后方作为动画背景，并随文本自适应颜色。

plugins.name: dsh-clipboard
plugins.description: 剪贴板快速引用：DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动记录系统剪贴板历史（仅本机），输入框旁一键引用，模型可用 MCP 工具读最近复制 / Clipboard quick-quote for DeepSeek Harness: local history + input widget + MCP tools
plugins.zh: 剪贴板快速引用：DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动记录系统剪贴板历史（仅本机），输入框旁一键引用，模型可用 MCP 工具读最近复制 / Clipboard quick-quote for DeepSeek Harness: local history + input widget + MCP tools

plugins.name: dshm-keep-screen-on
plugins.description: DSHM 屏幕常亮桥：有 agent / 后台任务在跑时，ArkWeb 页面持有 Screen Wake Lock，让 HarmonyOS 不自动熄屏。
plugins.zh: DSHM 屏幕常亮桥：有 agent / 后台任务在跑时，ArkWeb 页面持有 Screen Wake Lock，让 HarmonyOS 不自动熄屏。

plugins.name: dsh-draw-mode
plugins.description: Links a local ComfyUI server into DeepSeek Harness: five draw_* tools, a curated workflow library, per-model prompt dialects and a sidebar panel.
plugins.zh: 将本地 ComfyUI 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness：提供五个 draw_* 工具、精选工作流库、各模型的提示词方言以及侧边栏面板。

plugins.name: dsh-codeeek
plugins.description: 阅读代码 · DSH 独立插件：一个独立于普通工作区选择的代码阅读模式：先理解业务，再梳理调用链、精读实现，最后通过具体场景验证理解。
plugins.zh: 阅读代码 · DSH 独立插件：一个独立于普通工作区选择的代码阅读模式：先理解业务，再梳理调用链、精读实现，最后通过具体场景验证理解。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-toolbox
plugins.description: PDF 结构操作 DSH 插件：合并/拆分/压缩/加水印/提取-删除-旋转-插入页面/元数据/加密检测/文本提取（9 个工具 14 项操作，纯本地 pdf-lib + pdfjs-dist）
plugins.zh: PDF 结构操作 DSH 插件：合并/拆分/压缩/加水印/提取-删除-旋转-插入页面/元数据/加密检测/文本提取（9 个工具 14 项操作，纯本地 pdf-lib + pdfjs-dist）

plugins.name: dsh-harness-restart
plugins.description: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry plus an out-of-process helper that quits and relaunches the desktop app.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键重启：侧边栏入口配合独立进程辅助工具，用于退出并重新打开桌面应用。

plugins.name: oh-my-dsh
plugins.description: Seat-based multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness - a port of oh-my-opencode-slim (omo-slim) onto DSH native seams.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的座位式多代理编排——将 oh-my-opencode-slim (omo-slim) 移植到 DSH 原生接口。

plugins.name: dsh-account-glance
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI sidebar glance card: DeepSeek balance, peak / off-peak billing countdown (statutory holidays included), and today's spend / tokens / calls, right above the account row. Self-contained host half; @linxin666/dsh-usage optional.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 侧边栏概览卡片：显示 DeepSeek 余额、峰谷计费倒计时（含法定节假日）以及今日花费/Token/调用次数，位于账号行上方。自包含宿主页；@linxin666/dsh-usage 为可选组件。

plugins.name: dsh-trace-waterfall
plugins.description: A live, searchable trace waterfall for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时可搜索追踪瀑布图。

plugins.name: dsh-tg-bridge
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: every DSH session becomes a Telegram forum topic, mirrored both ways, with approvals, questions, commands, files and voice
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每个 DSH 会话变为 Telegram 论坛主题，双向镜像，支持审批、提问、命令、文件和语音

plugins.name: boom-art
plugins.description: Boom Art! - DSH 发送烟花插件：以输入框为爆心，向边界外径向绽放，带 LED 边框与六档强度。
plugins.zh: Boom Art! - DSH 发送烟花插件：以输入框为爆心，向边界外径向绽放，带 LED 边框与六档强度。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-terminal-upgrades
plugins.description: Terminal upgrades for DeepSeek Harness: option-click a link in the terminal to open it in your browser.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 终端增强：选项点击终端中的链接可在浏览器中打开。

plugins.name: dsh-ue-db
plugins.description: Offline Unreal Engine 5.8 database for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线版 Unreal Engine 5.8 数据库

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-slim
plugins.description: DSH plugin: shrink the tool-definition block sent on every request (~39% fewer tokens) without changing tool behaviour
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在不改变工具行为的前提下，缩减每次请求发送的工具定义块（减少约 39% 的 token）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-always-on-top
plugins.description: Pin the DeepSeek Harness desktop window above every other app from a button beside source control.
plugins.zh: 从源代码控制旁边的按钮将 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口置顶于其他应用之上。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-backlog-md
plugins.description: Native Backlog.md task management for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 Backlog.md 任务管理

plugins.name: dsh-model-caps
plugins.description: Model capability editor for DSH: fetch upstream /models, review and save context window, max output and image support
plugins.zh: DSH 模型能力编辑器：获取上游 /models、审查并保存上下文窗口、最大输出与图像支持

plugins.name: dsh-turn-continuation
plugins.description: Continue an unfinished interrupted DSH Web agent turn from its saved session context
plugins.zh: 从保存的会话上下文恢复未完成的中断 DSH Web Agent 回合

plugins.name: dsh-onchain-arbitrage-radar
plugins.description: Read-only on-chain arbitrage radar for DeepSeek Harness: cross-venue spreads, funding crowding, tokenized-stock clock, cost model and execution gate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读链上套利雷达：跨交易所价差、资金费率拥挤度、代币化股票时钟、成本模型及执行门禁。

plugins.name: dsh-copy-document
plugins.description: Adds a whole-document copy button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar editor header, right of Save
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏编辑器头部「保存」按钮右侧添加整文档复制按钮

plugins.name: dsh-mt-download
plugins.description: Multi-channel file downloader for DeepSeek Harness: 16-connection aria2c acceleration with automatic single-stream fallback.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道文件下载器：支持 16 连接 aria2c 加速，并自动降级为单流传输。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-locale-ru
plugins.description: Russian language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI (Русский язык для DeepSeek Harness)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 俄语语言包（Русский язык для DeepSeek Harness）

plugins.name: dsh-toggle-leftside
plugins.description: Deepseek Harness插件。让左侧折叠后支持悬浮、贴边预览。支持web和desktop。
plugins.zh: Deepseek Harness插件。让左侧折叠后支持悬浮、贴边预览。支持web和desktop。

plugins.name: @martindye/dsh-voice
plugins.description: Martin's self-contained two-way voice plugin for the DSH web app: unified voice composer in, per-message speaker buttons and auto-read out (own TTS server), plus the speech-to-text wiring. Forked from @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-voice-input 0.
plugins.zh: Martin 的面向 DSH Web 应用的独立双向语音插件：统一的语音编译器输入、每条消息的扬声器按钮和自动朗读（自有 TTS 服务器），以及语音转文本布线。源自 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-voice-input 0。

plugins.name: dsh_AsaAgent
plugins.description: Bridge Asa's self-learning research agent into DeepSeek Harness: mcp__asa__asa_research / asa_message / asa_status plus an asa_doctor diagnostic. Streamable-HTTP MCP bundle, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: 将 Asa 的自我学习研究代理接入 DeepSeek Harness：支持 mcp__asa__asa_research / asa_message / asa_status 及 asa_doctor 诊断。Streamable-HTTP MCP 包，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-flow-canvas
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可交互的分支流程图决策画布，支持多选、自定义输入与图片节点
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可交互的分支流程图决策画布，支持多选、自定义输入与图片节点

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-balance-indicator
plugins.description: Shows your remaining DeepSeek Platform balance in the DeepSeek Harness composer status row.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 作曲家状态栏中显示你的 DeepSeek Platform 剩余余额。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-relay
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）接到 QQ 的插件：通过官方 QQbot 将私聊消息传进指定的 DSH 会话，答完自动发回；图片、文件、动图、表情包、视频、B 站链接都能处理。
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）接到 QQ 的插件：通过官方 QQbot 将私聊消息传进指定的 DSH 会话，答完自动发回；图片、文件、动图、表情包、视频、B 站链接都能处理。

plugins.name: dsh-review-desk
plugins.description: DSH private Win32 review desktop: prepare stays in background, open switches explicitly. 中文：DSH 后台复验桌面
plugins.zh: DSH private Win32 review desktop: prepare stays in background, open switches explicitly. 中文：DSH 后台复验桌面

plugins.name: dsh-thinking-effort-rheostat
plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模仿 Claude Desktop 的推理强度控件
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模仿 Claude Desktop 的推理强度控件

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-inject
plugins.description: Maintained adaptation of H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject for DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2; not an official upstream release.
plugins.zh: H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject 为 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 维护适配版；非官方上游版本。

plugins.name: dsh-chat-comfort
plugins.description: Conservative chat reading enhancements for Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.
plugins.zh: 针对 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 的保守型聊天阅读增强功能。

plugins.name: dsh-ai-exporter
plugins.description: Export DSH conversations to TXT, Markdown and searchable PDF with native Windows destination selection.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为 TXT、Markdown 及可搜索 PDF，支持原生 Windows 目的地选择。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram user-account (MTProto) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: channels, messages, in-chat search, comments, links, whitelisted sending, a DSH bot chat and a Telegram-to-DSH bridge, managed from a mobile-friendly Settings page.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 用户账号 (MTProto) 插件：支持频道、消息、聊天内搜索、评论、链接、白名单发送、DSH Bot 聊天以及 Telegram 到 DSH 的桥接，均可在移动端友好的设置页面中管理。

plugins.name: dsh-brain-viewer
plugins.description: AI brain viewer for DeepSeek Harness: brain-shaped relationship graph in the sidebar + Markdown knowledge-base pipeline.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness AI 大脑查看器：侧边栏中的大脑形状关系图 + Markdown 知识库管道。

plugins.name: dsh-sensitive-replace
plugins.description: Deepseek Harness 敏感字符自动替换插件，用于替换模型读取的敏感字符从而避免官方 API 400 错误。
plugins.zh: Deepseek Harness 敏感字符自动替换插件，用于替换模型读取的敏感字符从而避免官方 API 400 错误。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-ranswork
plugins.description: Workspace overview for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list, with per-card actions (pin / rename / copy id / fork / stop / archive).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区概览：一个侧边栏面板，可在运行中的任务和所有对话之间切换，显示为可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片支持固定、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止和归档等操作。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-port
plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the local HTTP proxy port at runtime with /proxy <port>; routes the agent's in-process fetches and child processes
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：运行时通过 /proxy <port> 切换本地 HTTP 代理端口；路由代理的进程内 fetch 和子进程请求

plugins.name: dsh-x-archive
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) tool plugin: archive and read X (Twitter) posts as permanent Markdown snapshots, powered by 2100laike X Archive (x.2100laike.com)
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 工具插件：以 2100laike X Archive (x.2100laike.com) 为动力，将 X (Twitter) 帖子归档并读取为永久 Markdown 快照

plugins.name: dsh-wb-archive
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) tool plugin: archive and read Weibo posts as permanent Markdown snapshots, powered by 2100laike Weibo Archive (wb.2100laike.com)
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 工具插件：由 2100laike Weibo Archive (wb.2100laike.com) 驱动，将微博帖子归档并读作永久 Markdown 快照。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-market
plugins.description: Plugin market button for the dsh web UI - opens dshmarket.com in one click
plugins.zh: dsh Web UI 的插件市场按钮——一键打开 dshmarket.com

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.description: DeepSeek API balance and usage floating card for the dsh web UI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek API 余额和使用情况浮动卡片，适用于 dsh Web UI

plugins.name: dsh-session-dashboard
plugins.description: An always-visible session card in the DSH sidebar: see which sessions need you, are running, or completed unread — one click to jump in.
plugins.zh: DSH 侧边栏中始终可见的会话卡片：一目了然查看需要处理、运行中或未读已完成的会话，一键跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-ops-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: force every large-file download through the local aria2 engine by denying shell download commands at the tool pre-execute hook. 强制下载统一走 aria2 的 DSH 插件。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: force every large-file download through the local aria2 engine by denying shell download commands at the tool pre-execute hook. 强制下载统一走 aria2 的 DSH 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-shell
plugins.description: Mobile shell layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: drawer overlay, page lock, no iOS focus zoom, keyboard-aware composer, crypto.randomUUID polyfill.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的移动终端外壳层：抽屉式叠加、页面锁定、禁用 iOS 聚焦缩放、键盘自适应编辑器、crypto.randomUUID polyfill。

plugins.name: dsh-release
plugins.description: One-call release pipeline: sync versions, test, pack, tag+push, GitHub release, npm publish (token / staged / OIDC) — then prove the npm tarball, the GitHub asset and the local artifact are byte-identical. Bootstraps its own git/npm on machines without node on PATH.
plugins.zh: 一键发布流水线：同步版本、测试、打包、打标签并推送、创建 GitHub Release、发布 npm 包（支持 Token / Staged / OIDC 认证）—— 并验证 npm 软件包、GitHub 资源和本地工件的字节一致性。在无 node 的机器上自动引导 git/npm 环境。

plugins.name: dsh-model-thinking
plugins.description: 自动匹配第三方模型的思考强度档位，切换模型动态对齐；支持 DSH 原生菜单，可选搭配炫酷滑条。Automatic reasoning-effort matching for third-party models in DSH.
plugins.zh: 自动匹配第三方模型的思考强度档位，切换模型动态对齐；支持 DSH 原生菜单，可选搭配炫酷滑条。Automatic reasoning-effort matching for third-party models in DSH.

plugins.name: dsh-llm-llamacpp
plugins.description: llama.cpp provider for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 llama.cpp 提供者

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-orchd

plugins.zh: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline for the project of the current session. · 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-delta
plugins.description: 给 AI 编码助手的跨会话长期记忆：自动注入、只推变化。DSH 插件 + 零依赖 CLI。
plugins.zh: 给 AI 编码助手的跨会话长期记忆：自动注入、只推变化。DSH 插件 + 零依赖 CLI。

plugins.zh: DSH 会话远程备份插件：把会话日志、附件与元数据增量备份到 WebDAV 或本地目录（mirror/zip 双形态、版本保留、排除规则、限速重试、SHA-256 校验、一键恢复）。

plugins.zh: DSH plugin Prompt Forge: rewrite the composer draft by the AI-usage doctrine (AI使用心法) and toggle between original and optimized prompt

plugins.name: dsh-aitestcase
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 测试设计插件：需求 -> 测试 PRD -> 测试点 -> 测试用例 -> 质检评审，自包含、无外部后端
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 测试设计插件：需求 -> 测试 PRD -> 测试点 -> 测试用例 -> 质检评审，自包含、无外部后端

plugins.name: dsh-port-token

plugins.name: dsh-sound-notify
plugins.description: Sound notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): play a sound when a task completes, fails, or waits for approval — with per-category switches.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的声音通知：任务完成、失败或等待审批时播放提示音，支持按类别开关。

plugins.name: dsh-long-input-window
plugins.description: dsh 长内容输入插件
plugins.zh: dsh 长内容输入插件

plugins.name: dsh-mimo-voice
plugins.description: Xiaomi MiMo TTS voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness: speak a chosen line through the local speakers, with API key / voice design / preview controls in settings.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小米 MiMo TTS 语音插件：通过本地扬声器播放选定的文本，设置中包含 API 密钥、语音设计和预览控制。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-game
plugins.description: Turn-based game interface for DeepSeek Harness; Gomoku example; bring your own game.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的回合制游戏界面；含五子棋示例；支持自带游戏。

plugins.name: @agi321/dsh-temp-chat
plugins.description: Temporary Q&A: /single-turn and /multi-turn answer via an isolated web-researching subagent; results stay in the conversation and never enter the main model context.
plugins.zh: 临时问答：通过独立的网页研究子代理提供 /single-turn 和 /multi-turn 回答；结果保留在对话中，永不进入主模型上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-game-control
plugins.description: 游戏操控工具集：DeepSeek Harness 插件，给 agent 加上扫描码级键盘、鼠标相对位移（视角控制）、时序连招与截图能力 / Game control tools for DeepSeek Harness: scan-code keyboard, relative mouse, timed input sequences, screenshots (MCP + SendInput)
plugins.zh: 游戏操控工具集：DeepSeek Harness 插件，给 agent 加上扫描码级键盘、鼠标相对位移（视角控制）、时序连招与截图能力 / Game control tools for DeepSeek Harness: scan-code keyboard, relative mouse, timed input sequences, screenshots (MCP + SendInput)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: remaining account balance beside the composer cache-hit reading
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：作曲家缓存命中读数旁显示账户剩余余额

plugins.name: dsh-restart-button
plugins.description: Restart button for the DeepSeek Harness session header, plus an optional tray entry that relaunches the desktop app.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话标题的重启按钮，以及可选的系统托盘入口，用于重新打开桌面应用。

plugins.zh: 道一-易经推演 · 通用决策评审插件（决策辅助，非迷信）；六层加权聚合引擎，纯 JS 零求解器依赖

plugins.name: dsh-ui-colors
plugins.description: Adds an ability to control the looks of DSH GUI, mixing spectrum and presets of colors. Borders included!
plugins.zh: 增强 DSH GUI 外观控制，支持颜色光谱与预设混合，含边框设置！

plugins.name: dsh-turn-notify
plugins.description: Native Windows toast and chime when a DeepSeek Harness turn completes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 单轮对话完成后，在 Windows 上显示原生 Toast 通知和提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-archive-manager
plugins.description: 归档会话管理 · Archived sessions — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 设置面板：列出本机全部已归档会话，逐条复原回工作区，或连同会话日志与投影缓存永久删除。 A DSH settings panel that lists archived sessions and either restores one into its workspace or deletes it from disk for good.
plugins.zh: 归档会话管理 · Archived sessions — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 设置面板：列出本机全部已归档会话，逐条复原回工作区，或连同会话日志与投影缓存永久删除。 A DSH settings panel that lists archived sessions and either restores one into its workspace or deletes it from disk for good.

plugins.name: dsh-image-tiler
plugins.description: Shows oversized images to the model at a readably high resolution by tiling them before admission.
plugins.zh: 通过分块方式在模型可见范围内以可读高分辨率展示超大图片。

plugins.name: dsh-readme
plugins.description: DSH plugin: inject a designated text file into every agent's system prompt before its first run, as binding working constraints.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在每次代理首次运行前，将指定文本文件注入其系统提示，作为强制约束条件。

plugins.name: dsh-speed-anchor
plugins.description: Live token-speed sparkline pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 作曲家工具栏中的实时 token 速度趋势胶囊。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-armor
plugins.description: Per-model prompt injection for DeepSeek Harness: give each model its own system prompt through the official system-prompt seam.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的按模型提示注入：通过官方系统提示接口为每个模型分配独立的系统提示。

plugins.name: dsh-session-trash
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除：删除先进回收站可还原，彻底删除会清干净日志、工作区记账、归档标记与宿主会话表。
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除：删除先进回收站可还原，彻底删除会清干净日志、工作区记账、归档标记与宿主会话表。

plugins.name: dsh-providers-live-models
plugins.description: Live model catalogs for DeepSeek Harness: OpenCode Go/Zen, OpenAI Codex and OpenDesign, with per-model switches, sign-in and subscription balances. · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时模型目录：OpenCode Go/Zen、OpenAI Codex 与 OpenDesign，含逐模型开关、登录和订阅额度。
plugins.zh: Live model catalogs for DeepSeek Harness: OpenCode Go/Zen, OpenAI Codex and OpenDesign, with per-model switches, sign-in and subscription balances. · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时模型目录：OpenCode Go/Zen、OpenAI Codex 与 OpenDesign，含逐模型开关、登录和订阅额度。

plugins.name: dsh-refactor-insight
plugins.description: DSH refactor-insight skill plugin: turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan (file-length, long-function, deep-nesting, god-object, high-coupling, and TODO-density heuristics plus a staged runbook).
plugins.zh: DSH 重构洞察技能插件：将代码异味转化为可执行、优先级排序的重构计划（基于文件长度、长函数、深层嵌套、上帝对象、高耦合及 TODO 密度启发式规则，附带分阶段执行手册）

plugins.name: dsh-traffic-guard
plugins.description: A byte-budget gate for agents on metered proxies: direct-first, stall-triggered proxy, hard per-call/per-day caps, per-hop redirect checks, local ledger. Cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows). DeepSeek Harness plugin + standalone CLI.
plugins.zh: 面向计量代理的字节预算网关：优先直连、触发暂停的代理、严格单次/每日上限、逐跳重定向检查、本地账本。跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）。DeepSeek Harness 插件 + 独立 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-websift
plugins.description: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness, powered by a real Chrome over CDP. One call fetches several pages, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest (80-98% fewer context tokens). Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, auto proxy.
plugins.zh: 基于 CDP 真实 Chrome 的 Token 高效网页阅读，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。一次调用可获取多个页面，按相关性过滤并返回单一摘要（节省 80-98% 的上下文 Token）。支持真实搜索链接、登录流程、截图和自动代理。

plugins.name: dsh-geogebra
plugins.description: DSH 插件：让模型用一条 GeoGebra 命令列表画出真正的 GeoGebra 图形，导出 PNG 或可用 GeoGebra 打开的可编辑 .ggb；无窗口、不抢鼠标键盘。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：让模型用一条 GeoGebra 命令列表画出真正的 GeoGebra 图形，导出 PNG 或可用 GeoGebra 打开的可编辑 .ggb；无窗口、不抢鼠标键盘。

plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端右键对话中的文件：打开、用默认应用打开、选择其他应用、复制路径、在资源管理器中打开

plugins.name: dsh-inner-voice

plugins.zh: DSH 思维链进度字幕插件

plugins.name: dsh-tui-favors
plugins.description: A dsh-TUI plugin that pins the model, reasoning effort, agent preset and permission mode every new  conversation starts on, plus a /favors command to inspect or re-apply them on demand.
plugins.zh: dsh-TUI 插件：锁定每次新对话开始时使用的模型、推理力度、代理预设与权限模式，并提供 /favors 命令按需查看或重新应用。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-archive
plugins.description: DSH plugin: archive a whole workspace's conversations, hide fully archived workspaces from the sidebar, and pin workspaces to the top.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：归档整个工作区的对话，从侧边栏隐藏已完全归档的工作区，并将工作区置顶。

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-distill
plugins.description: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core and replay the distilled version on every later request, with a per-session cost report.
plugins.zh: 将过长模型推理蒸馏至核心有用部分，并在后续每次请求中回放蒸馏版本，附带单会话成本报告。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-custom
plugins.description: DSH 的编辑模式插件：接管布局，任意元素、组件可自定义，支持调整位置/宽/高/字号/隐藏。可选脱离文档流、吸附对齐，支持多选、批量、撤销、重置。兼容主题插件，允许用户调整元素获得更多空间和自定义个性化界面。
plugins.zh: DSH 的编辑模式插件：接管布局，任意元素、组件可自定义，支持调整位置/宽/高/字号/隐藏。可选脱离文档流、吸附对齐，支持多选、批量、撤销、重置。兼容主题插件，允许用户调整元素获得更多空间和自定义个性化界面。

plugins.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏助手：⌘⇧K 弹出未读与待决策总览，⌘⇧J / ⌘⇧I 顺序定位未读与等待处理，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；底部六项会话状态读数（运行中 / 未读 / 待处理 / 闲置 / 未归档 / 已归档）每个图标可点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；host 半边的跨重启会话账本——上次中途退出的会话重启后依然未读，账本未读也画在会话行上，启动时还会弹一次续跑清单。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness user message bubble skin library | DSH 用户消息气泡样式库插件

plugins.name: dsh-lan-remote
plugins.description: Expose the running DeepSeek Harness desktop web GUI to a phone - the same session through a loopback reverse proxy, with LAN and Tailscale token URLs. No second harness.
plugins.zh: 通过环回反向代理将正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web GUI 暴露给手机——同一会话，支持局域网和 Tailscale token URL。无需第二个 harness。

plugins.name: dsh-native-glass
plugins.description: Native macOS glass for Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop — transparent chat surfaces with live behind-window blur.
plugins.zh: Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop 原生 macOS 毛玻璃效果——透明聊天界面配合实时窗口后模糊背景。

plugins.name: dsh-peak-valley-reminder
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷提醒插件：会话标题栏「模式」之后显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 峰谷提醒插件：会话标题栏「模式」之后显示高峰/空闲时段并倒计时切换

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-organizer
plugins.description: 归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接。
plugins.zh: 归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-gate
plugins.description: Workspace-scoped plugin gate for DeepSeek Harness: per directory, hide a plugin's tool schemas and system-prompt sections from the model, so unrelated projects stop paying their prompt prefix.
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区级插件闸门：按目录隐藏插件的工具 schema 和系统提示词部分，使不相关的项目不再承担其提示词前缀的开销。

plugins.name: dsh-crosssession
plugins.description: Cross-session messaging, persistent session team, approval gates and a per-session task board for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的跨会话消息、持久会话团队、审批关卡和按会话的任务看板。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-stats
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web 插件：每条助手消息旁的费用胶囊 + 设置里的「费用统计」页（逐条计费项、回复与上下文压缩分开、官方 CNY/USD 价目表、高峰/空闲感知）
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web 插件：每条助手消息旁的费用胶囊 + 设置里的「费用统计」页（逐条计费项、回复与上下文压缩分开、官方 CNY/USD 价目表、高峰/空闲感知）

plugins.name: dsh-delete-guard
plugins.description: DSH plugin: meters AI deletions per session, terminates the call once the cumulative size passes a threshold, then asks the user with the list of files already deleted.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：计量每次会话中的 AI 删除量，当累计大小超过阈值时终止调用，并列出已删除的文件供用户确认。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-control
plugins.description: DSH Web sidebar restart control: graceful host exit, supervisor-aware replacement, pid-verified status notice.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏重启控制：优雅退出主机、支持 supervisor 感知的替换、经 pid 验证的状态通知。

plugins.name: dsh-question-tree
plugins.description: DSH Desktop 插件：使用树形结构解决线性对话上下文过长而导致回顾问题、记录问题困难的结症，允许同时记录多个问题，自定义问题深度。增加划词功能，支持添加到对话或添加到问题树。选区浮出动作栏、引用 chip、右栏问题树——记住你还没搞懂的地方，而不是让你在长对话里往回翻。
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 插件：使用树形结构解决线性对话上下文过长而导致回顾问题、记录问题困难的结症，允许同时记录多个问题，自定义问题深度。增加划词功能，支持添加到对话或添加到问题树。选区浮出动作栏、引用 chip、右栏问题树——记住你还没搞懂的地方，而不是让你在长对话里往回翻。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-review-router
plugins.description: 可指定模型的 Auto 审查：reviewer 路由来自插件配置，缺省回退当前会话。
plugins.zh: 可指定模型的 Auto 审查：reviewer 路由来自插件配置，缺省回退当前会话。

plugins.name: dsh-backup
plugins.description: 由于 dsh 的自定义范围太大，很难通过一个插件或者程序来完美备份自己的配置，所以我觉得可以通过 ai 来分析哪些配置需要备份、可以备份，以及在新的环境中如何恢复。有了这个 skills 导出的配置文件，任意 agent 都可以帮助恢复 dsh 的配置。
plugins.zh: 由于 dsh 的自定义范围太大，很难通过一个插件或者程序来完美备份自己的配置，所以我觉得可以通过 ai 来分析哪些配置需要备份、可以备份，以及在新的环境中如何恢复。有了这个 skills 导出的配置文件，任意 agent 都可以帮助恢复 dsh 的配置。

plugins.name: dsh-freemodels-opencode
plugins.description: DSH 插件：opencode Zen 免费车道模型的选择与连通性测试
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：opencode Zen 免费车道模型的选择与连通性测试

plugins.name: dsh-tool-search
plugins.description: Deferred tool loading for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): send MCP tools as a compact index and load details on demand, without breaking the prompt cache.
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）延迟工具加载：以紧凑索引发送 MCP 工具，按需加载详情，且不破坏提示词缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-picture-text-reader
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: batch-read Xiaohongshu notes and WeChat articles with local OCR, every result carrying its source URL. Read-only.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：使用本地 OCR 批量读取小红书笔记和微信公众号文章，每条结果附带来源 URL。只读模式。

plugins.name: DSH-Graphify
plugins.description: 将 Graphify 原版代码知识图谱深度集成至 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持项目自动索引、实时增量更新、交互式可视化、扫描范围配置及 AI Agent 图谱查询。Native Graphify integration for DSH Desktop, featuring automatic code knowledge graphs, original interactive visualization, live updates, and Agent tools.
plugins.zh: 将 Graphify 原版代码知识图谱深度集成至 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持项目自动索引、实时增量更新、交互式可视化、扫描范围配置及 AI Agent 图谱查询。Native Graphify integration for DSH Desktop, featuring automatic code knowledge graphs, original interactive visualization, live updates, and Agent tools.

plugins.name: dock-flash
plugins.description: dock-base adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel — mounts the panel into the dock-base Workbench. The panel itself is the separate package `dsh-flash`.
plugins.zh: DSH Quick Control 面板的 dock-base 适配器——将面板挂载到 dock-base Workbench 中。面板本身为独立包 `dsh-flash`。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-balance-tokens
plugins.description: DSH plugin: account balance and session token status strip below the workspace
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：工作区下方的账户余额与会话令牌状态条

plugins.name: dsh_session_cost
plugins.description: show cost for your current dsh session

plugins.name: dsh-herdr-site
plugins.description: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr，支持面板跳转与 --wait。状态上报 / 终端集成。｜ Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state, enabling panel jump and --wait support.
plugins.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr，支持面板跳转与 --wait。状态上报 / 终端集成。｜ Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state, enabling panel jump and --wait support.

plugins.name: dsh-comfyui-album
plugins.description: DSH 相册插件：把 dsh-comfyui-image 生成的图片收成相册，侧边栏浏览，悬浮复制图片/提示词、导出工作流、加入当前对话、删除。
plugins.zh: DSH 相册插件：把 dsh-comfyui-image 生成的图片收成相册，侧边栏浏览，悬浮复制图片/提示词、导出工作流、加入当前对话、删除。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-cost
plugins.description: DSH plugin: DeepSeek-official cost accounting (session total + current turn) added to the built-in Token usage panel.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在内置的 Token 使用面板中添加 DeepSeek 官方成本核算（会话总计 + 当前轮次）。

plugins.name: dsh-local-3d-studio
plugins.description: DSH plugin: local 3D studio orchestration with Three.js procedural modeling, multi-view rendering, and auto-detection of Blender / COLMAP / ComfyUI.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：基于 Three.js 过程建模、多视图渲染及 Blender/COLMAP/ComfyUI 自动检测的本地 3D 工作室编排。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-sfx
plugins.description: Windows toast notifications with selectable opencode sound packs for DeepSeek Harness; click a notification to open the matching session.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 弹窗通知，附带可选的 opencode 音效包；点击通知即可打开对应会话。

plugins.name: dsh-server-ops-monitor
plugins.description: DSH SSH Ops companion: read-only server metrics and streaming Agent command output in the native sidebar.
plugins.zh: DSH SSH 运维伴侣：在原生侧边栏中只读查看服务器指标并实时流式显示 Agent 命令输出。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的「增强提示词」按钮：一次辅助 LLM 调用把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持加载态、失败重试与一键回退。Prompt enhancer button for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「增强提示词」按钮：一次辅助 LLM 调用把草稿改写成结构化提示词，支持加载态、失败重试与一键回退。Prompt enhancer button for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-rea-mcp-toggle
plugins.description: Toggle REA MCP tools from DeepSeek Harness Plugins
plugins.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 插件切换 REA MCP 工具

plugins.name: dsh-theme-liuguang
plugins.description: Liuguang (琉光) — DeepSeek Harness skin with two switchable design languages: liquid glass and Soviet constructivism, plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs and a whale-girl desktop pet.
plugins.zh: Liuguang (琉光) — DeepSeek Harness skin with two switchable design languages: liquid glass and Soviet constructivism, plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs and a whale-girl desktop pet.

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-migrate
plugins.description: Workspace-scoped DeepSeek Harness migration: conversations, project files and attachments with path remapping
plugins.zh: 工作区范围的 DeepSeek Harness 迁移：包含会话、项目文件和附件，并重映射路径。

plugins.name: commandcode-usage-dsh
plugins.description: Command Code plan usage (5h / weekly windows, monthly credits) as a settings page in DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中作为设置页面展示命令代码计划使用情况（5小时/每周窗口，月度额度）

plugins.name: opencode-usage-dsh
plugins.description: OpenCode Zen/Go quota usage (5h rolling, weekly, monthly) as a settings page in DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中的 OpenCode Zen/Go 配额使用情况（5小时滚动、周、月）设置页

plugins.name: @zyfgood/dsh-mobile
plugins.description: DSH 插件：手机端 Web UI。同一局域网内用手机浏览全部 DSH 会话、实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面端提供二维码与访问链接。Mobile session client for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：手机端 Web UI。同一局域网内用手机浏览全部 DSH 会话、实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面端提供二维码与访问链接。Mobile session client for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-layout-persist
plugins.description: Persist the DeepSeek Harness Web frame's left sidebar and right panel widths across restarts.
plugins.zh: 跨重启持久化保存 DeepSeek Harness Web 框架的左侧边栏和右侧面板宽度。

plugins.name: dsh-devforge
plugins.description: Spec-driven service forge and integrated operations plugin for DSH
plugins.zh: 面向 DSH 的规格驱动型服务构建器与集成运维插件

plugins.name: dsh-whale-girl
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：鲸鱼女孩桌宠。Agent 干活时游泳、等审批时敲玻璃、完成时庆祝；互动养成 + whale_say 工具，纯 SVG/CSS 动画零素材。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：鲸鱼女孩桌宠。Agent 干活时游泳、等审批时敲玻璃、完成时庆祝；互动养成 + whale_say 工具，纯 SVG/CSS 动画零素材。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-scout
plugins.description: Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — usage categories, trust score, official peer compatibility; one-click install through the official installer (disabled by default)
plugins.zh: 发现并验证 GitHub 主题 topic:dsh-plugin 上的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 包含使用分类、可信度评分、官方兼容版本；通过官方安装器一键安装（默认禁用）。

plugins.name: dsh-ciel
plugins.description: 夏尔 Ciel — DeepSeek Harness 的规划前顾问：第二个知识广博的模型在动手前提供方向、先例、陷阱与验证清单（主意，不是步骤）。命名灵感：转生史莱姆的大贤者夏尔。Settings → 夏尔 Ciel 独立页面可配。
plugins.zh: 夏尔 Ciel — DeepSeek Harness 的规划前顾问：第二个知识广博的模型在动手前提供方向、先例、陷阱与验证清单（主意，不是步骤）。命名灵感：转生史莱姆的大贤者夏尔。Settings → 夏尔 Ciel 独立页面可配。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-local-voice
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的本地实时语音转写：右下角浮窗，边说边出字，Qwen3-ASR 本地推理，完全离线。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地实时语音转写：右下角浮窗，边说边出字，Qwen3-ASR 本地推理，完全离线。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-hot
plugins.description: Create and archive DeepSeek Harness sessions from outside the running Host — no restart, no refresh. 让运行中的 DSH 从外部创建/归档会话。
plugins.zh: Create and archive DeepSeek Harness sessions from outside the running Host — no restart, no refresh. 让运行中的 DSH 从外部创建/归档会话。

plugins.name: dsh-archived-sessions
plugins.description: Browse archived conversations and restore them to the sidebar from Settings.
plugins.zh: 在设置中浏览并恢复归档会话到侧边栏。

plugins.name: dsh-enter-send
plugins.description: dsh plugin: switch the chat composer between Enter-send and Ctrl+Enter-send from Settings → General.
plugins.zh: dsh 插件：从设置 → 常规中切换聊天输入框为按 Enter 发送或按 Ctrl+Enter 发送。

plugins.name: dsh-next-suggestion
plugins.description: Inline next-reply suggestion for the DeepSeek Harness composer: predicts your most likely next message and fills it on Tab.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器内联下一条回复建议：预测你最可能发送的消息并按 Tab 填入。

plugins.name: dsh-music-dj
plugins.description: AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: turn a sentence into a song; searches and switches tracks through a local LX Music instance (bundles no audio sources).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI DJ：将一句话变成歌曲；通过本地 LX Music 实例搜索和切换曲目（不捆绑音频源）。

plugins.name: dsh-reset-button
plugins.description: One-click Restart button for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): relaunch from the composer toolbar, right beside the permission control - no more closing and reopening the app after installing a plugin.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 一键重启按钮：位于编辑器工具栏权限控制旁，安装插件后无需关闭再打开应用。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-maximize
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮） | DeepSeek Harness Desktop Plugin: Auto‑maximize main window on launch (same as clicking the Maximize button manually)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动自动最大化主窗口（等同于手动点击最大化按钮） | DeepSeek Harness Desktop Plugin: Auto‑maximize main window on launch (same as clicking the Maximize button manually)

plugins.name: dsh-default-workspace
plugins.description: DSH 插件：点击新对话页工作区前的文件夹图标，一键切回默认工作区
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：点击新对话页工作区前的文件夹图标，一键切回默认工作区

plugins.name: dsh-relay-isolation
plugins.description: Provision a separate DSH_HOME for a model relay, so relay traffic never shares your main Harness sessions or credentials.
plugins.zh: 为模型中继 provision 独立的 DSH_HOME，确保中继流量不与你的主 Harness 会话或凭据共享。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-json-mcp
plugins.description: DSH-JsonMCP配置UI及组件
plugins.zh: DSH-JsonMCP配置UI及组件

plugins.name: dsh-auto-update
plugins.description: Check, install and roll back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page - with health-checked restart and automatic rollback.
plugins.zh: 在 Web 设置页面检查、安装并回滚 DeepSeek Harness CLI 更新，支持健康检查重启与自动回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-project-runner
plugins.description: Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live output, and keeps each run's log on disk for the agent to read.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分组运行面板：一键启动项目的全部服务于真实 PTY 中，实时流式输出日志，并将每次运行的日志持久化到磁盘供智能体读取。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh
plugins.description: SSH terminal, SFTP, remote metrics and agent tools for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SSH 终端、SFTP、远程指标和智能体工具。

plugins.name: dsh-welcome-boot
plugins.description: 启动DSH默认播放鲸鱼女仆的开机动画，点设置→内置插件→开屏动画就可以换成自己的视频。
plugins.zh: 启动DSH默认播放鲸鱼女仆的开机动画，点设置→内置插件→开屏动画就可以换成自己的视频。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-balance-v2
plugins.description: Inline DSH balance/session usage readout: session cost, duration, remaining balance, peak/off-peak, between token usage and context.
plugins.zh: 内联 DSH 余额/会话用量读显：会话成本、时长、剩余余额、峰谷时段，以及词元用量与上下文之间的关系。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-recursive-harness
plugins.description: Recursive Harness for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Propose, Probe, Compose loops and a cross-task experience library (Harness², arXiv:2610.14224). Work in progress.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的递归 Harness：提议、探测、组合循环以及跨任务体验库（Harness²，arXiv:2610.14224）。正在进行中。

plugins.name: dsh-liangwen-tide

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的峰谷指示器 + 当日已用金额：峰时「梁文峰」、谷时「梁文谷」，峰谷时段与价目表自动跟随官方定价页。A peak/off-peak tide + today-cost plugin for the DSH Web GUI.

plugins.zh: 听懂：把英文有声读物（MP3）或英文文档变成听力课——本机识别每一句、AI 朗读翻译、精听与间隔复习，练到一听就懂。DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件 | Turn English audiobooks into listening lessons for dsh.

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-base

plugins.zh: DSH 工作区的本地优先、可编辑知识库，显示在侧边栏中。

plugins.name: dsh-open-any
plugins.description: 对话内文件右键「打开方式」——含系统 OpenAs 对话框，可打开未注册文件关联的应用 | Right-click files in DSH chat to open them with any local app.
plugins.zh: 对话内文件右键「打开方式」——含系统 OpenAs 对话框，可打开未注册文件关联的应用 | Right-click files in DSH chat to open them with any local app.

plugins.name: dsh-code-ctx
plugins.description: 给 AI agent 的代码库上下文引擎 —— 索引 0.5s，检索 6ms，hit@8 81%
plugins.zh: 给 AI agent 的代码库上下文引擎 —— 索引 0.5s，检索 6ms，hit@8 81%

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-clinepass
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: ClinePass model provider — seeds the llm-pi-ai `clinepass` route (endpoint, protocol, credential ref, 12-model catalog) so the Models settings page needs only the API key.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 捆绑包：ClinePass 模型提供商——初始化 llm-pi-ai `clinepass` 路由（端点、协议、凭证引用、12 款模型目录），使“模型”设置页面仅需填写 API 密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-setting
plugins.description: 在「设置」界面管理 DSH 配置文件里的 MCP 服务器。setup mcp server in setting panel
plugins.zh: 在「设置」界面管理 DSH 配置文件里的 MCP 服务器。setup mcp server in setting panel

plugins.name: dshx-token-cost
plugins.description: A DSH settings page showing the DeepSeek account balance alongside daily token usage broken down by model, with the metered API cost it would have incurred.
plugins.zh: DSH 设置页面，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额及按模型分组的每日 token 用量，并计算对应的计量 API 费用。

plugins.name: dshx-skill-manager
plugins.description: A DSH settings page listing installed skills with per-skill enable switches and short summaries.
plugins.zh: DSH 设置页面，列出已安装的技能，并提供每个技能的启用开关和简短说明。

plugins.name: dshx-session-delete
plugins.description: Permanently delete a DSH conversation 鈥?sidebar menu item plus the removal endpoint the harness itself does not provide.
plugins.zh: Permanently delete a DSH conversation 鈥?sidebar menu item plus the removal endpoint the harness itself does not provide.

plugins.name: dshx-message-edit
plugins.description: Edit a sent prompt or an assistant reply inside an existing DSH conversation, then regenerate from that point 鈥?in place, without forking a new session.
plugins.zh: Edit a sent prompt or an assistant reply inside an existing DSH conversation, then regenerate from that point 鈥?in place, without forking a new session.

plugins.name: dshx-loop-guard
plugins.description: Detect and stop repeated identical tool calls (agent loops), mainly for small local models.
plugins.zh: 检测和停止重复的相同工具调用（Agent 循环），主要针对小型本地模型。

plugins.name: dshx-language-mirror
plugins.description: Always reply (including final reports) in the language of the user's latest prompt.
plugins.zh: 始终使用用户最新提示的语言（包括最终报告）进行回复。

plugins.name: dshx-image-clamp
plugins.description: Clamp every image sent to the model to a maximum side length (default 2000px) so Claude's many-image limit is never exceeded.
plugins.zh: 将发送给模型的所有图片最大边长限制为默认 2000px，确保不超出 Claude 的多图限制。

plugins.name: dshx-ai-approval
plugins.description: Adds an AI-reviewed sandbox escalation permission preset to DSH.
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 添加经 AI 审查的沙箱升级权限预设。

plugins.name: dsh-grsai-canvas
plugins.description: DSH 右侧栏「画布」插件：无限画布 + 直接在图上标注 + 接入 GrsAI(gpt-image-2 / nano-banana) 按标注改图，结果放在原图旁边对比，画布自动存到工作区。
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧栏「画布」插件：无限画布 + 直接在图上标注 + 接入 GrsAI(gpt-image-2 / nano-banana) 按标注改图，结果放在原图旁边对比，画布自动存到工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web-panel
plugins.description: DeepSeek web panel for DSH
plugins.zh: DSH 的 DeepSeek 网页面板

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-cdp
plugins.description: Drive the native browser page in the DeepSeek Harness desktop Sidebar: nine tools, pure plugin, no launch flags
plugins.zh: 驱动 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端侧边栏中的原生浏览器页面：九个工具，纯插件，无需启动标志

plugins.name: @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: complete workbench (explorer / editors / previews / terminal / git / browser / tasks, side + bottom split panes) plus a VSCode-like shell refactor (full-width 48px header, activity rail, global controls). Service-first: exposes ctx.betterS
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：完整工作台（资源管理器/编辑器/预览/终端/git/浏览器/任务，侧边及底部分割窗格）以及类 VSCode 的 Shell 重构（全宽 48px 标题栏、活动栏、全局控制）。服务优先：暴露 ctx.betterS

plugins.name: dsh-approval-explainer
plugins.description: DSH 审批弹窗 AI 注释器：模型请求权限外操作时，用模型自己的推理解释这次操作的意义与风险
plugins.zh: DSH 审批弹窗 AI 注释器：模型请求权限外操作时，用模型自己的推理解释这次操作的意义与风险

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-tmp
plugins.description: Workspace Tmp for DeepSeek Harness: gives the agent a temporary directory beside the workspace for test files and scratch output, with a workspace_tmp tool and automatic deletion, so nothing pollutes the project tree.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区临时目录，供测试文件和临时输出使用，附带 workspace_tmp 工具和自动清理功能，确保项目目录不受污染。

plugins.name: dsh-cache-saver
plugins.description: DSH plugin that cuts the prompt payload re-sent every request: slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas, attributes tool-result volume, and shows the token cost in a settings page.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，用于削减每次请求重复发送的提示载荷：压缩过大的 MCP 工具 JSON Schema、归因工具结果体积，并在设置页面显示令牌消耗。

plugins.name: dsh-attest-chain
plugins.description: Signed chain-of-custody for DeepSeek Harness sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record — what the agent did, provable after the fact
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness会话的签名链式监管：每个被监控的工具结果都会追加一个哈希链接的、ed25519签名的记录 — 代理做了什么，事后可以证明

plugins.name: dsh-temp-note
plugins.description: A temp note in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, with session, workspace, and global scopes, one-click copy, and LLM polish.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏中的临时笔记，支持会话、工作区和全局作用域，一键复制及 LLM 润色。

plugins.name: DSH-TokenDashboard
plugins.description: A local token usage, API call, and cache statistics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Token 用量、API 调用和缓存统计仪表板。

plugins.name: dsh-install-profiler
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Windows 安装包静态画像 + 静态画像驱动的动态取证与故障排查
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Windows 安装包静态画像 + 静态画像驱动的动态取证与故障排查

plugins.name: dsh-balance-usage-widget
plugins.description: Composer-dock widget for DeepSeek Harness: account balance + session token usage.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器停靠小工具：显示账户余额和会话 token 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-session-recycle
plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move sessions into a recycle bin with view/restore/permanent-delete · DSH 会话回收站
plugins.zh: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move sessions into a recycle bin with view/restore/permanent-delete · DSH 会话回收站

plugins.name: dsh-llm-xai-oauth
plugins.description: Use a SuperGrok / X Premium subscription inside DeepSeek Harness. Device-code OAuth, grok-bridge token reuse, no xAI API key. Works in headless, web, and any TUI.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅。支持设备码 OAuth、grok-bridge token 复用，无需 xAI API 密钥。适用于无头模式、Web 界面及任意 TUI。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-search
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 多引擎搜索插件：原生 web_search 兼容，必应/百度/搜狗/360 + Tavily/Exa，网页正文抓取与 web_research 深度收集，零模型 token、可配置、可回退。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多引擎搜索插件：原生 web_search 兼容，必应/百度/搜狗/360 + Tavily/Exa，网页正文抓取与 web_research 深度收集，零模型 token、可配置、可回退。

plugins.name: dsh-status-turbo
plugins.description: DSH(DeepSeek Harness) 状态条：在输入框上方一行显示当前阶段、本阶段耗时、本步 token 与无进展告警，纯日志投影驱动，不轮询宿主。
plugins.zh: DSH(DeepSeek Harness) 状态条：在输入框上方一行显示当前阶段、本阶段耗时、本步 token 与无进展告警，纯日志投影驱动，不轮询宿主。

plugins.name: dsh-stream-timeout-fix
plugins.description: Fix the 300s undici bodyTimeout that kills long LLM SSE streams with TypeError: terminated (DeepSeek Harness host plugin)
plugins.zh: 修复导致长 LLM SSE 流因 TypeError: terminated 而中断的 300s undici bodyTimeout 问题（DeepSeek Harness 主机插件）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-prompt-enhance
plugins.description: DSH Desktop 提示词增强插件：1:1 复刻 WorkBuddy 的增强按钮，含插件详情页配置面板与 dsh-cost-meter 费用估算
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 提示词增强插件：1:1 复刻 WorkBuddy 的增强按钮，含插件详情页配置面板与 dsh-cost-meter 费用估算

plugins.name: dsh-session-janitor
plugins.description: DSH session cleaner: a sidebar page listing session records and archive caches, with a restorable recycle bin and an in-use guard.
plugins.zh: DSH 会话清理器：侧边栏页面列出会话记录和归档缓存，带可恢复回收站和使用中保护。

plugins.name: dsh-session-manager
plugins.description: Delete DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sessions and workspace data from the Web GUI — a per-session Delete menu row, a management settings page with sizes, and a restorable trash.
plugins.zh: 从 Web GUI 删除 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 会话及工作区数据——每个会话提供 Delete 菜单行，设置页面显示大小信息，并支持从回收站恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-session-find
plugins.description: Ctrl+F find-in-session for DeepSeek Harness: full-text search over the loaded conversation, with source labels, turn grouping, regex / case / whole-word options and Markdown export.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ctrl+F 会话内查找：对加载的对话进行全文搜索，支持来源标签、回合分组、正则表达式/大小写/全词匹配选项及 Markdown 导出

plugins.name: dsh-skills-mcp
plugins.description: 为deepseek harness添加skills和mcp管理功能
plugins.zh: 为deepseek harness添加skills和mcp管理功能

plugins.name: dsh-vba-bridge
plugins.description: Read, edit and verify Excel VBA projects — modules, UserForms, export and procedure lists — through Excel COM, exposed as DSH tools.
plugins.zh: 通过 Excel COM 读取、编辑和验证 Excel VBA 项目 —— 包括模块、用户窗体、导出和过程列表，并以 DSH 工具的形式暴露

plugins.name: dsh-stata
plugins.description: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）中控制 Stata：常驻 GUI 会话、执行命令与 .do 文件、回读控制台输出（无需 COM / 管理员 / 批处理模式）
plugins.zh: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）中控制 Stata：常驻 GUI 会话、执行命令与 .do 文件、回读控制台输出（无需 COM / 管理员 / 批处理模式）

plugins.name: dsh-preview-studio
plugins.description: [Experimental] Live app preview for DeepSeek Harness EXE/APK work - tested only on DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.
plugins.zh: 【实验性】DeepSeek Harness EXE/APK 开发的实时应用预览，仅在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 上测试。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-feeder
plugins.description: DSH plugin that extracts long-term facts from completed turns into an appendable Markdown memory inbox.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，从已完成轮次中提取长期事实到可追加的 Markdown 记忆收件箱。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-price-tip
plugins.description: DeepSeek 官方 API 峰谷价格提醒：Harness Web UI 胶囊 + deepseek_price_tip Agent 工具
plugins.zh: DeepSeek 官方 API 峰谷价格提醒：Harness Web UI 胶囊 + deepseek_price_tip Agent 工具

plugins.name: dsh-session-hud
plugins.description: Session-status desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): live counts of running / unread-completed / waiting-for-choice sessions; click a count to jump.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的会话状态桌面宠物：实时显示运行中/未读已完成/等待选择中的会话数量；点击数量可跳转。

plugins.name: dsh-reverse-skill
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地软件逆向与反编译技能（APK/JAR/.NET/原生 PE/固件），带工具探测、授权门禁、证据分级
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地软件逆向与反编译技能（APK/JAR/.NET/原生 PE/固件），带工具探测、授权门禁、证据分级

plugins.name: dsh-comfy
plugins.description: ComfyUI workflow canvas for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) desktop right sidebar: browse, inspect, edit and run local ComfyUI workflows on a native infinite canvas instead of an embedded browser.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 桌面版右侧边栏的 ComfyUI 工作流画布：在原生无限画布上浏览、检查、编辑和运行本地 ComfyUI 工作流，替代嵌入浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-video-kit
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与关键帧图片，供模型逐帧查看。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与关键帧图片，供模型逐帧查看。

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy2api-connect
plugins.description: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关的模型目录自动同步进 DeepSeek Harness（模型名/思考档/最大上下文），带可视面板
plugins.zh: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关的模型目录自动同步进 DeepSeek Harness（模型名/思考档/最大上下文），带可视面板

plugins.name: CodexAutoApprovalDSH
plugins.description: Auto approval tool for DSH
plugins.zh: DSH 自动审批工具

plugins.name: dsh-ui-opacity
plugins.description: Adjustable opacity for DeepSeek Harness popup menus and the session header.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 弹出菜单和会话标题栏的不透明度可调。

plugins.name: dsh-compaction-guard
plugins.description: Compaction integrity for DeepSeek Harness: constraints extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — what the agent was told to remember and silently forgot is reported loudly. Zero LLM calls in the trust path
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的压缩完整性：从压缩范围提取的约束会与摘要进行验证 — 代理被要求记住却无声遗忘的内容会被大声报告。信任路径中零LLM调用

plugins.name: dsh-freeze
plugins.description: Hermetic composition lock for DeepSeek Harness: fingerprints the profile's plugin set, lockfile, and patch layer; a session that boots on a drifted composition says so loudly — the vendor-skills --frozen thesis, applied to the whole agent
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的隔离组合锁：对配置文件的插件集、锁文件和补丁层进行指纹识别；若会话基于漂移的组合启动，将明确报错——这是将 vendor-skills --frozen 理念应用于整个代理的体现

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-drift
plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness: baselines every section contributed to the assembled system prompt and warns loudly when a plugin or preset upgrade silently adds, removes, or rewrites what the model is told
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词漂移闸门：汇聚各部分贡献以构建系统提示词，并在插件或预设升级静默添加、移除或重写模型指令时发出警示

plugins.name: dsh-egress-gate
plugins.description: Deterministic network egress gate for DeepSeek Harness: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist before they run — content scanning guards what agents read, this guards where data may flow
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性网络出口闸门：所有网页抓取和搜索请求在运行前均会对照目标地址白名单进行检查——内容扫描守护代理读取的数据，此闸门守护数据的流向

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-test
plugins.description: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate for DeepSeek Harness: records every visible tool schema (including MCP tools), diffs upgrades against the baseline, and refuses silent surface changes
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的工具表面快照和漂移门：记录每个可见的工具架构（包括MCP工具），将升级与基线进行差异比较，并拒绝静默的表面变更

plugins.name: dsh-pr-gate
plugins.description: Deterministic write gate for DeepSeek Harness: scope policy + residue scan on every file the agent writes, live in the session — the CI gate moved to the moment of the write
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性写入闸门：在会话中实时对代理写入的每个文件应用作用域策略与残留扫描——将 CI 闸门移至写入发生的瞬间

plugins.name: dsh-read-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic prompt-injection interception for DeepSeek Harness: scans what the agent READS (tool results) at the moment it enters model context
plugins.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性提示词注入拦截：扫描代理在即将进入模型上下文时实际读取的内容（工具结果）

plugins.name: dsh-agent-hints
plugins.description: Per-request serving-intent hints for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the X-Agent-Hint HTTP header on an independent chat-completions provider route. Install: dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的按请求服务意图提示：基于独立 chat-completions 提供程序路由的 X-Agent-Hint HTTP 头。安装：dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints

plugins.name: dsh-academic-search
plugins.description: DSH plugin for CS/AI academic search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and Crossref — paper identity merging, bounded citation chains, arXiv handoff, no model API.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，用于在 arXiv、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 和 Crossref 上进行 CS/AI 学术搜索——支持论文身份合并、有界引用链、arXiv 交接，无需调用模型 API。

plugins.name: file-checker
plugins.description: A DSH plugin that adds a one-click Open location button to delivered-file cards.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：为交付文件卡片新增一键打开位置按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pomodoro
plugins.description: Pomodoro focus timer plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a floating overlay timer with a Plugins-page configuration page, break cycles and desktop notifications. Browser-only DSH client plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 番茄钟专注定时器插件：浮动覆盖层计时器，配备插件页面配置界面，支持休息周期与桌面通知。仅限浏览器端 DSH 客户端使用。

plugins.name: dsh-glm-web-search
plugins.description: Z.AI (GLM) web search, web reader and vision for DeepSeek Harness, authenticated by a Z.AI email (OAuth) login instead of an API key.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.AI (GLM) 网络搜索、网页阅读和视觉功能，通过 Z.AI 邮箱（OAuth）登录认证，无需 API 密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-paper-reader
plugins.description: DSH 插件：论文解读模式。精读单篇论文并生成证据可追溯的中文解读报告，按图注自动裁出图表，并基于同一份解析产物回答关于这篇论文的问题。速览 / 解读 / 深读三档可选，以 agent preset 隔离，只在选中该模式时可见。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：论文解读模式。精读单篇论文并生成证据可追溯的中文解读报告，按图注自动裁出图表，并基于同一份解析产物回答关于这篇论文的问题。速览 / 解读 / 深读三档可选，以 agent preset 隔离，只在选中该模式时可见。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
plugins.description: Prompt enhancement for the composer: a star button left of the send action rewrites the draft with the session's model, with editable template files beside the bundle
plugins.zh: 为编辑器提供提示词增强功能：发送按钮左侧设有一颗星标，使用当前会话的模型重写草稿，并可在捆绑包旁编辑模板文件。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-suite
plugins.description: Skill management for the DeepSeek Harness: the Skills page (browse, toggle, edit, create, delete) over the user skill root, the save_skill authoring tool for the agent, and the bundled skill-creator manual
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的技能管理：涵盖用户技能根目录的“技能”页面（浏览、切换、编辑、创建、删除）、供智能体使用的 save_skill 创作工具，以及内置的 skill-creator 手册。

plugins.name: dsh-scheduled-tasks

plugins.zh: Local File Share / 本地文件共享 — let the dsh agent list, read and write files on the machine that runs your browser, through a private WebSocket relay and the File System Access API. Zero data copied onto the dsh host.

plugins.name: dsh-simple-cost
plugins.description: DSH widget: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, running cost of the open conversation, per-turn cost, and a button-triggered AI breakdown for turns over a token threshold. Peak/off-peak billing, holiday-aware.
plugins.zh: DSH 小部件：在侧边栏账户区域上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前对话的运行成本、每轮成本，以及触发式 AI 费用明细（针对超过 token 阈值的轮次）。区分峰谷计费，节假日感知。

plugins.name: dsh-sao-link-start
plugins.description: Full-screen SAO-inspired startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable beam, dial, language and character settings. Original high-fidelity rendering by default; optional compatibility mode for low-end GPUs and a tunnel-only intro.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造全屏 SAO 风格启动动画，可调光束、旋钮、语言和角色设置。默认高保真渲染；可选兼容模式适配低配 GPU，仅展示隧道开场。

plugins.name: gord-dsh-saber-theme
plugins.description: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Saber（Fate）主题皮肤，支持 macOS 和 Windows。
plugins.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Saber（Fate）主题皮肤，支持 macOS 和 Windows。

plugins.name: dsh-ecosystem-panel
plugins.description: DSH plugin: read-only ecosystem health panel - bundle / patch / skill / upgrade / decoupling diagnosis in one view | DSH 插件：只读生态健康面板，六类体检一屏看完
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: read-only ecosystem health panel - bundle / patch / skill / upgrade / decoupling diagnosis in one view | DSH 插件：只读生态健康面板，六类体检一屏看完

plugins.name: dsh-strata-monitor
plugins.description: Strata model server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness: monitor page, floating window, composer status line.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Strata 模型服务器监控面板：监控页面、浮动窗口、Composer 状态栏。

plugins.name: dsh-windows-mcp-lite

plugins.name: dsh-auto-shutdown
plugins.description: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness plugin: a switch in Settings that powers off the PC after the conversation finishes, with a native countdown dialog that cancels the shutdown in one click.
plugins.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：设置中提供一个开关，在对话结束后关闭 PC，附带原生倒计时对话框，可一键取消关机。

plugins.name: dsh-dyou-wine
plugins.description: D友の酒 · Dyou Wine: fixed-rhythm page bounce, a flying whale-girl pet and bundled BGM for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: D友の酒 · Dyou Wine: fixed-rhythm page bounce, a flying whale-girl pet and bundled BGM for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-codex-style
plugins.description: DSH output style plugin
plugins.zh: DSH 输出样式插件

plugins.name: dsh-notification-bridge
plugins.description: DSH macOS notification bridge
plugins.zh: DSH macOS 通知桥接器

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-custom
plugins.description: Use configured DSH model providers and credentials for OpenAI Responses web search.
plugins.zh: 使用已配置的 DSH 模型提供商与凭据进行 OpenAI Responses 网页搜索。

plugins.description: A proper image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: zoom, pan, rotate, download, copy, open with the default app, and gallery browsing for images inside the chat.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的专业图片查看器：支持缩放、平移、旋转、下载、复制、用默认应用打开，以及聊天内图片画廊浏览。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web-panel

plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：在中央面板嵌入 DeepSeek 网页聊天

plugins.name: dsh-ui-plugin
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that restyles the welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 插件，重构欢迎区域和编辑器的样式，并提供工作区、模式和技能的快捷入口。

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：为会话菜单添加永久删除会话操作（DSH 仅自带归档功能）。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-console
plugins.description: DSH skill manager plugin: /skills, /skills-uninstall, /skills-update, /skills-doctor
plugins.zh: DSH 技能管理插件：/skills、/skills-uninstall、/skills-update、/skills-doctor

plugins.name: dsh-skill-sync

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：保持本地技能仓库镜像更新（定期 git pull + /skills-sync）。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-lastused
plugins.description: DSH plugin: keeps the most recently used workspace first in the sidebar, persisted across restarts.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：将最近使用的工作区置顶显示于侧边栏，并在重启后保持持久。

plugins.name: dsh-intelligent-ui
plugins.description: DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness — turns answers into interactive Paper Glass cards. 24 components, streaming + persistent turn cards.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将回答转换为交互式 Paper Glass 卡片。包含 24 个组件，支持流式传输与持久化会话卡片。
