plugins.name: @1agents/session-reader
plugins.description: Read Plane: cross-agent session discovery, turn inspection, workspace aggregation and distillation from raw local session files.
plugins.zh: Read Plane：跨智能体会话发现、轮次检查、工作区聚合及从原始本地会话文件中提炼总结。

plugins.name: dsh-context-window-picker
plugins.description: Session-scoped context window selector for the DeepSeek Harness model picker
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器的会话级上下文窗口选择器

plugins.zh: Skill GoGo：一个 DSH 面板插件，用于浏览、分组、预览、导出、安装和重命名技能，并在编辑器中提供多选技能菜单。

plugins.name: dsh-live-preview
plugins.description: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。
plugins.zh: Live-preview panel for DeepSeek Harness: preview workspace pages beside the chat, auto-reload on save. · DeepSeek Harness 实时预览插件：边聊边看你的页面，改完自动刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-parallel-dev
plugins.description: DSH 并行开发编排插件：团队模式门禁、独立验收、依赖看板与设置页

plugins.description: DSH GitHub 热榜插件：按日/周/月给模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务等小工具排名，榜单类型可自定义。
plugins.zh: DSH GitHub 热榜插件：按日/周/月给模型插件、Skill、MCP 服务等小工具排名，榜单类型可自定义。

plugins.name: dsh-test-framework

plugins.zh: 面向测试工程师的 AI 自动化测试框架插件：一键把「测试工作框架」骨架落到任意新文件夹；会话里自动带上框架约束并形成闸门；引导式把需求文档拆成模块、确认版本与跨文档关联、登记测试环境与账密，落到产品级规范。

plugins.name: dsh-spring-boot-launcher
plugins.description: 该项目是一个Deepseek Harness的插件，目前是作为Maven Spring Boot 项目的专用启动器。它提供 Agent 工具和 Web 管理面板，用同一套进程管理逻辑完成项目检查、Profile 选择、启停、状态查询和日志查看。
plugins.zh: 该项目是一个Deepseek Harness的插件，目前是作为Maven Spring Boot 项目的专用启动器。它提供 Agent 工具和 Web 管理面板，用同一套进程管理逻辑完成项目检查、Profile 选择、启停、状态查询和日志查看。

plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 插件：按住 Ctrl 并点击 Tab 可在最近查看的会话间切换；松开修饰键即打开高亮会话。Ctrl+Shift+Tab 反向循环。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：模糊路径查找 + 索引内容搜索（find_files / resolve_file / related_files），移植自 pi-fff。

plugins.zh: DSH 新手入门包：安装即得欢迎语、从 0 到 1 学习路径、按场景推荐插件、新手自查清单，并与 dsh-handbook-zh 中文教程联动。Starter pack for DeepSeek Harness beginners (Chinese).

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-delete

plugins.zh: Delete sessions — local logs included, irreversibly — and manage or delete workspaces from the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar. · 在 dsh 侧栏删除会话（连带本地日志，不可恢复），并管理工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-hub
plugins.description: Remote MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness: settings page, connection management, and mcp__<server>__<tool> registration in one plugin
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程 MCP 服务器：设置页面、连接管理及 mcp__<server>__<tool> 注册，集成于单一插件中。

plugins.name: dsh-easy-approval
plugins.description: Two-step Enter for DeepSeek Harness approvals: the first Enter selects the pending approval panel, the second allows it · 两段式审批 Enter
plugins.zh: Two-step Enter for DeepSeek Harness approvals: the first Enter selects the pending approval panel, the second allows it · 两段式审批 Enter

plugins.name: dsh-office-live

plugins.name: dsh-restart-planner

plugins.description: Conversation-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness: plays a sound when a user-initiated task actually finishes, not when it is interrupted.

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-skin-kitty

plugins.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI 打造的 Hello Kitty 主题插件，以粉嫩的视觉风格和自定义壁纸，为你的 DSH 界面增添一份可爱与个性。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-plus
plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: usage stats, plan quotas, custom HTTPS balance, 26-week heatmap
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面插件：使用统计、计划配额、自定义 HTTPS 余额、26 周热力图

plugins.zh: DSH PTC run_code 解析错误位置插件（行号 + 代码帧）

plugins.zh: 面向 dsh-TUI 的原生 MCP Server 管理插件：通过 /mcp-manager 浮窗完成 MCP CRUD、启停、Sets、复制、Inspector、Tool schema、Doctor Lite 和凭据引用管理，并将配   置原子写入当前 profile，支持 Cordis HMR 热重载。

plugins.name: DSH-SessionDelete

plugins.zh: DSH 会话删除插件：在「归档会话」下方新增「删除会话」

plugins.name: dsh-memory-system-prompt

plugins.zh: 将本地视频上传至抖音创作者账号：打开上传页面，调用文件选择器，上传文件并完成验证，填写标题，设置可见性——除非明确指示，否则不会点击发布。

plugins.zh: 一键将本地 DSH 插件项目发布到 GitHub 和插件市场：预检、逐文件上传并校验字节、提交市场注册 PR，然后拉取所有已发布文件并对比字节。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-model-router

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x 支持按任务选择子代理及推理强度。CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router 的维护延续版本。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：STM32 / PY32 调试与烧录（CMSIS-DAP / DAPLink / openocd）+ 串口收发。内置独立 openocd 副本，不碰你的 IDE 树。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-graph

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-notebook-tools

plugins.zh: 面向 DSH 代理的单元格感知型 Jupyter Notebook 工具

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.zh: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).

plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 与 Zen 实时模型发现、会话路由、定价与资格诊断

plugins.name: dsh-skill-center
plugins.description: DSH 技能中心：查看、开关、新建、按链接安装、删除（进回收站可恢复）DSH 技能。
plugins.zh: DSH 技能中心：查看、开关、新建、按链接安装、删除（进回收站可恢复）DSH 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-particles
plugins.description: Interactive whale particle background for the DSH Web UI: every dot carries its own slow force; mouse disturbs them, plus an auto screensaver mode with 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing. Custom particle colours, a soft bloom glow, and selectable
plugins.zh: DSH Web UI 的交互式鲸鱼粒子背景：每个点都携带自身的缓慢力场；鼠标扰动它们，并具备带 360 度波浪和全屏呼吸效果的自动屏保模式。支持自定义粒子颜色、柔和泛光效果和可选

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-auto-compact
plugins.description: 上下文占用达到 50% 时自动压缩（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。Auto-compact a DeepSeek Harness session at 50% context usage.
plugins.zh: 上下文占用达到 50% 时自动压缩（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。Auto-compact a DeepSeek Harness session at 50% context usage.

plugins.name: ox-alpha-dsh
plugins.description: Bilingual DSH Desktop model hub plugin for Ox Alpha, custom LLM models/providers, health checks, OpenRouter discovery, and safe rollback.
plugins.zh: Ox Alpha 的双语 DSH Desktop 模型中心插件，支持自定义 LLM 模型/提供者、健康检查、OpenRouter 发现及安全回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-nestquay
plugins.description: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar
plugins.zh: DSH 侧边栏的工作区分组

plugins.name: dsh-blue-whale-balance
plugins.description: DSH 插件｜DeepSeek 余额动画桌宠：余额卡片、逐密钥观测账目、历史趋势与低余额提醒
plugins.zh: DSH 插件｜DeepSeek 余额动画桌宠：余额卡片、逐密钥观测账目、历史趋势与低余额提醒

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 本地用量桌宠：逐轮 token 用量气泡 + 按天养成的 Q 版战地医护，含本机统计、每日任务、勋章、久坐/喝水提醒与四套换装主题。不联网、不读凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-translate
plugins.description: dsh插件，用于直接对客户端内或网页内的文字划线翻译
plugins.zh: dsh插件，用于直接对客户端内或网页内的文字划线翻译

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spreadjs-driver
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: allow the agent editing XLSX/SJS/SSJSON file automaticlly, can be cooperated with dsh-spreadjs-editor plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：允许代理自动编辑 XLSX/SJS/SSJSON 文件，可与 dsh-spreadjs-editor 插件配合使用。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-spreadjs-editor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: view and edit Excel/SpreadJS workbooks from the ui-all file tree.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：从 ui-all 文件树中查看和编辑 Excel/SpreadJS 工作簿。

plugins.name: dsh-lmmarr
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态

plugins.name: dsh-open-native
plugins.description: Open delivered-file cards with the system default app
plugins.zh: 使用系统默认应用打开已交付的文件卡片

plugins.name: dsh-icon-switch
plugins.description: dsh-icon-switch: in-app icon switcher for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: dsh-icon-switch：DeepSeek Harness 内置图标切换器

plugins.name: dsh-litellm-extra-headers
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为指定的提供者和上游主机，在 OpenAI 兼容的 chat/completions 请求中注入 body-level 额外头部（这是唯一能穿透 LiteLLM 中继的注入点）。

plugins.name: dsh-undici-timeout
plugins.description: A configurable direct channel for the DeepSeek Harness LLM egress: a keep-alive undici Agent with adjustable connect/headers/body/keep-alive timeouts, IPv4-forcing, HTTP/2 off by default, automatic stand-down behind a proxy, and a read-only status route. A minimal patch, one file, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness LLM 出口的可选直连通道：可配置的 keep-alive undici Agent，支持调整连接/头部/主体/保活超时、强制 IPv4、默认关闭 HTTP/2、代理后自动降级，以及只读状态路由。最小化补丁，单文件，零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-edit-resend
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: edit an already-sent user prompt and resend it - forks a child session whose inherited prefix stops just before that message.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：编辑已发送的用户提示词并重新发送——分叉一个子会话，其继承前缀仅截止到该消息之前。

plugins.name: dsh-firefly-spring-skin
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤样板 · Firefly 'Spring Missive' theme skin for the DSH web GUI

plugins.name: dsh-omni-modal
plugins.description: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness: configure OpenAI-compatible image/video generation endpoints with switchable config profiles, plus generate_image / generate_video / check_video tools.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Omni-modal 设置部分：配置 OpenAI 兼容的图像/视频生成端点，支持可切换的配置方案，并提供 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：让 Agent Teams 领队为其创建的每个队友选择提供者、模型和推理强度。

plugins.name: dsh-easy-hotkey
plugins.description: Window-local shortcut guide for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: hold-to-open overlay, keycap search, temporary pinning, light/dark themes, and bilingual UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 窗口级快捷键指南：按住打开浮层、键帽搜索、临时固定、明暗主题及双语界面。

plugins.name: dsh-artifact-center
plugins.description: Artifact Center — browse, search and open files produced by DSH conversations across workspaces.
plugins.zh: Artifact Center——浏览、搜索并打开各工作区中 DSH 对话生成的文件。

plugins.name: dsh-projection-persist
plugins.description: DSH plugin: keep session projection values (titles) alive across a Host generation reset, so the session list never falls back to the untitled placeholder.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：保持会话投影值（标题）在主机生成重置后依然存活，使会话列表不再回退到「未命名」占位符。

plugins.name: dsh-side-chat
plugins.description: Temporary side conversations for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 和 Web 的临时侧边对话

plugins.name: dsh-db-connections
plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命名数据库连接——在设置页面配置 MySQL，随后在聊天中通过名称引用。默认只读，写操作需逐连接单独启用。

plugins.name: dsh-aux-degrade
plugins.description: DSH 1.5 辅助模型降级：让压缩摘要、会话标题这类旁路调用更省更完整，主循环零影响。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Auxiliary-model degradation for DSH 1.5: cheaper, complete side calls (reasoning off, token floor, tools stripped). DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.zh: DSH 1.5 辅助模型降级：让压缩摘要、会话标题这类旁路调用更省更完整，主循环零影响。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Auxiliary-model degradation for DSH 1.5: cheaper, complete side calls (reasoning off, token floor, tools stripped). DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.

plugins.name: dsh-capability-composer
plugins.description: DSH 1.5 能力组合器：按会话或工作区编排工具、技能与 MCP，按需缩小系统提示。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Capability composer for DSH 1.5: per-session tool / skill / MCP compositions that shrink the system prompt on demand. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.zh: DSH 1.5 能力组合器：按会话或工作区编排工具、技能与 MCP，按需缩小系统提示。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Capability composer for DSH 1.5: per-session tool / skill / MCP compositions that shrink the system prompt on demand. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.

plugins.name: crop-zoom
plugins.description: Makes small text in a screenshot readable before a model reads it: crop a region, magnify it with a chosen kernel, hand back a new image. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin + standalone CLI.
plugins.zh: 在模型读取截图前将小字放大以提高可读性：裁剪区域，使用指定核函数放大后返回新图像。DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件 + 独立 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-req-capture
plugins.description: Diagnostic plugin: wraps global fetch to log requests and capture bodies whose URL matches a configurable substring to disk.
plugins.zh: 诊断插件：包装全局 fetch，记录请求并捕获 URL 匹配可配置子串的主体内容到磁盘。

plugins.name: dsh-compaction-codex
plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.zh: Codex 风格的窗口交换压缩引擎：基于确定性指针模板生成摘要，零 LLM 调用，替代默认的 LLM 摘要压缩方案。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-commands
plugins.description: Smarter slash-command matching for skills: suffix, contains and alias matching (e.g. /studio finds autonomous-studio).
plugins.zh: 更智能的技能斜杠命令匹配：支持后缀、包含和别名匹配（例如 /studio 可匹配 autonomous-studio）。

plugins.name: dsh-active-sessions
plugins.description: Sidebar tab listing running and completed-unread sessions across projects, with click-to-switch and grouping.
plugins.zh: 侧边栏选项卡，列出各项目下运行中和已完成但未读的会话，支持点击切换和分组显示。

plugins.name: dsh-en2zh
plugins.description: Live English-to-Chinese translation of model output in the web UI - translation above, original kept aside - with an optional local MT engine and LLM fallback.
plugins.zh: Web UI 中模型输出的实时英译中：译文在上，原文保留在侧，可选本地机器翻译引擎与 LLM 后备方案。

plugins.name: dsh-context-budget
plugins.description: Ports the Codex CLI TokenBudget mechanism to dsh: remaining-context awareness, archive rollover, and notes/history retrieval tools for past sessions.
plugins.zh: 将 Codex CLI TokenBudget 机制移植到 dsh：具备剩余上下文感知、归档轮换，以及过去会话的笔记/历史检索工具。

plugins.name: dsh-resource-lease
plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.zh: 资源租赁治理：自动注册浏览器标签页、后台作业、进程和端口为会话拥有的租赁，支持 TTL 自动回收、固定保留和手动清理。

plugins.name: muche-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: 连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
plugins.zh: 连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务

plugins.name: dsh-guild-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges a guild expert-team board into dsh: routes guild tasks to one-shot dsh subagents, visible in the GUI.
plugins.zh: 将公会专家团队看板接入 dsh：将公会任务路由至一次性 dsh 子代理，并在 GUI 中显示。

plugins.name: dsh-mac-notify
plugins.description: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
plugins.zh: macOS 桌面通知，通过 SSH 发送给在 Mac 上运行的小型通知者 HTTP 监听器，用于 dsh 事件。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-duck
plugins.description: Web search provider that bridges an OpenAI Responses-API-compatible endpoint with the web_search_preview tool into the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 网络搜索提供者：将兼容 OpenAI Responses API 的端点与 web_search_preview 工具桥接至 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-bing
plugins.description: Keyless Bing HTML search provider plus a relay-aware fetch provider with per-hop redirect validation for the dsh web seam.
plugins.zh: 无密钥 Bing HTML 搜索提供者，以及支持逐跳重定向验证的 relay-aware 获取提供者，用于 dsh 网络接口。

plugins.name: dsh-ttft-hedge
plugins.description: Hedged requests for streaming /v1/messages LLM calls: fires a second attempt when response headers miss a deadline and races them, retries immediately on 5xx/504, passes through 4xx/429, with statistics.
plugins.zh: 针对流式 /v1/messages LLM 调用的 hedged 请求：当响应头未按时到达时触发第二次尝试并竞争返回，对 5xx/504 立即重试，透传 4xx/429，并附带统计信息。

plugins.name: dsh-stream-index-guard
plugins.description: Patches the LLM assistant-stream accumulator at runtime to clamp invalid chunk indices, downgrading hard stream failures to dropped or merged chunks; ships a stats tool.
plugins.zh: 在运行时修补 LLM 助理流累加器以钳位无效 chunk 索引，将严重的流故障降级为丢弃或合并的 chunk；附带统计工具。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-suite
plugins.description: Session hygiene suite: strips leaked thinking tags, adds retry cooldown budgets, blocks plaintext credentials before execution, runs a daily health-check loop with a health panel, and auto-tunes agent instruction hints from error statistics.
plugins.zh: 会话清理套件：清除泄露的 thinking 标签、增加重试冷却预算、在执行前拦截明文凭证、运行每日健康检查循环并配有健康面板，以及基于错误统计自动优化代理指令提示。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-watch
plugins.description: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
plugins.zh: 浮动叠加层，集中展示来自任意会话的待审批项、计划审查和用户问题，支持点击进入对应会话。

plugins.name: dsh-super-injector
plugins.description: Runtime plugin injector: inject, hot-reload and uninstall local plugin packages in a running dsh without restarts, with plugin scaffolding, self-test and a management panel.
plugins.zh: 运行时插件注入器：无需重启即可在运行的 dsh 中注入、热重载和卸载本地插件包，支持插件脚手架、自测及管理面板。

plugins.name: dsh-almazom-approve-escalate
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: one-click Approve & escalate on the approval card — approves the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：一键审批并升级 — 批准待处理请求并将实时会话切换至权限预设

plugins.name: dsh-skills-hub
plugins.description: 跨平台 AI Skills 统一管理器：以 ~/.agents/skills 为中心技能库，通过系统符号链接把同一份技能一键安装/卸载到 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI、Trae、Windsurf 等多个 Agent 工具，仅展示本机已安装的平台，统一管理本地技能目录与只读平台展示。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux。DeepSeek Harness plugin.
plugins.zh: 跨平台 AI Skills 统一管理器：以 ~/.agents/skills 为中心技能库，通过系统符号链接把同一份技能一键安装/卸载到 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI、Trae、Windsurf 等多个 Agent 工具，仅展示本机已安装的平台，统一管理本地技能目录与只读平台展示。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux。DeepSeek Harness plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-conflict-doctor
plugins.description: DSH plugin conflict governance: diagnose silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and get the exact patch that fixes each one. DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。
plugins.zh: DSH plugin conflict governance: diagnose silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and get the exact patch that fixes each one. DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。

plugins.name: dsh-cache-report
plugins.description: See what ate your prompt cache. Hit-rate & tool-block cost report for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — zero deps, registers no tools.
plugins.zh: 查看是什么消耗了你的提示词缓存。DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 命中率与工具块成本报告——零依赖，不注册任何工具。

plugins.name: dsh-git-view
plugins.description: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息
plugins.zh: dsh中查看git修改，支持编辑和git暂存、提交等操作，支持使用dsh中配置的模型生成提交信息

plugins.name: dsh-image-compare
plugins.description: Sidebar image comparer for DeepSeek Harness: browse the session workspace inside the right-column panel, open a set of images into one pageable viewer, zoom and pan each image independently, sync one view onto the whole set, and reorder them by dragging the filmstrip.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏图像对比器：在右列面板内浏览会话工作区，将一组图片打开到同一可翻页查看器，独立缩放和平移每张图像，同步其中一视图至整组，并通过拖动胶卷条重新排序

plugins.name: dsh-provider-fold
plugins.description: Collapsible provider groups and prominent provider headings for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) model selection menu.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 模型选择菜单支持折叠式提供商分组和显眼的提供商标题。

plugins.name: spa-api-extract
plugins.description: Agent Skill: extract data from JS single-page apps via curl+grep+python when WebFetch fails (timeout / obfuscated JS). Read-only, desensitized, MIT.
plugins.zh: Agent Skill：当 WebFetch 失败（超时/混淆 JS）时，通过 curl+grep+python 从 JS 单页应用提取数据。只读、脱敏，采用 MIT 许可证。

plugins.name: dsh-quota-pill
plugins.description: DSH plugin: DeepSeek account balance and per-Session spend in the composer dock
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：DeepSeek 账户余额及单会话开销显示于 Composer 停靠栏

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-qq-bot
plugins.description: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.
plugins.zh: QQ 官方机器人通道插件 for DeepSeek Harness — talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.

plugins.name: dsh-inquiry-preset
plugins.description: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）
plugins.zh: 探究模式：把一个概念变成学习者亲手操作的交互式学习任务（DSH agent preset）

plugins.name: dsh-goal-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: hold back goal auto-continuation while background subagents are still running (in-process disarm/resume guard), so a delegated turn does not burn <goal_round> injections while it waits for settlement.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：当后台子代理仍在运行时暂停目标自动继续（进程内禁用/恢复守卫），以免委托轮次在等待结算过程中消耗 <goal_round> 注入次数

plugins.name: dsh-qoder-connect
plugins.description: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.
plugins.zh: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.

plugins.name: dsh-computer-mcp
plugins.description: 通过 MCP 让 DeepSeek Harness 操作另一台电脑：文件读写、搜索、编辑、回收与可选命令执行，支持 Windows/macOS 和内网/Tailscale。
plugins.zh: 通过 MCP 让 DeepSeek Harness 操作另一台电脑：文件读写、搜索、编辑、回收与可选命令执行，支持 Windows/macOS 和内网/Tailscale。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-group
plugins.description: Selection Toolbar (dsh-selection-group) — one hover toolbar for text selected in DeepSeek Harness: annotate + quote in a single box, depending on neither upstream plugin.
plugins.zh: 选区工具栏 (dsh-selection-group) —— DeepSeek Harness 中选中文本时出现的一个悬停工具栏：在一个框内同时完成标注与引用，不依赖上游插件。

plugins.name: dsh-anysearch-fallback
plugins.description: DSH web_fetch fallback: when AnySearch extraction fails with HTTP 422, the page is fetched directly with a browser-like user agent. Zero-dependency DSH plugin.
plugins.zh: DSH web_fetch 回退方案：当 AnySearch 因 HTTP 422 提取失败时，使用类似浏览器的 User-Agent 直接抓取页面。零依赖 DSH 插件

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-paopaocat
plugins.description: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。
plugins.zh: 🐱 泡泡猫的奇幻之境主题 — 月光森林、彼岸花、流云与睡着的小猫，为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤。淡雅/蓝色双风格一键切换，内置 3 首背景音乐并支持上传自己的音乐。

plugins.name: dsh-enter-using
plugins.description: DSH Web UI plugin: answer command-approval prompts with Enter and number keys, Codex style.
plugins.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：以 Codex 风格，通过回车键和数字键响应命令审批提示

plugins.name: dsh-bonk-pet
plugins.description: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭
plugins.zh: 敲盆宠物 · DSH 悬浮小鲸鱼插件：出错掉钢管、敲铁盆、讨白饭

plugins.name: dsh-live2d-pet
plugins.description: Live2D 桌宠挂件 for DeepSeek Harness Web: 可拖动吸附/滚轮缩放/待机呼吸眨眼, 单击显示 DeepSeek 余额
plugins.zh: Live2D 桌宠挂件 for DeepSeek Harness Web: 可拖动吸附/滚轮缩放/待机呼吸眨眼, 单击显示 DeepSeek 余额

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-spend
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows what the OpenRouter account actually charged today — per chat and in total, under the composer and in Settings, split by model and API key.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示 OpenRouter 账户今天实际扣费情况——按聊天和总计，显示在作曲家和设置中，按模型和 API 密钥分类。

plugins.name: dsh-locale-tr
plugins.description: Turkish (Türkçe) language pack for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — a client plugin that registers the 'tr' UI locale.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 土耳其语（Türkçe）语言包——一个注册 'tr' UI 区域的客户端插件。

plugins.name: dsh-companion
plugins.description: Local state-aware desktop companion and task-status overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地状态感知桌面伴侣和任务状态浮层。

plugins.name: dsh-bupt-ucloud
plugins.description: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件
plugins.zh: 北邮云平台接口的dsh插件

plugins.name: dsh-issue-reporter
plugins.description: Issue reporter and diagnostic telemetry tool for DeepSeek Harness with AI optimization, issue watcher, and one-click updater
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的问题报告与诊断遥测工具，支持 AI 优化、问题监控和一键更新

plugins.name: @goodandready/dsh-usage-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a malformed token-usage sample from taking a whole session history down with it: a missing or non-numeric counter becomes zero before the harness adds it up, so the fold never yields NaN and already-broken sessions open again.
plugins.zh: 防止格式错误的 token 用量样本拖垮整个会话历史：缺失或非数字的计数器在汇总前会被归零，从而避免折叠产生 NaN，已损坏的会话得以重新打开。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 左侧栏的模型 Token 用量统计插件：跨会话汇总累计用量、连续使用天数、年度活动热力图、每日分模型趋势与模型占比

plugins.name: dsh-handoff
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存 / 加载开发交接文档（/handoff save | load，含确定性脱敏与 Git 状态捕获）

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-community
plugins.description: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件社区的讨论与反馈入口：插件展示 / 求助 / 想法与需求 / 已知问题。本仓库不含任何可执行代码（见 SECURITY.md）。 / Discussion and feedback hub for the DSH plugin community. Contains no executable code.

plugins.name: dsh-minimax-tts
plugins.description: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：用 MiniMax（海螺）TTS 朗读对话流里的 assistant 消息（手动播放 + 灵动模式）

plugins.name: dsh-daily-chat-config
plugins.description: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件
plugins.zh: 在 DSH「插件」页里编辑 daily agent preset 的子条目列表（persona 与工具组合）——内存挂载，不写任何文件

plugins.name: dsh-sci-viz
plugins.description: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。
plugins.zh: DSH 科研可视化工作台：蛋白质三维结构 + 统计图表 + 基因组学绘图，直接画在对话旁边。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-bridge
plugins.description: Codex architect and read-only reviewer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. ChatGPT sign-in, model selection, explicit file approval and checkpoints. Preview.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的 Codex 架构师与只读审查器。支持 ChatGPT 登录、模型选择、显式文件审批及检查点。预览版。

plugins.name: dsh-pinpu
plugins.description: Audio-reactive turn rail for DeepSeek Harness: the transcript's own turn marks dance to whatever the system is playing (WASAPI loopback), with hover-only highlighting and a left/right rail option.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的音频反应式对话轨道：转录本的对话标记随系统播放内容（WASAPI 回环）而动，悬停高亮，支持左右轨道选项。

plugins.name: dsh-codebase-memory
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connects the codebase-memory-mcp code graph, nudges the model at the decision point, corrects failed MCP calls, and indexes repositories by itself.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：连接 codebase-memory-mcp 代码图，在决策点提示模型，纠正失败的 MCP 调用，并自动索引代码仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-eraser
plugins.description: DSH 插件：删除对话轮次，并在轮尾显示「第 N 轮」编号。删除只是把内容从「模型可见上下文」里遮蔽（墓碑），原始会话日志一个字节不改，随时可按需读回。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：删除对话轮次，并在轮尾显示「第 N 轮」编号。删除只是把内容从「模型可见上下文」里遮蔽（墓碑），原始会话日志一个字节不改，随时可按需读回。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-status-bar
plugins.description: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar
plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：在输入框上方维护一条状态条（比输入卡片略窄、居中、与卡片上沿贴合），向其它客户端插件提供 inputStatusBar

plugins.name: dsh-remote-gui
plugins.description: Embed a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, list the remote sessions, and switch between the local instance and any remote host. Standalone implementation using the DSH 0.2.x credential-cookie and typert RPC contract.
plugins.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道将远程 DeepSeek Harness GUI 嵌入本地 DSH 窗口，列出远程会话，并在本地实例与任意远程主机间切换。基于 DSH 0.2.x 凭据 Cookie 与 typert RPC 契约的独立实现。

plugins.name: dsh-linux-desktop-entry
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: install, repair or remove the Linux desktop entrance for the Web GUI from inside the harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从 harness 内部安装、修复或移除 Web GUI 的 Linux 桌面入口。

plugins.name: dsh-github-sync
plugins.description: GitHub repository sync plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): bidirectional git sync with pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring, repo add/remove/rename, local file browsing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 GitHub 仓库同步插件：双向 git 同步，含预推送检查、Actions/CI 监控，支持仓库添加/移除/重命名和本地文件浏览。

plugins.name: dsh-session-mover
plugins.description: DSH plugin: move sessions between workspaces safely — frame-level zstd header rewrite, byte-level verification, full-directory backup, live membership update
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：安全地在工作区之间迁移会话——基于帧级的 zstd 头部重写、字节级校验、全目录备份及实时成员更新

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: Delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation for real: a Session sidebar action that removes the stored log, its projection cache and its subagent logs.
plugins.zh: 彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：通过 Session 侧边栏操作移除存储的日志、投影缓存及其子代理日志。

plugins.name: dsh-desk-card
plugins.description: Bottom-right native Windows cards for DeepSeek Harness: approve a permission request, know a question is waiting, and get a summary when a turn finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右下角原生 Windows 卡片：批准权限请求、提示有待回答问题，并在回合结束时提供摘要

plugins.name: dsh-skin-live
plugins.description: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web
plugins.zh: DSH Web 全局皮肤插件：图片/视频背景铺满界面，面板半透明可调 | Global image/video background skin for DSH Web

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-memory-lite
plugins.description: 给 DSH 的本地优先跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀 + 空闲自动整理 + 按需注入。数据全在本地 SQLite，不联网不上传。
plugins.zh: 给 DSH 的本地优先跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀 + 空闲自动整理 + 按需注入。数据全在本地 SQLite，不联网不上传。

plugins.name: dsh-ocg-used
plugins.description: A plugin that displays OCG usage in real time in the DSH input box.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 输入框实时显示 OCG 使用情况的插件。

plugins.name: dsh-pelican-router
plugins.description: Pelican Cycling: a DeepSeek Harness plugin using genuine AI classification, local Pelican PRO inference, and transparent UI-only workflow status.
plugins.zh: Pelican Cycling：一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，采用真实 AI 分类、本地 Pelican PRO 推理及透明的 UI 工作流状态。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-hub
plugins.description: DSH plugin: run several agents on different models at once, with a shared real-time progress board.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：同时在多个模型上运行多个智能体，并共享实时进度看板

plugins.name: dsh-feishu
plugins.description: Deep Feishu / Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness: Bitable (multidimensional tables), docs, sheets, wiki, drive, messages, plus a visual settings page.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Deep 飞书 / Lark 集成：支持多维表格 (Bitable)、文档、表格、Wiki、云盘、消息，以及可视化设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-grok-stars
plugins.description: Adds starfield to the new-chat background, like in grok.com
plugins.zh: 在新建聊天背景中增添星战风格星空，效果类似 grok.com

plugins.name: dsh-babel
plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。
plugins.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接使用其他 AI 编码工具生态里的 MCP 服务器与插件——读已有配置而非要求作者重新移植，并明确报告哪些能跑、哪些缺密钥、哪些跑不了。

plugins.name: dsh-drag
plugins.description: Drag a conversation row from the DSH web sidebar onto the chat area to insert it into the composer draft as a session-reference chip.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH Web 侧边栏中的对话行拖拽至聊天区域，即可将其作为会话引用芯片插入到撰写器草稿中。

plugins.name: dsh-git-commit-agent
plugins.description: DSH plugin: a dedicated agent that plans exact Git commits from real repo state, binds approval to an immutable plan revision, and commits via a restricted, verified git executor.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：专用代理根据真实仓库状态规划精确 Git 提交，将审批绑定到不可变计划版本，并通过受限验证 git 执行器完成提交。

plugins.name: dsh-webdav-sync
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并可从 WebDAV 恢复（会话+环境双源同步、rev/generation 版本机制、三方比较与冲突策略）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并可从 WebDAV 恢复（会话+环境双源同步、rev/generation 版本机制、三方比较与冲突策略）

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-hosts
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。

plugins.name: dsh-think-chinese
plugins.description: DSH plugin: force the model thinking chain (reasoning) to always be written in Chinese
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：强制模型思考链（推理过程）始终使用中文输出

plugins.name: dsh-host-paths
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Desktop: dropped files and folders become @path references instead of uploads, by wiring the shell file-path bridge into the composer host-path seam.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop：拖入的文件和文件夹变为 @path 引用而非上传，通过将 shell 文件路径桥接至编辑器主机路径接缝实现。

plugins.name: dsh-token-ledger
plugins.description: Cross-project token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: totals every project's provider-billed token usage
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨项目代币账本：汇总每个项目的供应商计费代币用量。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-enter
plugins.description: Focus the DeepSeek Harness approval panel automatically, so Enter approves and Esc rejects without reaching for the mouse.
plugins.zh: 自动聚焦 DeepSeek Harness 审批面板，使 Enter 批准和 Esc 拒绝无需鼠标操作。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-review
plugins.description: Codex-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness. An independent reviewer decides allow/deny, fail-closed, with a rationale for every decision. Engine: an LLM route, or TypeSafe's Jev (`reviewer.engine`). · DSH 插件：独立复核器裁决，引擎可选 LLM 路由或 Jev。

plugins.zh: DSH 会话费用账单：账号余额 + 峰谷计价 + 每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框下方读数与右侧栏面板双入口。 DeepSeek Harness session cost breakdown: balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and how each session's spend is composed.

plugins.name: deepseek-preset-github-plugin-security-review
plugins.description: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 插件静态安全审查预设，该项目代码由ai生成，主要框架由我搭建，通过“侦察员+审计员”双 Agent 协作、通过实验性ai自测攻防。主要功能有防死机上下文裁剪，有效防御投毒与提示词注入。包含21条安全红线、依赖树连坐排查与自动 YAML 校验，这是一名20岁非科班大学生的AI安全探索，欢迎大佬指导。本项目不能代替人工审计。请勿在生产环境或敏感凭证环境中使用。
plugins.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 插件静态安全审查预设，该项目代码由ai生成，主要框架由我搭建，通过“侦察员+审计员”双 Agent 协作、通过实验性ai自测攻防。主要功能有防死机上下文裁剪，有效防御投毒与提示词注入。包含21条安全红线、依赖树连坐排查与自动 YAML 校验，这是一名20岁非科班大学生的AI安全探索，欢迎大佬指导。本项目不能代替人工审计。请勿在生产环境或敏感凭证环境中使用。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 归档会话页面：支持按行或批量删除，一次性清除会话日志、投影缓存和归档索引，内置 30 天回收站、子代理感知拒绝机制，并显示每行磁盘占用。

plugins.name: dsh-float-lamp

plugins.name: dsh-win-native
plugins.description: DSH plugin: Windows correctness layer — GBK/GB18030/UTF-16/Big5/Shift-JIS encoding detection with confidence and lossy reporting, Windows path legality (reserved device names, 8.3, UNC, MAX_PATH), netstat interpretation and bounded read-only disk inspecti
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Windows 正确性层——GBK/GB18030/UTF-16/Big5/Shift-JIS 编码检测（含置信度与无损报告）、Windows 路径合法性检查（保留设备名、8.3 格式、UNC、MAX_PATH）、netstat 解读及有界只读磁盘检测。

plugins.name: dsh-toolbox-bundle
plugins.description: One command installs four deterministic DeepSeek Harness plugins: 46 offline, bounded tools for JSON/YAML/CSV/encoding chores plus JVM, Python and Windows production diagnostics.
plugins.zh: 一条命令安装四个确定性 DeepSeek Harness 插件：46 个离线边界工具，用于 JSON/YAML/CSV/编码任务以及 JVM、Python 和 Windows 生产环境诊断。

plugins.name: dsh-py-doctor
plugins.description: DSH plugin: deterministic, offline Python/Django production-report diagnostics — traceback root cause, pytest summaries, unapplied migrations, N+1 SQL, manage.py check --deploy and Celery backlog. Does not execute Python, start subprocesses or touch the n
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：确定性离线 Python/Django 生产报告诊断——回溯根因、pytest 摘要、未应用迁移、N+1 SQL、manage.py check --deploy 及 Celery 积压。不执行 Python，不启动子进程，不触碰文件系统。

plugins.name: dsh-jvm-doctor
plugins.description: DSH plugin: offline JVM production-report diagnostics — thread dumps with Java-level deadlock cycles, GC-log pause percentiles, Maven/Gradle dependency conflicts, exception chains and Spring config diffs. Never touches a running process: no jcmd, no jstac
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：离线 JVM 生产报告诊断——含 Java 级死锁周期的线程转储、GC 日志暂停百分位数、Maven/Gradle 依赖冲突、异常链及 Spring 配置差异。绝不触碰运行中进程：无需 jcmd、jstack。

plugins.name: dsh-deterministic-tools
plugins.description: DSH plugin: 29 deterministic, offline tools for JSON validation with exact line/column, JSONPath queries, YAML/CSV conversion, text diff, regex capture, encodings, hashes, Unicode, CIDR, JWT structure and timestamps. Every call returns a { result, meta }
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：29 款确定性离线工具，用于 JSON 验证（精确行列号）、JSONPath 查询、YAML/CSV 转换、文本对比、正则捕获、编码、哈希、Unicode、CIDR、JWT 结构解析与时戳处理。每次调用均返回 { result, meta } 对象。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-community
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Codex 社区接入 / Community Codex integration for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Codex 社区接入 / Community Codex integration for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-liuyao
plugins.description: 六爻
plugins.zh: 六爻

plugins.name: dsh-session-todos
plugins.description: 会话内待办事项：DSH 悬浮待办面板 + 服务器端跨端存储 + 会话列表未完成图标
plugins.zh: 会话内待办事项：DSH 悬浮待办面板 + 服务器端跨端存储 + 会话列表未完成图标

plugins.name: dsh-skill-toggles
plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable/disable skills by group (skill toggles manager)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：按组启用/禁用技能（技能切换管理器）

plugins.name: dsh-openjev-browser
plugins.description: Native DSH (cordis) plugin port of the openjev-browser MCP stdio tool: model-driven browser control with a tiny context footprint. A local OpenJev decision model reads the page and returns only the one element that matters, so the agent never ingests the DOM.
plugins.zh: 开源jev-browser MCP stdio 工具的 DSH (cordis) 原生插件移植版：模型驱动的浏览器控制，上下文占用极小。本地 OpenJev 决策模型读取页面并仅返回关键元素，避免智能体解析整个 DOM。

plugins.name: dsh-evolution
plugins.description: Local-first self-evolution plugin for DSH: records your coding-agent sessions to a local ledger, reviews them across sessions with the model you already configured, and turns repeated pitfalls into local knowledge. Zero uploads by default. 本地优先的 DSH 自动进化插件：会话账本 + 跨会话复盘，默认不联网、不上传。
plugins.zh: Local-first self-evolution plugin for DSH: records your coding-agent sessions to a local ledger, reviews them across sessions with the model you already configured, and turns repeated pitfalls into local knowledge. Zero uploads by default. 本地优先的 DSH 自动进化插件：会话账本 + 跨会话复盘，默认不联网、不上传。

plugins.name: dsh-ark-image
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：文生图 / 图片生成，基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）。零依赖，纯 JavaScript，无需构建。 | DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, plain JavaScript, no build step.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：文生图 / 图片生成，基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）。零依赖，纯 JavaScript，无需构建。 | DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, plain JavaScript, no build step.

plugins.name: codex-dsh-bridge
plugins.description: HTTP MCP bridge for Codex to create and continue visible sessions in DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.zh: 为 Codex 创建的 HTTP MCP 桥接器，可在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中创建和继续可见会话

plugins.name: dsh-collab-dev
plugins.description: DSH native collaboration: main-agent architecture and validated plans, parallel workers, verification and independent review.
plugins.zh: DSH 原生协作：主智能体架构与验证计划、并行工作节点、验证及独立审查。

plugins.name: output-overview
plugins.description: DSH 产出总览插件：统计 DSH 生成的代码行数、文档数、采纳率与成本，Web 面板展示。Output statistics for DeepSeek Harness: generated code lines, docs, adoption rates, and cost.
plugins.zh: DSH 产出总览插件：统计 DSH 生成的代码行数、文档数、采纳率与成本，Web 面板展示。Output statistics for DeepSeek Harness: generated code lines, docs, adoption rates, and cost.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-git-status
plugins.description: DSH plugin: current workspace Git status in the Web GUI composer tool row (branch, change counts, expandable file list, auto-refresh) plus a git_status agent tool.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：Web GUI Composer 工具栏显示当前工作区的 Git 状态（分支、变更数量、可展开文件列表，自动刷新），并提供 git_status 代理工具。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-session-cost-pill
plugins.description: 💸 Live session spend in the DeepSeek Harness composer dock — per-request peak/off-peak pricing, zero harness patches.
plugins.zh: 💸 DeepSeek Harness 作曲家工具栏中的实时会话花费——按请求区分峰谷定价，无需修补 harness。

plugins.name: dsh-apis-plugin
plugins.description: dsh-apis-plugin
plugins.zh: dsh-apis插件

plugins.name: dsh-commerce-cockpit
plugins.description: 电商经营驾驶舱 · Ecommerce Business Cockpit — DeepSeek Harness 演示插件。演示界面与数据校验层开源；客户数据映射、指标口径与诊断服务私有。
plugins.zh: 电商经营驾驶舱 · Ecommerce Business Cockpit — DeepSeek Harness 演示插件。演示界面与数据校验层开源；客户数据映射、指标口径与诊断服务私有。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-tidy
plugins.description: DSH 侧栏收纳插件：把「插件 / 自动化任务 / 上下文洞察 / 技能中心」面板图标收进侧栏底部的可折叠入口，让新会话在最上、工作区居中。
plugins.zh: DSH 侧栏收纳插件：把「插件 / 自动化任务 / 上下文洞察 / 技能中心」面板图标收进侧栏底部的可折叠入口，让新会话在最上、工作区居中。

plugins.name: dsh-tableau-twb-viewer
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin — inspect a Tableau workbook (.twb) in the browser: 1:1 SVG dashboard layout, field-level lineage graph, datasource / calculated-field metadata. Read-only metadata; .twbx refused by design.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件——在浏览器中检查 Tableau 工作簿（.twb）：1:1 SVG 仪表板布局、字段级血缘图谱、数据源/计算字段元数据。只读元数据；出于设计原因拒绝 .twbx 文件。

plugins.name: dsh-task-overlay
plugins.description: Desktop task overlay for DeepSeek Harness: goal / todo progress / pending-confirmation alerts, with an in-app switch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面任务浮层：显示目标/Todo 进度/待确认提醒，支持应用内切换。

plugins.name: dsh-files-to-chat
plugins.description: Right-click a file or folder in the DSH right sidebar file tree to add it to the conversation as an @ reference, with multi-select batch insertion.
plugins.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏文件树中右键点击文件或文件夹，以 @ 引用形式将其加入对话，支持多选批量插入。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-preset-branch
plugins.description: 从任意已完成轮次把会话分支到一个新模式：选一个 Agent 预设，就以该模式新建会话并迁移这段对话。  Branch a session into another Agent preset from any completed turn — the conversation is migrated into a new session composed in the mode you pick.
plugins.zh: 从任意已完成轮次把会话分支到一个新模式：选一个 Agent 预设，就以该模式新建会话并迁移这段对话。  Branch a session into another Agent preset from any completed turn — the conversation is migrated into a new session composed in the mode you pick.

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：在侧边栏会话菜单里加入删除会话（永久移除会话记录与完整历史，补足只能归档的限制）。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：在侧边栏会话菜单里加入删除会话（永久移除会话记录与完整历史，补足只能归档的限制）。

plugins.name: dsh-simple-background
plugins.description: 用于dsh web设置背景图，简单的设置背景图片的功能
plugins.zh: 用于dsh web设置背景图，简单的设置背景图片的功能

plugins.name: dsh-context-mode-adapter
plugins.description: context-mode 没有官方 DSH 插件——本仓库补上：11 个 ctx_* 工具进程内注册 + hook 路由拦截，节省会话上下文
plugins.zh: context-mode 没有官方 DSH 插件——本仓库补上：11 个 ctx_* 工具进程内注册 + hook 路由拦截，节省会话上下文

plugins.name: dsh-agent-recycle-guard
plugins.description: DSH 删除防护插件：拦截 Agent 的 rm/del/Remove-Item 等删除命令，强制转入 Windows 回收站，fail-closed 无永久删除退路，安装即用零配置。
plugins.zh: DSH 删除防护插件：拦截 Agent 的 rm/del/Remove-Item 等删除命令，强制转入 Windows 回收站，fail-closed 无永久删除退路，安装即用零配置。

plugins.name: dsh-acceptance
plugins.description: Agent 交付验收台：任务级的凭证工作台 —— 逐条原始需求 ↔ 证据的映射，证据的版本绑定与过期。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
plugins.zh: Agent 交付验收台：任务级的凭证工作台 —— 逐条原始需求 ↔ 证据的映射，证据的版本绑定与过期。DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-continues a turn the model ended by exhausting its output-token limit, with a per-session burst cap and a minimum interval between continuations.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，自动继续由模型耗尽输出 token 而结束的回合，支持每个会话的突发上限和续接之间的最小间隔

plugins.name: dsh-chat-eraser
plugins.description: Allows for a deletion of chats under workspace. Also lets you edit the prompts that are already inputted.
plugins.zh: 支持在工作区下删除聊天记录，并可编辑已输入的提示词

plugins.name: dsh-chrome-browser
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a model-facing `chrome` tool that drives the installed Google Chrome over CDP — screenshots returned as images, DOM/text/eval, console & network diagnostics, real input events. Runs in the Host, so no per-call approval and no bash sandbox limits.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：面向模型的 `chrome` 工具，通过 CDP 控制已安装的 Google Chrome——截图以图像形式返回，支持 DOM/文本/eval、控制台与网络诊断、真实输入事件。在 Host 中运行，无需每次调用审批，也不受 bash 沙盒限制。

plugins.name: dsh-frp
plugins.description: DEPRECATED: moved to https://github.com/tingaidehua/plugin-frp
plugins.zh: 已弃用：已迁移至 https://github.com/tingaidehua/plugin-frp

plugins.name: @lone-wolf-akela/dsh-sandboxie-redirect
plugins.description: DSH bundle adding a copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box's copy while the real disk is untouched.
plugins.zh: DSH 扩展包，添加写时复制权限预设：shell 命令在基于工作区的 Sandboxie 沙箱内运行，对工作区外部的写入将落入沙箱副本，而真实磁盘不受影响。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-term-dictionary
plugins.description: 术语词典：自动识别对话中的生僻术语并建立词条，左侧插件区提供词典面板。已收录的词在回复中被划出，鼠标靠近显示简短解释，点击进入词典对应词条；选中词句可一键添加词条。
plugins.zh: 术语词典：自动识别对话中的生僻术语并建立词条，左侧插件区提供词典面板。已收录的词在回复中被划出，鼠标靠近显示简短解释，点击进入词典对应词条；选中词句可一键添加词条。

plugins.name: dsh-lessons
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：记录 AI 的愚蠢时刻与被纠正之处，沉淀成教训清单，并在后续每次对话中自动注入系统提示词，让本地模型不再重复犯同样的错。
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：记录 AI 的愚蠢时刻与被纠正之处，沉淀成教训清单，并在后续每次对话中自动注入系统提示词，让本地模型不再重复犯同样的错。

plugins.name: dsh-manage-server
plugins.description: DSH plugin: server summary, alerts, read-only security baseline
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：服务器摘要、告警与只读安全基线

plugins.name: dsh-deploy-web
plugins.description: DSH plugin: publish /app/<slug>/ and /demo/<slug>/ static or proxy sites
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：发布 /app/<slug>/ 与 /demo/<slug>/ 静态站点或代理站点

plugins.name: dsh-deploy-nginx
plugins.description: DSH plugin: nginx site base, TLS status, safe reload for ops portal
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：nginx 站点基础配置、TLS 状态与运维门户安全重载

plugins.name: dsh-terminal-panel
plugins.description: In-page terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness: real PTY terminals in the sidebar — PowerShell 7 / Windows PowerShell / cmd / Git Bash, starting in your home directory — plus a settings panel and nine switchable terminal_* tools for the agent. DSH 网页内的终端面板插件
plugins.zh: In-page terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness: real PTY terminals in the sidebar — PowerShell 7 / Windows PowerShell / cmd / Git Bash, starting in your home directory — plus a settings panel and nine switchable terminal_* tools for the agent. DSH 网页内的终端面板插件

plugins.name: dsh-free-web-search
plugins.description: DSH plugin that adds third-party free web search to DeepSeek Harness — Bing, Google, Baidu, Yandex, no API key required. Includes proxy support (HTTP/SOCKS5), a latency test that recommends the best backend, and one-click switching between the plugin and official search. Zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加第三方免费网页搜索的插件：支持 Bing、Google、百度、Yandex，无需 API 密钥。包含代理支持（HTTP/SOCKS5）、延迟测试以推荐最佳后端，以及一键切换插件与官方搜索。零依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-auto
plugins.description: DSH 宿主插件:注册 auto 模型,按有序回退链在多条 provider+model 间静默切换 (DeepSeek Harness)
plugins.zh: DSH 宿主插件:注册 auto 模型,按有序回退链在多条 provider+model 间静默切换 (DeepSeek Harness)

plugins.name: dsh-folder-drop
plugins.description: DSH Desktop 插件：把文件夹拖进 composer，得到它的原生绝对路径（DSH 原生只收文件）
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop 插件：把文件夹拖进 composer，得到它的原生绝对路径（DSH 原生只收文件）

plugins.name: dsh-reasoning-slider
plugins.description: DSH Web plugin: replace the composer reasoning-effort picker with an inline slider card.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：用内联滑块卡片替换 composer 中的推理开销选择器。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-ui-reasoning-effort
plugins.description: DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在模型设置页面为自定义 pi-ai 提供商配置每模型的推理力度级别，并提供 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 模型的预设。

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete-ui
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session row menu, with a themed confirmation dialog and a running-work guard.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：在侧边栏会话行菜单中添加永久性的删除会话操作，附带主题化确认对话框和运行中工作保护。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-oss-backup
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把工作区文件备份到 S3 兼容对象存储（RustFS / 阿里云 OSS / AWS S3）。AK/SK 只从环境变量读取，绝不落盘、绝不进日志。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把工作区文件备份到 S3 兼容对象存储（RustFS / 阿里云 OSS / AWS S3）。AK/SK 只从环境变量读取，绝不落盘、绝不进日志。

plugins.name: dsh-session-inherit
plugins.description: Inherit a long DeepSeek Harness session into a clean one: adds an "Inherit" row to the session "..." menu, mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent tool failures, commands, todos) from the source session log
plugins.zh: 将长 DeepSeek Harness 会话继承到干净会话：在会话的“...”菜单中添加“继承”行，从源会话日志中机械提取具体锚点（任务、最近指令、编辑的文件、最近工具失败、命令、待办事项）

plugins.name: dsh-webp-relabel
plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 的标准化 WebP 请求图片重新标记为 image/png，以便本地 OpenAI 兼容视觉服务器（LM Studio、llama.cpp）能够接受。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-trace
plugins.description: 持续监听并记录本地 Harness 调用 LLM 的全过程：完整提示词（用户输入 + DSH/插件注入）、技能加载、工具调用与命令执行、本地文件读写、联网搜索抓取。按「轮次 → 步骤」依时间汇总为高可读 Markdown，落在会话对应工作区内，序号加时间命名。内置审阅页与可调配置。
plugins.zh: 持续监听并记录本地 Harness 调用 LLM 的全过程：完整提示词（用户输入 + DSH/插件注入）、技能加载、工具调用与命令执行、本地文件读写、联网搜索抓取。按「轮次 → 步骤」依时间汇总为高可读 Markdown，落在会话对应工作区内，序号加时间命名。内置审阅页与可调配置。

plugins.name: dsh-kimi-shell
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web UI plugin: turn the dsh-web-mobile session drawer into a kimi-style bottom sheet 把左侧会话抽屉变成 kimi 风格底部浮层
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web UI plugin: turn the dsh-web-mobile session drawer into a kimi-style bottom sheet 把左侧会话抽屉变成 kimi 风格底部浮层

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-tavily
plugins.description: Tavily web search for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): wires the Tavily remote MCP server into the harness as a plugin bundle
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Tavily 网页搜索：将 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务器作为插件包接入 harness。

plugins.name: @deepcodec/dsh-clock
plugins.description: DSH Web clock: shows the current date & time in the bottom status bar (composer dock), with user-configurable format.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 时钟：在底部状态栏（Composer 停靠栏）中显示当前日期和时间，支持用户自定义格式

plugins.name: dsh-memory-eternal-fork
plugins.description: Maintained fork of EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal: local Markdown memory vault for DeepSeek Harness, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. MIT.
plugins.zh: EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal 的维护分支：DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Markdown 记忆库，含 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 兼容性修复。MIT 协议。

plugins.name: dsh-rich-tracking

plugins.name: dsh-chat-window-fold
plugins.description: DSH web GUI plugin: auto fold/expand the chat window — bottom checkpoints hide old pages, top-scroll expands earlier messages with the viewport anchored.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：自动折叠/展开聊天窗口——底部检查点隐藏旧页面，向上滚动可展开早期消息，视口固定。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-switch
plugins.description: Per-session skill switch for DeepSeek Harness: see which skills a session loads, toggle them off, and keep a pure-chat session free of skill overhead. Also mounts whole skill families in and out of the host's skill hub.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话切换技能功能：查看当前会话加载了哪些技能，可随时关闭，并保持纯聊天会话无技能开销。也支持将整套技能家族挂载或卸载到宿主机技能中心。

plugins.name: dsh-job-progress
plugins.description: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable floating ball with a per-session task panel showing done/total, speed and ETA.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中长期运行的后台任务实时进度显示：可拖动的浮动球，附带每个会话的任务面板，显示已完成/总数、速度和预计剩余时间。

plugins.name: dsh-status-chime
plugins.description: Spoken status alerts for DeepSeek Harness where clip LENGTH encodes urgency: a 2s approval chime vs an 8s failure announcement. Eight scenes, no third-party dependencies on Windows 10/11. Re-verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. · DSH 语音状态提示：时长编码紧急度，已在官方 0.2.0-rc.2 上复核。
plugins.zh: Spoken status alerts for DeepSeek Harness where clip LENGTH encodes urgency: a 2s approval chime vs an 8s failure announcement. Eight scenes, no third-party dependencies on Windows 10/11. Re-verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. · DSH 语音状态提示：时长编码紧急度，已在官方 0.2.0-rc.2 上复核。

plugins.name: dsh-aurora-effort-slider

plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 模型座位的「推理等级」换成一条可直接拖动的星河滑轨：极光填充、粒子曲速、MAX 蓄能光环 / A draggable aurora starfield slider for the DSH reasoning-effort row

plugins.name: dsh-veripipe
plugins.description: dsh plugin: per-turn receipts (todo counts, goal id, fail-closed plan verdict) that survive the next turn, plus a read-only veripipe_receipt tool.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-session-delete

plugins.zh: DSH 插件，从磁盘删除对话——这是 DSH 故意省略的破坏性会话操作——同时提供空会话批量清理功能。适用于 DSH 0.2.x。

plugins.name: dsh-news-plugin

plugins.name: dsh-colors
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness theme plugin: 22 light-only palettes (Pantone / Chinese traditional / Morandi) and 14 composable surface effects, plus twelve-shichen clock rotation, workspace colour binding, per-session colour marks and a nickname/avatar row.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：22 种纯亮色配色方案（Pantone / 中国传统色 / 莫兰迪色系）及 14 种可组合的面层特效；含十二时辰时钟旋转动效、工作区色彩绑定、按会话的色彩标记，以及昵称/头像行。

plugins.name: dsh-model-control
plugins.description: Unified model control for DeepSeek Harness: model picker + model management (channels, per-model capabilities) + reasoning-effort advisory, in one seat and one settings page.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一模型控制中心：集成模型选择器、模型管理（渠道与各模型能力）及推理力度建议，集中于一处设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-google

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Google Calendar 与 Google Tasks 插件——30 个工具，支持自然语言调度，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-agentic-proxy
plugins.description: Per-command proxy for DeepSeek Harness: the agent decides which shell commands leave through a proxy, backed by a kernel the plugin installs and supervises itself.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命令级代理插件：智能体决定哪些 Shell 命令通过代理出口，插件安装并自行监督底层内核。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-badge

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在扁平（按时间倒序）侧边栏列表的每个会话行上显示工作区徽章

plugins.name: dsh-link

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端 H5 桥接插件：手机浏览器经内网 / Tailscale 用连接密钥接入桌面版正在运行的会话（流式回复、Markdown、工具卡、图片上传）。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的懒加载 MCP 工具：每个多工具 MCP 服务器对应一个加载器工具，支持按智能体屏蔽工具、描述预设

plugins.zh: 将 Trae CN 桌面应用模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：解密本地登录，通过回环 OpenAI 兼容接口转换远程会话协议，并注册 Trae 模型组。

plugins.name: dsh-git-branch
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在对话框工具行、权限选择框右侧只读显示当前项目的 git 分支；目录不是仓库时不显示。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在对话框工具行、权限选择框右侧只读显示当前项目的 git 分支；目录不是仓库时不显示。

plugins.name: dsh-taskflow

plugins.name: image-gen-mcp
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and Codex plugin: configurable, provider-agnostic image generation over MCP, plus a bundled image-generation skill. Exposes mcp__image_generation__image_generate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 Codex 插件：基于 MCP 的可配置、厂商无关的图像生成，附带捆绑的图像生成技能。暴露 mcp__image_generation__image_generate。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件及 MCP 服务器：通过兼容 StepFun 的 /images/generations 端点实现文生图，支持可配置的 base URL、密钥和模型。暴露 mcp__simple_image__simple_image。

plugins.name: opencode-eyes
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin and OpenCode MCP server: describe an image with StepFun step-3.7-flash, so a text-only model can see. Exposes mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image.

plugins.name: simple-plan

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：simple-plan 技能——规划 2-7 个步骤，通过 worker 子智能体执行，由无状态验证器验证每一项交付物，最多三个循环完成修复。保留 Codex 原版。

plugins.name: math-rigor
plugins.description: Auditable mathematical proving for DeepSeek Harness: a local stdio MCP server (23 tools), a bundled workflow skill, and the /prove and /audit-proof commands. proven / refuted / inconclusive are never conflated, and unproven steps are reported, not hidden.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可审计数学证明：一个本地 stdio MCP 服务器（23 个工具）、捆绑的工作流技能，以及 /prove 和 /audit-proof 命令。证明/反驳/不确定三种状态严格区分，未证明的步骤会被报告而非隐藏。

plugins.zh: 基于标准编码 Agent 的渐进式开发助手。ask/plan/build 三模式由宿主权限预设强制（ask/plan→只读、build→可写工作区），可 Alt+M 或 /apb 切换并随会话持久；遵循先讨论定方向、入口与文件规划、todo 占位、逐模块实现调试、走通后再分步重构的人类式小步开发纪律。

plugins.zh: One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness - disabled providers leave the model picker. DSH 模型提供商一键开关：在「设置 → 模型」每行「编辑」左侧放一个开关，关掉即从模型选择栏消失。

plugins.name: dsh-ofm-model-manager
plugins.description: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness — disabled models leave the model picker, custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences live in the profile and apply immediately.
plugins.zh: 对 DeepSeek Harness 中所有提供商的每模型启用/禁用与重命名——禁用模型从选择器中移除，自定义名称替换内置名称。偏好设置在配置文件中，立即生效。

plugins.name: dsh-local-host-guard
plugins.description: DSH 宿主内哨兵：同步调用打点 + 主线程卡死取证 + 内存三闸（写闸 / 冷回填闸 / 闲置会话下放）+ 队列哨兵。零依赖，全中文。
plugins.zh: DSH 宿主内哨兵：同步调用打点 + 主线程卡死取证 + 内存三闸（写闸 / 冷回填闸 / 闲置会话下放）+ 队列哨兵。零依赖，全中文。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-whale-girl
plugins.description: 修改应用内的图标，并调整尺寸大小。
plugins.zh: 修改应用内的图标，并调整尺寸大小。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-modelwatch
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) OpenRouter 模型监控插件：新上模型 / 热门周榜 / 变化流水。全程只读 GET，不推外部通知。
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) OpenRouter 模型监控插件：新上模型 / 热门周榜 / 变化流水。全程只读 GET，不推外部通知。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-model-director
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: smart subagent model assignment - model profiles (intelligence/speed/tags), tag-first matching, load balancing
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：智能子代理模型分配 —— 模型配置（智能/速度/标签），优先标签匹配，负载均衡

plugins.name: dsh-annotator
plugins.description: 对DSH的交付物进行标注的插件，人工标注后，DSH会根据标注执行
plugins.zh: 对DSH的交付物进行标注的插件，人工标注后，DSH会根据标注执行

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pdf-text
plugins.description: Read text out of local PDF files inside DeepSeek Harness: page-by-page text, page statistics, scanned-PDF detection, no Python, no network.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内读取本地 PDF 文件中的文本：逐页提取文本、页面统计、扫描型 PDF 检测，无需 Python，无需网络。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-dashboard
plugins.description: Read-only wall dashboard for DeepSeek Harness sessions across several machines: pull or push, one hub, tablet page that fits the screen.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨机器会话的只读墙面仪表盘：拉取或推送，一个中心枢纽，适配屏幕的平板页面

plugins.name: dsh-boot-anim
plugins.description: DSH 桌面版启动动画（SteamOS 风格七段分镜）+ UI 由外向内分层入场过渡。宿主侧插件，经 webserver/index-inject 注入，零依赖、零源码改动。
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面版启动动画（SteamOS 风格七段分镜）+ UI 由外向内分层入场过渡。宿主侧插件，经 webserver/index-inject 注入，零依赖、零源码改动。

plugins.name: dsh-emil-skills
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skills — motion, UI polish, Apple design, mobile-native, Swift — bundled as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
plugins.zh: Emil Kowalski 的设计工程技能——动态效果、UI 打磨、Apple 设计风格、移动端原生、Swift——封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-account-switch
plugins.description: DSH 多账号插件：热切换、额度耗尽自动换号并原地重跑。官方新用户首登送 6 元额度，接码 0.2-0.3 元/号，账号池就是连续可用的额度池。
plugins.zh: DSH 多账号插件：热切换、额度耗尽自动换号并原地重跑。官方新用户首登送 6 元额度，接码 0.2-0.3 元/号，账号池就是连续可用的额度池。

plugins.name: dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: drop sandbox_permissions/justification fields that cannot widen the current sandbox mode, so redundant escalations (common with GPT models) no longer fail with "not strictly wider".
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：移除 sandbox_permissions/justification 字段，防止其扩大当前沙盒模式，从而避免冗余升级因“不够严格更宽”而失败（GPT 模型中常见）。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-ru
plugins.description: Local Russian speech-to-text provider for DeepSeek Harness voice input: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR 0.6B (GGUF) on transcribe.cpp. Model and native runtime download on first use, sha256-verified.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 语音输入的本地俄语语音转文本提供者：基于 transcribe.cpp 的 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR 0.6B (GGUF) 模型。首次使用时自动下载模型和原生运行时，并进行 SHA256 验证。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-usage-monitor
plugins.description: DeepSeek account balance and per-session usage cost in the Harness composer dock.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 作曲器 dock 中显示账户余额及各会话使用成本

plugins.name: @luchenglong/dsh-session-cleaner
plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 会话回收站与清理管理器：移入回收站 / 恢复 / 彻底清除、重名防误删、对话内容预览、定期自动清空、主题与 DSH 主体一致。Trash bin & session cleaner for DeepSeek Harness: move-to-trash, restore, purge, name-collision guard, conversation preview, scheduled auto-purge, DSH-native theming.
plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 会话回收站与清理管理器：移入回收站 / 恢复 / 彻底清除、重名防误删、对话内容预览、定期自动清空、主题与 DSH 主体一致。Trash bin & session cleaner for DeepSeek Harness: move-to-trash, restore, purge, name-collision guard, conversation preview, scheduled auto-purge, DSH-native theming.

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Browse installed Skills, their files, and content in Settings, then adaptively import from a file, folder, ZIP, or GitHub with AI.
plugins.zh: 在「设置」中浏览已安装的技能及其文件和内容，然后从文件、文件夹、ZIP 或 GitHub 自适应导入。

plugins.name: dsh-mermaid-diagram
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: a Mermaid diagram tool for the model, rendered as a diagram card in the Web UI.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：面向模型的 Mermaid 图表工具，在 Web UI 中渲染为图表卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness plugins: finds plugins that failed to load, rows a failed update left behind, unmanaged entries - plus a disk scan for update leftovers.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件诊断工具：查找加载失败的插件、遗留的更新失败条目、未管理的条目，并提供磁盘扫描以查找更新残留。

plugins.name: dsh-git-forge
plugins.description: DSH community plugin: GitHub/Gitea accounts, project grants, push policy (better-sidebar)
plugins.zh: DSH 社区插件：GitHub/Gitea 账号、项目授权、推送策略（better-sidebar）

plugins.name: dsh-code-intel
plugins.description: Symbol-aware code outline and hybrid code search for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的符号感知代码大纲与混合代码搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-browser
plugins.description: A browser in DSH's right sidebar: loopback-proxied pages, element picking into [DOMn] references, tabs and device preview.
plugins.zh: DSH 右侧边栏中的浏览器：loopback 代理页面、元素选取至 [DOMn] 引用、标签页及设备预览。

plugins.name: dsh-token-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Token usage page in Settings — totals, GitHub-style calendar, per-provider/model breakdowns from local session logs.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：设置中的 Token 使用页面——汇总总量、GitHub 风格日历、来自本地会话日志的各提供商/模型细分。

plugins.name: dsh-file-manager
plugins.description: a dsh plugin for file manager in current sidebar

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-session-sync
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 OpenCode 桌面端（opencode.db）的历史会话按各自原本的工作目录导入为 DSH 原生会话
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把 OpenCode 桌面端（opencode.db）的历史会话按各自原本的工作目录导入为 DSH 原生会话

plugins.name: dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
plugins.description: 飞书会话监听并投递到指定工作区的会话中
plugins.zh: 飞书会话监听并投递到指定工作区的会话中

plugins.name: dsh-rss
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）RSS 阅读器插件：分组订阅、FreshRSS 账号同步、图片本地代理、BYOK AI 摘要/翻译/问答、播客与全文抓取
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）RSS 阅读器插件：分组订阅、FreshRSS 账号同步、图片本地代理、BYOK AI 摘要/翻译/问答、播客与全文抓取

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-settings-button
plugins.description: DSH plugin: puts a Settings row in the sidebar header, immediately before Plugins, and opens the native Settings panel in one click.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前添加一行设置入口，一键打开系统原生设置面板。

plugins.name: dsh-clear-ungrouped
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one-click clear (archive) for the sidebar's Ungrouped conversations, with confirm and undo.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：一键清除（归档）侧边栏中的「未分组」对话，支持确认与撤销。

plugins.name: dsh-github
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 接入插件：设置里登录账号，agent 用它真实干活（12 个工具 + 云计算与成本护栏）。token 不经过模型上下文。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 接入插件：设置里登录账号，agent 用它真实干活（12 个工具 + 云计算与成本护栏）。token 不经过模型上下文。

plugins.name: dsh-apply-model-all
plugins.description: Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.
plugins.zh: 一键将当前会话的模型应用到所有其他会话，位于编辑器模型选择器旁。

plugins.name: dsh-screenshot
plugins.description: A deepseek harness conversation screenshot plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话截图插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-publisher
plugins.description: Publish a DSH plugin to GitHub, and develop one repository from several machines.
plugins.zh: 将 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub，并从多台机器开发同一个仓库。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-uia
plugins.description: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness through UI Automation: read a window's control tree, drive elements by id, approve every write, and watch it all in the settings panel.
plugins.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面：读取窗口控件树、通过 ID 驱动元素、审批每次写入操作，并在设置面板中查看全过程。

plugins.name: Sidor_Character
plugins.description: SIDOR 人设卡 —— DeepSeek Harness 附属插件：批量导入人设卡（.persona.md / 酒馆角色卡），自由加载/更换人设，会话内即时应用 + Agent 预设持久化。
plugins.zh: SIDOR 人设卡 —— DeepSeek Harness 附属插件：批量导入人设卡（.persona.md / 酒馆角色卡），自由加载/更换人设，会话内即时应用 + Agent 预设持久化。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-archive
plugins.description: dsh web plugin: archive finished dsh sessions idle for three weeks, once a night
plugins.zh: dsh web 插件：每晚自动归档已结束且闲置三周的 dsh 会话

plugins.name: dsh-locale-ru
plugins.description: Russian localization (ru) for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — 58 message namespaces, 3674 strings. Language pack for @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 俄语（ru）本地化——58 个消息命名空间，3674 条字符串。@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale 语言包。

plugins.name: attention-scheduler
plugins.description: 注意力调度与记忆检索规则 | DSH Skill：减轻上下文幻觉（检索触发、注入预算、写回白名单、L0/L1 成本归属），支持 dsh plugin 一键安装
plugins.zh: 注意力调度与记忆检索规则 | DSH Skill：减轻上下文幻觉（检索触发、注入预算、写回白名单、L0/L1 成本归属），支持 dsh plugin 一键安装

plugins.name: dsh-session-move
plugins.description: Manage DeepSeek Harness sessions from the Web UI: drag & drop / menu move to another folder, permanently delete, and AI-rename by summarizing the conversation. Includes agent tools.
plugins.zh: 在 Web UI 中管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话：拖拽或菜单移动至其他文件夹、永久删除，并通过总结对话 AI 重命名。包含 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-copilot-quota
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot quota indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the remaining chat, completion and AI-credit quota of the signed-in account, shown next to the composer.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中的 GitHub Copilot 配额指示器：显示已登录账号剩余的聊天、补全和 AI 积分配额，位于编辑器旁。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-google-classroom
plugins.description: Google Classroom MCP bundle for DeepSeek Harness: read-only courses, coursework, due dates, announcements, rosters and submissions as mcp__google-classroom__* tools.
plugins.zh: Google Classroom MCP 工具包，用于 DeepSeek Harness：以只读方式提供课程、作业、截止日期、公告、名册和提交内容作为 mcp__google-classroom__* 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-shot
plugins.description: Composer screenshot control for DeepSeek Harness: box-select and annotate a capture in an in-window overlay, optionally hiding the DSH window while capturing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的撰写器截图控制：在窗口内叠加层中框选并标注截图，捕获时可隐藏 DSH 窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-editor
plugins.description: DSH 插件：在「更多设置」里查看、修改并保存所有 agent 共用的全局系统提示词，保存后立即生效。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在「更多设置」里查看、修改并保存所有 agent 共用的全局系统提示词，保存后立即生效。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-sound
plugins.description: Audible alert for the DSH Web GUI the moment a prompt is waiting for you — approval panels and ask-user-question panels alike, with per-seam voices or your own uploaded audio.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 提示音告警：当提示等待你处理时（包括审批面板和 ask-user-question 面板）立即响起，支持按任务类型自定义音色或上传自己的音频。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-dxpdf
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: convert Word .docx to PDF with the dxpdf Rust/Skia engine — no Microsoft Office, no LibreOffice, no network. It repairs the schema-invalid constructs WPS Office writes and restores Word's odd/even page parity.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness插件：基于dxpdf Rust/Skia引擎将Word .docx转换为PDF——无需Microsoft Office、LibreOffice或网络。修复WPS Office写入的schema无效结构，并恢复Word奇偶页码平衡。

plugins.name: @kagurazakayashi/dsh-delete-session
plugins.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that registers a delete-session item into the official session row menu slot (sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item) and appends it below the archive item. It also registers a Plugins-page config card for choosing how
plugins.zh: 一个最小化的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在官方会话行菜单插槽（sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item）中注册删除会话项，并追加到归档项下方。同时注册插件页面配置卡以选择如何

plugins.name: @kagurazakayashi/dsh-startup-command
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
plugins.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在 Web 配置文件成功启动后运行用户定义的命令。

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-dag
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a research graph: one JSON node store drawn as a node-link graph, a filterable board, and a steering frontier in the right pane, with a knowledge_dag tool for the model.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，展示研究图谱：由 JSON 节点存储绘制的节点链接图、可筛选看板，以及右侧窗格的引导前沿，并配备供模型使用的 knowledge_dag 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-voice
plugins.description: DSH plugin for voice input
plugins.zh: DSH 语音输入插件

plugins.name: dsh-voice-input

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中的离线本地语音转文本：麦克风按钮录音，在本地使用 faster-whisper 转录，并将文字插入聊天草稿。

plugins.zh: Agent 行为守护桌宠：跨 agent 监控可疑外传（加密打包直传对象存储 / DNS 外泄线索 / 敏感密钥被读），发现即告警，明确确认后按「一次一个」终止目标 agent；事件写入只追加 guard-events.jsonl，并通过 DSH host 工具 + MCP(stdio) 供其它 agent 查询

plugins.name: dsh-user-style
plugins.description: 让 AI 记住「你喜欢怎么被对待」：可编辑的用户工作风格档案，在每次对话开始前注入系统提示词。悬浮面板 + 三层作用域（全局/工作区/仅本会话）+ 4 套内置预设 + 一键安装脚本。

plugins.name: dsh-grok-auth
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that reuses the official Grok CLI login (SuperGrok / X Premium OAuth) for an xai LLM route
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，复用官方 Grok CLI 登录（SuperGrok / X Premium OAuth）以接入 xai LLM。

plugins.zh: 用于通过原生 DSH UI 保持 SSH 代理会话驻跑的独立后端代理；无需 dsh-remote 依赖或核心代码修改。

plugins.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Minecraft rcon 插件
