plugins.name: dsh-zhipu-toolkit
plugins.description: Zhipu BigModel/GLM provider toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: dual-endpoint model catalog (Coding Plan + ordinary API), verified thinking-level mapping, live model discovery, Web settings card
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Zhipu BigModel/GLM 提供商工具包：双端点模型目录（编程计划与普通 API）、已验证的思维层级映射、实时模型发现及 Web 设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-shell-switch
plugins.description: Switch the dsh agent's command shell between PowerShell and Git Bash, from a panel in Settings or on the plugin's own row page.
plugins.zh: 从设置面板或插件自身页面切换 dsh agent 的命令 Shell（在 PowerShell 与 Git Bash 之间）。

plugins.name: dsh-ian-rules
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）个人插件：把你的项目开发规则交给 agent —— 右侧栏面板可视化维护（全局 + 按项目），并自动注入每个会话的系统提示。
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）个人插件：把你的项目开发规则交给 agent —— 右侧栏面板可视化维护（全局 + 按项目），并自动注入每个会话的系统提示。

plugins.name: dsh-one-dark-pro
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）主题插件：注册 One Dark Pro 配色，并把「外观」设置里的主题添加 One Dark Pro。
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）主题插件：注册 One Dark Pro 配色，并把「外观」设置里的主题添加 One Dark Pro。

plugins.name: dsh-lenovo-toolkit
plugins.description: Lenovo professional tools for DeepSeek Harness: battery health plus Windows device, performance, storage, Wi-Fi, app and safe-action tools.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 联想专业工具：电池健康检测及 Windows 设备、性能、存储、Wi-Fi、应用和安全操作工具。

plugins.name: dsh-safe-delete
plugins.description: DSH plugin: intercept agent rm in every bash session and move targets to the macOS Trash instead
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：拦截每次 bash 会话中的 agent rm，并将目标移至 macOS 废纸篓

plugins.name: dsh-translator
plugins.description: 在 AI 每段回复（不含思维链）旁增加翻译按钮，用 设置 → 模型 中已配置的模型翻译成所选语言，译文显示在原文下方。Translate DSH AI replies segment by segment with your configured models.
plugins.zh: 在 AI 每段回复（不含思维链）旁增加翻译按钮，用 设置 → 模型 中已配置的模型翻译成所选语言，译文显示在原文下方。Translate DSH AI replies segment by segment with your configured models.

plugins.name: dsh-spend-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件：滚动 10 分钟花费熔断（¥1 弹窗提醒 / ¥2 结束当前轮），弥补 dsh 核心没有花费上限的空白。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件：滚动 10 分钟花费熔断（¥1 弹窗提醒 / ¥2 结束当前轮），弥补 dsh 核心没有花费上限的空白。

plugins.name: dsh-generative-ideas
plugins.description: Roadmap ideation for DeepSeek Harness — generate and compare distinct roadmap options via headless agent runs, pick one, export as goal.md
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的路径规划构思——通过无头代理运行生成并对比不同的路径方案，选择其一后导出为 goal.md

plugins.name: dsh-rich-context
plugins.description: Agent instruction manager for DSH — edit and template the AGENTS.md files the harness actually reads (global + per-workspace)
plugins.zh: DSH 的代理指令管理器——编辑和模板化 harness 实际读取的 AGENTS.md 文件（全局 + 每工作区）。

plugins.name: dsh-right-click-menu
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的右键菜单插件：对着文件、对话里的文件路径、超链接右键，即可在 DSH 内预览、用默认程序打开、在资源管理器定位、复制路径或内容、另存为，以及把链接在侧边栏或系统浏览器中打开。A Codex-style right-click menu for the DSH web UI: files, chat file paths, and hyperlinks.
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的右键菜单插件：对着文件、对话里的文件路径、超链接右键，即可在 DSH 内预览、用默认程序打开、在资源管理器定位、复制路径或内容、另存为，以及把链接在侧边栏或系统浏览器中打开。A Codex-style right-click menu for the DSH web UI: files, chat file paths, and hyperlinks.

plugins.name: dsh-dynamic-bg
plugins.description: 给 DSH 铺整屏动态背景：静态图 / GIF / 视频三种都支持，配可调蒙版、模糊、不透明度与面板半透明。只改 CSS 变量、不碰哈希类名。动态背景插件（DSH plugin for dynamic wallpaper/background）
plugins.zh: 给 DSH 铺整屏动态背景：静态图 / GIF / 视频三种都支持，配可调蒙版、模糊、不透明度与面板半透明。只改 CSS 变量、不碰哈希类名。动态背景插件（DSH plugin for dynamic wallpaper/background）

plugins.name: dsh-keymouse-use
plugins.description: A project that allow dsh to control your Windows.
plugins.zh: 允许 dsh 控制你的 Windows 的项目。

plugins.name: dsh-verify-cheap
plugins.description: Ships the verify-cheap skill for DeepSeek Harness: pick the cheapest check that still yields a definite answer, poll conditions instead of sleeping, and report measured durations. Two zero-dependency Node tools included.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 verify-cheap 技能：选择仍能得出明确结论的最廉价检查方式，轮询条件而非休眠，并报告实测耗时。内置两个零依赖 Node 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-status-beacon
plugins.description: DeepSeek API availability traffic light for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的 DeepSeek API 可用状态指示灯插件

plugins.name: dsh-server-box
plugins.description: DSH ????:???????? + ???? + SFTP ????(? dsh-server-deck ??)
plugins.zh: DSH 文件管理插件：本地文件浏览 + 远程 SFTP 支持（使用 dsh-server-deck 插件）

plugins.name: dsh-project-tabs
plugins.description: DSH plugin: browser-style project tabs in the window title bar - one tab per session, running / finished / waiting-for-approval badges, drag to reorder, restored across restarts.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：窗口标题栏中的浏览器风格项目标签页——每个标签页对应一个会话，显示运行中/已完成/等待审批徽章，支持拖拽重排，重启后恢复状态。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-context-menu
plugins.description: DSH plugin: right-click menu on the left sidebar workspace rows - rename, delete workspace, open in VS Code, reveal in File Explorer, plus open in a new tab when dsh-project-tabs is installed.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：左侧边栏工作区行右键菜单——重命名、删除工作区、在 VS Code 中打开、在文件资源管理器中显示，以及安装 dsh-project-tabs 后在新标签页中打开。

plugins.name: dsh-approval-comment
plugins.description: DSH 审批流程选择拒绝时，支持填写拒绝的理由（附言），类似 Claude Code CLI 的 Tab to amend
plugins.zh: DSH 审批流程选择拒绝时，支持填写拒绝的理由（附言），类似 Claude Code CLI 的 Tab to amend

plugins.name: dsh-novel-studio
plugins.description: A dedicated novel-writing partition for DeepSeek Harness: books, characters, worldbuilding, outline, chapters, an auto-wired relationship graph, and an AI pane that reads your real setting.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专用的小说创作分区：书籍、角色、世界观、大纲、章节、自动连接的关联图谱，以及读取你真实设定的 AI 窗格。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-router
plugins.description: An automatic skill router for deepseek harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自动技能路由器。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-unified-panel
plugins.description: 能力库 (Unified MCP & Skill Hub): All-in-One MCP & Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness with feature-based row recognition and built-in OAuth 2.1 client driver.
plugins.zh: 能力库 (Unified MCP & Skill Hub): All-in-One MCP & Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness with feature-based row recognition and built-in OAuth 2.1 client driver.

plugins.name: dsh-perf-lens
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件资源开销面板：按插件归因 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘占用。A DSH plugin panel showing which plugins use the host CPU, memory and disk, attributed per plugin.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件资源开销面板：按插件归因 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘占用。A DSH plugin panel showing which plugins use the host CPU, memory and disk, attributed per plugin.

plugins.name: dsh-pilot
plugins.description: Contract-driven master/subagent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness: the master drafts a contract, cheap subagents execute, and the plugin adjudicates deterministically (acceptance exit codes, git-diff whitelist, receipt cross-check) so the master only reads a verdict.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的契约驱动主/子智能体调度：主智能体起草契约，廉价子智能体执行，插件通过确定性裁决（接受退出码、git-diff 白名单、收据交叉检查）确保主智能体仅读取裁决结果。

plugins.name: dsh-kiwix-wiki
plugins.description: Offline Wikipedia database query tools backed by the local Kiwix ZIM library
plugins.zh: 由本地 Kiwix ZIM 库支持的离线 Wikipedia 数据库查询工具。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-quota
plugins.description: 给 DSH 桌面宠物挂一条今日 token 额度气泡：轻度/中度/重度三档只用一个彩色圆点表示，没有进度条也没有百分比。A token-quota bubble for the DSH desktop pet.
plugins.zh: 给 DSH 桌面宠物挂一条今日 token 额度气泡：轻度/中度/重度三档只用一个彩色圆点表示，没有进度条也没有百分比。A token-quota bubble for the DSH desktop pet.

plugins.name: dsh-text-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: neutralize configured code-point sequences before they reach the session log
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在代码点序列到达会话日志前将其中和清除

plugins.name: dsh-mail-digest
plugins.description: 把每轮回答压成一条详略得当的摘要发到邮箱，并支持邮件回信作答或续接对话（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.zh: 把每轮回答压成一条详略得当的摘要发到邮箱，并支持邮件回信作答或续接对话（DeepSeek Harness 插件）

plugins.name: dsh-butler-memory
plugins.description: A dsh plugin that uses the butler memory mcp server to achieve better and organized memory for dsh. Long term and short term memories seperated.
plugins.zh: 一个使用 butler memory mcp 服务器的 dsh 插件，以实现 dsh 更好且有条理的记忆管理。长期记忆与短期记忆分离。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-button
plugins.description: DSH 设置 → General 一键重启按钮:重启宿主进程并自动刷新页面。One-click restart row for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (DSH 0.1.5+).
plugins.zh: DSH 设置 → General 一键重启按钮:重启宿主进程并自动刷新页面。One-click restart row for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (DSH 0.1.5+).

plugins.name: dsh-memory-guardian
plugins.description: Local-first memory governance for DeepSeek Harness: scoped recall, provenance, conflict review, and a Web dashboard.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先记忆治理：作用域回忆、来源追溯、冲突审查及 Web 仪表板。

plugins.name: MDSM
plugins.description: MDSM (Male DeepSeek Mascot) appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: chat wallpaper with opacity, blur and scrim controls, an avatar brand mark, and a Settings section.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 MDSM（Male DeepSeek Mascot）外观层：带透明度、模糊和遮罩控制的聊天壁纸、头像品牌标识，以及设置部分。

plugins.name: dsh-hitl
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve / modify / reject decision card in the DSH Web UI.
plugins.zh: DSH 工具调用的人机协同审批门控：在 DSH Web UI 中，对任意工具调用挂载「批准/修改/拒绝」决策卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-agnes
plugins.description: Agnes AI image/video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools plus a settings page.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agnes AI 图像/视频生成插件：提供 agent 工具及设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-cn-plugin-center
plugins.description: China-friendly plugin center for DeepSeek Harness with curated and verified community plugins.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的中国友好插件中心，精选并验证社区插件。

plugins.name: dsh-inline-figures
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws clean vector figures inline between the paragraphs of its reply, so answers arrive as text-figure-text instead of a wall of text.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 主机插件：模型可在回复段落间内联绘制清晰的矢量图形，使答案以「文字-图形-文字」形式呈现，而非一整段纯文本。

plugins.name: dsh-turn-model
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每个已完成回合的操作行前显示该回合实际使用的模型名（纯文本，无图标）。Show which model answered each completed turn.
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每个已完成回合的操作行前显示该回合实际使用的模型名（纯文本，无图标）。Show which model answered each completed turn.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-composer-expand
plugins.description: DSH composer plugin: an expand button that turns the input into an immersive overlay writing surface where Enter makes a newline and only the send button submits.
plugins.zh: DSH 编排器插件：提供展开按钮，将输入框变为沉浸式覆盖式写作界面，Enter 换行，仅发送按钮提交。

plugins.name: dsh-model-surplus
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: model usage, plan quota and account balance in the session header — OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) with the selected model's monthly cap, Command Code 5-hour/weekly windows with remaining credits, and DeepSeek account balance.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在会话头部显示模型用量、计划配额和账户余额——OpenCode Go 计划用量（滚动/周/月）配合所选模型的月度上限，Command Code 5小时/每周窗口及剩余积分，以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。

plugins.name: dsh-keys-setting
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: choose whether Enter / Shift+Enter / Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends the message or inserts a line break
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：选择 Enter / Shift+Enter / Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 是发送消息还是插入换行。

plugins.name: dsh-token-billing
plugins.description: 给DeepSeek Harness Web GUI用的会话token计费插件：在会话标题栏显示本次会话的实时花费，点开可以看输入 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出 / 推理的分项、按模型的账单，以及当前用的是高峰还是空闲时段价。
plugins.zh: 给DeepSeek Harness Web GUI用的会话token计费插件：在会话标题栏显示本次会话的实时花费，点开可以看输入 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出 / 推理的分项、按模型的账单，以及当前用的是高峰还是空闲时段价。

plugins.name: dsh-notemd
plugins.description: Portable NoteMD workflow bundle for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 便携式 NoteMD 工作流套件。

plugins.name: dsh-gui-last-session
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: reopen the conversation you were last in after a restart, without patching engine files
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：重启后重新打开上次对话，无需补丁引擎文件

plugins.name: dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：当请求涉及 UI/UX 时自动加载 ui-ux-pro-max 设计智能技能（内置 7 个技能包，开箱即用）
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：当请求涉及 UI/UX 时自动加载 ui-ux-pro-max 设计智能技能（内置 7 个技能包，开箱即用）

plugins.name: dsh-git-auth-plugin
plugins.description: GitHub and GitLab CLI authentication through DSH credentials or environment tokens, with workspace-local SSH deploy keys and plugin settings.
plugins.zh: 通过 DSH 凭据或环境 token 实现 GitHub 和 GitLab CLI 认证，支持工作区本地 SSH 部署密钥和插件设置。

plugins.name: dsh-pitfalls
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把工作中踩过的坑记成可检索的档案（现象 / 怎么踩进去的 / 怎么解决），下次遇到同类问题先翻历史
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把工作中踩过的坑记成可检索的档案（现象 / 怎么踩进去的 / 怎么解决），下次遇到同类问题先翻历史

plugins.name: dsh-waaagh-ork
plugins.description: WAAAGH! — a green pixel-Ork mascot plugin for DSH Web: masks the model's thinking + output as green "Waaaaaaagh!!!" (click to reveal the original), a random-length input mask, and a "Deep diving" → "Waaaaaaagh!!!" running indicator.
plugins.zh: WAAAGH! —— DeepSeek Harness Web 的绿色像素兽人吉祥物插件：将模型的思考过程与输出内容伪装为绿色 "Waaaaaaagh!!!"（点击可还原原始内容）、随机长度输入掩码，以及 "Deep diving" → "Waaaaaaagh!!!" 动态指示器。

plugins.name: dsh-consumer-audit
plugins.description: Audit a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes, and record completion claims with the evidence that supports them.
plugins.zh: 审计 DSH 配置文件中无任何功能消耗的能力项，并记录带有支撑证据的完成声明。

plugins.name: dsh-poke-todo
plugins.description: Port of jcode's auto-poke incomplete-todos feature as a Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 将 jcode 的未完成待办事项自动提醒功能移植为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-free-media

plugins.zh: DSH 免费多模态三件套：零 Key 文生图 + 零 Key 视频理解 + 免费文生视频/图生视频。三个工具 + 一份 skill，MIT。

plugins.name: dsh-TaskCompletedNotification-plugin
plugins.description: 用WorkBuddy有感，于是照做了个横幅通知
plugins.zh: 用WorkBuddy有感，于是照做了个横幅通知

plugins.name: dsh-translate-tab
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Translate entry under Plugins in the sidebar that swaps the main area for a two-pane translator with model, effort and prompt controls.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧边栏「插件」下的翻译入口，将主区域替换为带模型、力度和提示词控制的窗格翻译器。

plugins.name: dsh-roomcomm
plugins.description: Roomcomm for DeepSeek Harness: your dsh agent talks to other AI agents in shared rooms (MCP tools + skill, zero setup)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Roomcomm 插件：你的 dsh 智能体可在共享房间中与其他 AI 智能体对话（MCP 工具 + 技能，零配置）。

plugins.name: dsh-quiet
plugins.description: 让 agent 在你离开时替你盯着，只在真的需要你出手时才叫你。DeepSeek Harness 桌面端插件。
plugins.zh: 让 agent 在你离开时替你盯着，只在真的需要你出手时才叫你。DeepSeek Harness 桌面端插件。

plugins.name: dsh-no-long-sit
plugins.description: [DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x] A cat desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness whose first job is to keep you from sitting too long. The pet lives in the corner, can be dragged anywhere (position remembered), and plays a looping animation per state (idle / getting up / drinkin
plugins.zh: [DSH 0.1.7–0.2.x] DeepSeek Harness 桌面猫咪宠物，首要任务是防止久坐。宠物位于角落，可拖拽至任意位置（位置记忆），并按状态播放循环动画（空闲/起身/饮水）

plugins.name: dsh-genbox-plugin
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness tools for GenBox: image generation/editing (including inpaint, upscale, cutout) and video generation through a local GenBox server.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 面向 GenBox 的工具：通过本地 GenBox 服务器实现图像生成/编辑（包括修复、放大、抠图）与视频生成。

plugins.name: dsh-project-agent-instructions
plugins.description: Project-level AGENTS.md loader for DeepSeek Harness: injects .dsh/AGENTS.md (and custom paths) into the agent system prompt, with a settings page.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目级 AGENTS.md 加载器：将 .dsh/AGENTS.md（及自定义路径）注入 agent 系统提示词，并附带设置页面。

plugins.name: dsh-model-capability
plugins.description: DSH plugin: configure per-model vision, reasoning levels and capacity from the Models settings UI (no host source changes).
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：从模型设置 UI 配置逐模型的视觉、推理级别和能力（无需修改主机源码）。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats

plugins.name: dsh-llm-error-classify

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-work

plugins.zh: DSH 持久化知识工作 Agent 工作流、证据捕获、审查与报告工具

plugins.name: dsh-fount-reality
plugins.description: Autonomous screen attention and private background Agent loop for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自主屏幕注视及私密后台代理循环。

plugins.name: dsh-fount-memory
plugins.description: Fount-inspired memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with in-turn recall and no autonomous conversation turns
plugins.zh: 受 Fount 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆插件，支持回合内记忆检索，不启动自主对话回合

plugins.name: dsh-evidence-first-knowledge-work
plugins.description: Evidence-first knowledge work skill packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin
plugins.zh: 以证据为先的知识工作技能，打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-session-balance
plugins.description: ⚖️ Quietly to display the balance.
plugins.zh: ⚖️ 静默显示余额。

plugins.name: dshOwnerCaller
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 需要你本人回到电脑前时弹窗并出声喊你，提示音一直响到你亲手关掉。 | DSH plugin: pops a card and rings on loop until you dismiss it.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 需要你本人回到电脑前时弹窗并出声喊你，提示音一直响到你亲手关掉。 | DSH plugin: pops a card and rings on loop until you dismiss it.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-groups
plugins.description: Category tabs for the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page's Installed list, with patch plugins nested under their parent.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件页面「已安装」列表的分类标签，插件按父级嵌套显示。

plugins.name: dsh-canvas
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话铺成可缩放地图，让意图、工具动作和结果都能回溯来源。 | Map DeepSeek Harness sessions into a zoomable canvas where intents, tool actions, and outcomes trace to source.
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话铺成可缩放地图，让意图、工具动作和结果都能回溯来源。 | Map DeepSeek Harness sessions into a zoomable canvas where intents, tool actions, and outcomes trace to source.

plugins.name: dsh-markdown-composer
plugins.description: 让 DSH 的输入框支持 Markdown：草稿实时渲染预览 + 格式化工具栏 + 语法快捷键（保留官方 composer 的附件、模型、权限、斜杠命令等全部能力）
plugins.zh: 让 DSH 的输入框支持 Markdown：草稿实时渲染预览 + 格式化工具栏 + 语法快捷键（保留官方 composer 的附件、模型、权限、斜杠命令等全部能力）

plugins.name: dsh-explain-selection
plugins.description: DSH 插件：选中回答里的文本就地解释，解释不进入主对话上下文；卡片内可继续选中追问，支持拖拽、指向线与三级嵌套。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：选中回答里的文本就地解释，解释不进入主对话上下文；卡片内可继续选中追问，支持拖拽、指向线与三级嵌套。

plugins.name: dsh-donevoice
plugins.description: dsh桌面任务提醒，点击桌面提醒可快速回到dsh页面。可自定义上传的音效
plugins.zh: dsh桌面任务提醒，点击桌面提醒可快速回到dsh页面。可自定义上传的音效

plugins.name: dsh-launcher
plugins.description: Power controls (shutdown / restart) for the DSH sidebar plus a Windows tray launcher with start-at-logon.
plugins.zh: DSH 侧边栏的电源控制（关机/重启）及 Windows 托盘启动器（随系统登录启动）。

plugins.name: dsh-brief
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one tool (brief_fetch) that feeds Hacker News + new high-star GitHub entries to your agent — the agent writes your morning digest. Public APIs only, fetch-on-demand, no polling.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供一个工具 (brief_fetch)，将 Hacker News 和新晋高星 GitHub 条目喂给你的 agent —— agent 替你撰写每日早报。仅调用公共 API，按需抓取，无轮询开销。

plugins.name: dsh-git-tools
plugins.description: Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
plugins.zh: Git 工具与 /git 斜杠命令，用于 DeepSeek Harness；在 Host 进程中运行 git，即使会话终端被沙箱隔离，也能正常使用 push、pull 和 fetch。

plugins.name: dsh-tts
plugins.description: DSH plugin: text to speech with a pluggable engine - Edge read-aloud (per-word timings, no API key) or any local TTS command line. One utterance, or a multi-speaker script laid out on a verified timeline.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：支持可插拔引擎的文本转语音——可选 Edge 朗读（含逐词计时，无需 API Key）或任意本地 TTS 命令行。支持单句输出，或基于已验证时间轴的多说话人脚本。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-continue
plugins.description: Auto-continue plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): automatically resumes a turn that ended on a rate limit (429), an exhausted quota, an empty response, or your own configured error codes — with a per-session consecutive-failure limit, a one-click quick swi
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 自动续期插件：自动恢复因速率限制（429）、配额耗尽、空响应或自定义错误代码而中断的对话轮次——支持按会话设置连续失败上限，一键快速切换

plugins.name: @dennisrongo/dsh-hooks
plugins.description: Claude Code-compatible hook lifecycle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — run shell commands at PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart/End, Stop, SubagentStop and Notification, plus contextual skill hints beside the composer
plugins.zh: 与 Claude Code 兼容的 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 钩子生命周期 — 在 PreToolUse、PostToolUse、UserPromptSubmit、SessionStart/End、Stop、SubagentStop 和 Notification 阶段运行 shell 命令，并在编辑器旁提供上下文技能提示

plugins.name: dsh-likemobaxtearm-chumc
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右侧栏 SSH 控制台插件 · 安装：https://github.com/qaz320621/dsh-likemobaxtearm-chumc
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）右侧栏 SSH 控制台插件 · 安装：https://github.com/qaz320621/dsh-likemobaxtearm-chumc

plugins.name: dsh-model-deploy
plugins.description: Inspect ONNX models and benchmark them with ONNX Runtime on the local machine or over SSH, with PASS/FAIL deployment gates. DSH plugin.
plugins.zh: 检查 ONNX 模型并使用 ONNX Runtime 在本地或 SSH 远程进行基准测试，支持 PASS/FAIL 部署门禁。DSH 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-weather
plugins.description: Global weather, multi-day forecast and air quality for DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP/shell agent - Open-Meteo, no API key.
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 及任意 MCP/shell 代理提供全球天气、多日预报和空气质量数据——使用 Open-Meteo，无需 API 密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-pua
plugins.description: DSH PUA 修订版（基于 @michengai/dsh-pua v0.3.22）：解除上游全局总闸，让「入口常显」与「功能默认关闭」共存——输入栏菜单一键开关 PUA，界面紧凑化。
plugins.zh: DSH PUA 修订版（基于 @michengai/dsh-pua v0.3.22）：解除上游全局总闸，让「入口常显」与「功能默认关闭」共存——输入栏菜单一键开关 PUA，界面紧凑化。

plugins.name: dsh-sticky-notes
plugins.description: Sticky notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness — quick notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection. / 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 在 DSH 随时记录事情，支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒和密码保护。
plugins.zh: Sticky notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness — quick notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection. / 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 在 DSH 随时记录事情，支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒和密码保护。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-gateway
plugins.description: Voice Gateway client surface plugin for the DSH web client: mic status indicator, six-state machine, voiceprint enrollment, and auto-speak controls.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 客户端的语音网关客户端界面插件：麦克风状态指示器、六态状态机、声纹注册及自动语音控制。

plugins.name: dsh-warm-ui
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 暖色主题 + 液态玻璃材质 + 输入栏工具行整形（客户端插件包）
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 暖色主题 + 液态玻璃材质 + 输入栏工具行整形（客户端插件包）

plugins.name: dsh-delivery-cards
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件的独立交付卡片行：绕开 conversation.chat.turnTail 链被抢占导致的交付卡片消失；11 类文件类型图标、亮暗双主题、零依赖零构建 — DSH plugin: standalone delivery-cards row that renders presented files as cards with file-type icons, dual themes, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件的独立交付卡片行：绕开 conversation.chat.turnTail 链被抢占导致的交付卡片消失；11 类文件类型图标、亮暗双主题、零依赖零构建 — DSH plugin: standalone delivery-cards row that renders presented files as cards with file-type icons, dual themes, zero dependencies.

plugins.name: dsh-session-mindmap
plugins.description: DSH plugin: turn a session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：将会话转换为自包含的交互式 HTML 思维导图。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-reasoning-effort-sync
plugins.description: Synchronize DeepSeek Harness model reasoning-effort levels with gateway metadata and models.dev
plugins.zh: 同步 DeepSeek Harness 模型推理强度级别与网关元数据及 models.dev。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-update-entry
plugins.description: DSH 桌面版插件：在侧栏常驻一个「检查更新」入口（官方指示器只在有更新时才出现）
plugins.zh: DSH 桌面版插件：在侧栏常驻一个「检查更新」入口（官方指示器只在有更新时才出现）

plugins.name: dsh-homepage-glass
plugins.description: DSH macOS风格深蓝渐变侧边栏 + 官网流动蓝底丨DSH macOS-Style Deep Blue Gradient Sidebar + Official Website Fluid Blue Background
plugins.zh: DSH macOS风格深蓝渐变侧边栏 + 官网流动蓝底丨DSH macOS-Style Deep Blue Gradient Sidebar + Official Website Fluid Blue Background

plugins.name: crystra-dsh
plugins.description: The single dsh-crystra plugin for DeepSeek Harness: workflow execution, analysis and deterministic initialization.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的单一 dsh-crystra 插件：工作流执行、分析与确定性初始化。

plugins.name: dsh-office-plugin
plugins.description: DSH办公程序复用与精确填报插件；当前rc7，提供Windows离线安装方式。
plugins.zh: DSH办公程序复用与精确填报插件；当前rc7，提供Windows离线安装方式。

plugins.name: @jackguo0310/dsh-cost
plugins.description: Per-turn and per-session API cost estimation for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话的逐回合与逐会话 API 成本估算。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.description: Audit a DeepSeek Harness plugin repository against the dsh-plugin listing rules: dsh.bundle manifest, bundle patch rows, prerelease-safe @deepseek-ai/dsh peer ranges, shipped code, repo age, and the dsh-plugin topic.
plugins.zh: 对照 dsh-plugin 收录规则审计 DeepSeek Harness 插件仓库：检查 dsh.bundle 清单、bundle patch 行、预发布安全的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 依赖范围、交付代码、仓库年龄以及 dsh-plugin 主题标签。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-gateway
plugins.description: 把 DSH 已配置的模型共享给本机程序——无需重复配置，用 OpenAI 兼容接口直接调用
plugins.zh: 把 DSH 已配置的模型共享给本机程序——无需重复配置，用 OpenAI 兼容接口直接调用

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-brave
plugins.description: Brave Search provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — independent dsh plugin hardened against web_search hangs, missing request timeouts, and HTTP 429 rate-limit storms.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Brave Search 提供商 —— 独立 dsh 插件，增强对 web_search 挂起、请求超时缺失和 HTTP 429 限流风暴的防护。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-hub
plugins.description: DSH Skill Hub - browse and manage local Agent Skills, and browse/download skills from ClawHub, ModelScope and QwenPaw
plugins.zh: DSH 技能中心：浏览和管理本地智能体技能，并从 ClawHub、ModelScope 和 QwenPaw 浏览/下载技能。

plugins.name: billion-context-relief
plugins.description: Agent-requested context relief for DSH — companion to billion-context-dsh (ACP). context_export moves a range to a temp file and leaves a path pointer (the model never reads it); context_delete drops a range with a DELETED REFERENCES marker; context_large
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Agent 请求上下文卸载功能的插件——与 billion-context-dsh (ACP) 配套使用。context_export 将指定范围移至临时文件并留下路径指针（模型不会读取）；context_delete 删除范围并标记 DELETED REFERENCES；context_large

plugins.name: dsh-eyecare-bg
plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）换护眼绿背景的插件：覆盖 31 个背景 token（画布/卡片/侧栏/输入框/代码块…），自带设置面板并注册进 DSH 设置页。零依赖、无客户端构建、不改 app.asar。
plugins.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）换护眼绿背景的插件：覆盖 31 个背景 token（画布/卡片/侧栏/输入框/代码块…），自带设置面板并注册进 DSH 设置页。零依赖、无客户端构建、不改 app.asar。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-plugin
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 ChatGPT 账号登录，并把 ChatGPT 方案模型当成普通 provider 使用 / Sign in with ChatGPT inside DeepSeek Harness and use ChatGPT-plan models as a normal provider route
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 ChatGPT 账号登录，并把 ChatGPT 方案模型当成普通 provider 使用 / Sign in with ChatGPT inside DeepSeek Harness and use ChatGPT-plan models as a normal provider route

plugins.name: dsh-knowledge-tree
plugins.description: 一个「把散落知识捋成自己的教程」的个人知识管理系统。在与AI的对话中收集零散知识（树叶），AI 自动归类到知识树，长期积累最终形成个人独有的知识体系。
plugins.zh: 一个「把散落知识捋成自己的教程」的个人知识管理系统。在与AI的对话中收集零散知识（树叶），AI 自动归类到知识树，长期积累最终形成个人独有的知识体系。

plugins.name: dsh-hot-search
plugins.description: Resident hot search for DSH: FFF-backed fuzzy filename + indexed grep + CJK typo-tolerant content search, all in the host process (no per-query process spawn).
plugins.zh: DSH 常驻热搜：基于 FFF 的模糊文件名 + 索引 grep + 容错 CJK 内容搜索，全部在宿主进程中完成（无需每次查询都生成新进程）。

plugins.name: dsh-selection-quote
plugins.description: DSH client plugin: select text in a conversation and attach it to the composer as an atomic quote reference.
plugins.zh: DSH 客户端插件：选中对话中的文本，并将其作为原子引用附件添加到编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-usage-hud
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar HUD: account balance, gifted balance, cumulative spend and token usage.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏 HUD：账户余额、赠送余额、累计花费及 token 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-task-workspace
plugins.description: DSH task workspace convention: one folder per task, one PROGRESS.md per task (overwritten each update), and per-task git once a task runs long.
plugins.zh: DSH 任务工作区约定：每个任务一个文件夹，每个任务一个 PROGRESS.md（每次更新覆盖），任务运行时间较长时使用 per-task git。

plugins.name: dsh-meow
plugins.description: DSH web plugin: a synthesized meow sound when the harness needs confirmation, needs input, hits an error, or finishes a turn, with a Settings enable/disable toggle.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 插件：在 Harness 需要确认、等待输入、遇到错误或完成一轮时播放合成的喵叫声；可通过设置切换启用/禁用。

plugins.name: dsh-wonder-tools
plugins.description: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能 —— 删除对话 / 重新生成（从这里重来）/ 队友命令（/teammate）/ 跨会话提醒 / 首轮结束自动命名；插件页呈现为 1 张卡 + 5 行组件，每行独立开关。 | DSH toolbox (assembly bundle): one card, five independently switchable features — delete conversation, rewind from here, teammate commands, cros
plugins.zh: DSH 工具箱（装配包）：一个插件装好五个功能 —— 删除对话 / 重新生成（从这里重来）/ 队友命令（/teammate）/ 跨会话提醒 / 首轮结束自动命名；插件页呈现为 1 张卡 + 5 行组件，每行独立开关。 | DSH toolbox (assembly bundle): one card, five independently switchable features — delete conversation, rewind from here, teammate commands, cros

plugins.name: dsh-photo2dsh-by-lan
plugins.description: 手机拍照经局域网一键进 PC 文件夹，DSH 插件面板可配落地目录 | DSH plugin: one-tap photo transfer from phone to a configurable folder on this PC over the LAN, with a config card on the Plugins page.
plugins.zh: 手机拍照经局域网一键进 PC 文件夹，DSH 插件面板可配落地目录 | DSH plugin: one-tap photo transfer from phone to a configurable folder on this PC over the LAN, with a config card on the Plugins page.

plugins.name: dsh-rename-title-after-first-turn
plugins.description: 主会话跑完第一轮后自动命名一次（首轮 Q+A；子代理/队友不受影响）。本机同时关掉官方 first-prompt provider：它只给 64 token，而 pi-ai 路由关不掉思考、64 全被 reasoning 吃光。 | DSH host-only plugin: names a main session from its first Q+A. Also disables the official first-prompt provider, whose 64-token budget is consumed by reasoning on pi-ai routes.
plugins.zh: 主会话跑完第一轮后自动命名一次（首轮 Q+A；子代理/队友不受影响）。本机同时关掉官方 first-prompt provider：它只给 64 token，而 pi-ai 路由关不掉思考、64 全被 reasoning 吃光。 | DSH host-only plugin: names a main session from its first Q+A. Also disables the official first-prompt provider, whose 64-token budget is consumed by reasoning on pi-ai routes.

plugins.name: dsh-windows-session-notification
plugins.description: 跨会话「需要接手」提醒（仅 Windows）：会话完成／等待审批／向你提问、而你没在看它时，弹出可点击跳回的 Windows 通知 + 分档提示音 + 任务栏角标。 | Cross-session attention notifier for Windows — actionable toasts, tiered sounds and a taskbar badge; only for sessions you are not watching.
plugins.zh: 跨会话「需要接手」提醒（仅 Windows）：会话完成／等待审批／向你提问、而你没在看它时，弹出可点击跳回的 Windows 通知 + 分档提示音 + 任务栏角标。 | Cross-session attention notifier for Windows — actionable toasts, tiered sounds and a taskbar badge; only for sessions you are not watching.

plugins.name: dsh-sidefork-a-teammate
plugins.description: 从界面直接派生队友：/teammate 两种模式——新建队友（全新、不继承任何上下文）或 fork 队友（并行分支，继承已完成的回合）。 | Spawn a teammate from the DSH UI: /teammate in two modes — a fresh teammate that inherits nothing, or a fork teammate on a parallel branch that inherits completed turns.
plugins.zh: 从界面直接派生队友：/teammate 两种模式——新建队友（全新、不继承任何上下文）或 fork 队友（并行分支，继承已完成的回合）。 | Spawn a teammate from the DSH UI: /teammate in two modes — a fresh teammate that inherits nothing, or a fork teammate on a parallel branch that inherits completed turns.

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: 会话行菜单「删除对话」：永久删除会话（磁盘日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶记账），级联删除它派生的子代理会话，运行中一律拒绝；同菜单还能复制原始会话 ID。 | DSH session-row "Delete conversation" — permanently deletes a session, cascades into the subagent sessions it spawned, refuses live ones, and copies the raw session id.
plugins.zh: 会话行菜单「删除对话」：永久删除会话（磁盘日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶记账），级联删除它派生的子代理会话，运行中一律拒绝；同菜单还能复制原始会话 ID。 | DSH session-row "Delete conversation" — permanently deletes a session, cascades into the subagent sessions it spawned, refuses live ones, and copies the raw session id.

plugins.name: dsh-github-adapted
plugins.description: Adapted build of @perrylink/dsh-github 0.7.15 for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 — classic-script client registration (upstream #12/#13, fix PR #14)
plugins.zh: 适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的 @perrylink/dsh-github 0.7.15 构建版本——classic-script 客户端注册（上游 #12/#13，修复 PR #14）

plugins.name: dsh-retry-guard
plugins.description: Observe repeated identical tool failures and optionally pause before DSH's next model step.
plugins.zh: 监测重复出现的相同工具失败，并可选地在 DSH 执行下一步模型前暂停。

plugins.name: sage-reminder
plugins.description: 时间提醒（reminder）— DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间 / 距上次发言 / 提醒 / 倒计时。定位是会话内的短期提醒（纯 client 半，数据存浏览器本地）
plugins.zh: 时间提醒（reminder）— DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间 / 距上次发言 / 提醒 / 倒计时。定位是会话内的短期提醒（纯 client 半，数据存浏览器本地）

plugins.name: dsh-glass-skin
plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端的亚克力玻璃皮肤：半透明画布与侧栏 + 重模糊背景，右下角圆钮即控制台，明暗独立调节和上传网络图片或本地图片
plugins.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端的亚克力玻璃皮肤：半透明画布与侧栏 + 重模糊背景，右下角圆钮即控制台，明暗独立调节和上传网络图片或本地图片

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-github
plugins.description: Host-only GitHub integration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 agent tools for repositories, pull requests, issues and reviews, a write-approval gate, a deterministic PR-review CLI and a reusable composite action. The token comes from the DSH credential store; the reviewer needs no model credential.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的纯 Host 端 GitHub 集成：29 个智能体工具，覆盖仓库、Pull Request、Issue 和代码审查；含写入审批门控、确定性的 PR 审查 CLI 及可复用的组合 Action。Token 来自 DSH 凭证存储，审查者无需模型凭据

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: DSH 双引擎插件：✨ 提示词增强（草稿改写+方向选项）+ 🧭 参谋方向引擎（局势模型为核心 / 续研增量更新 / 缩进树为视图）。同名插件有 11 个，只有这一个把「把问题想清楚」当一等公民。
plugins.zh: DSH 双引擎插件：✨ 提示词增强（草稿改写+方向选项）+ 🧭 参谋方向引擎（局势模型为核心 / 续研增量更新 / 缩进树为视图）。同名插件有 11 个，只有这一个把「把问题想清楚」当一等公民。

plugins.name: dsh-imagegen
plugins.description: DSH plugin: generate images via a New API relay (tools: generate_image, list_image_models)
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：通过 New API 中继生成图像（工具：generate_image、list_image_models）。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-keyless
plugins.description: DSH 插件：给 ctx.web 换上一个不需要密钥、也不消耗模型回合的搜索 provider
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：给 ctx.web 换上一个不需要密钥、也不消耗模型回合的搜索 provider

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-approval-zh
plugins.description: DSH 权限确认窗口（审批面板）中文化插件：接管 conversation.composer 用中文重绘审批卡片，翻译授权原因与命令明细 — 本地词表优先 + model-router 兜底 | Chinese localization for the DeepSeek Harness approval panel.
plugins.zh: DSH 权限确认窗口（审批面板）中文化插件：接管 conversation.composer 用中文重绘审批卡片，翻译授权原因与命令明细 — 本地词表优先 + model-router 兜底 | Chinese localization for the DeepSeek Harness approval panel.

plugins.name: dsh-git-graph
plugins.description: Git history and working-tree diff graph for the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中的 Git 历史记录与工作区差异图谱。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-fidelity
plugins.description: High-fidelity model calls for DeepSeek Harness: auto-adapts rejected optional parameters and keeps token usage accounting faithful
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高保真模型调用：自动适配被拒绝的可选参数，并保持 token 使用统计准确

plugins.name: dsh-loop-guard
plugins.description: 多智能体监工：一个独立模型实时审阅推理文本与工具调用，检测死循环 / 空转 / 偷懒，并按 WARN / BLOCK / STOP 三档落地。DSH 宿主插件 + 浏览器设置界面。
plugins.zh: 多智能体监工：一个独立模型实时审阅推理文本与工具调用，检测死循环 / 空转 / 偷懒，并按 WARN / BLOCK / STOP 三档落地。DSH 宿主插件 + 浏览器设置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-memory-archive
plugins.description: Session memory archive + prompt viewer for DeepSeek Harness: read back what compaction folded away, inspect the prompt each turn actually sent, and (optionally) install the bundled RP preset.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Session 记忆归档与提示词查看器：可回顾压缩折叠掉的上下文，检查每一轮实际发送的提示词，并（可选）安装内置 RP 预设。

plugins.name: dsh-revise
plugins.description: Visual frontend revisions for DeepSeek Harness: point at elements, send changes, and review screenshots + code diffs.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可视化前端修订：指向元素、发送更改，并查看截图与代码差异。

plugins.name: dsh-peakvalley
plugins.description: DSH 插件：输入栏下方最右侧显示峰谷时段徽标，空闲价格为高峰一半；仅 DeepSeek 模型可见，点击可切换 7 档显示内容。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：输入栏下方最右侧显示峰谷时段徽标，空闲价格为高峰一半；仅 DeepSeek 模型可见，点击可切换 7 档显示内容。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-bridge
plugins.description: Two-way bridge between DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and a Feishu / Lark bot: stage conclusions out, messages in, work summary at the end.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 与飞书/Lark 机器人之间的双向桥接：输出结论、接收消息、生成工作摘要

plugins.name: dsh-think-budget
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：给单步思考一个字数预算，连续几步没有可见结论时强制先给结论再继续
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：给单步思考一个字数预算，连续几步没有可见结论时强制先给结论再继续

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-vietnamese
plugins.description: Vietnamese language pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with complete localization, CI verification and upstream tracking.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 越南语语言包，含完整本地化、CI 验证和上游跟踪

plugins.name: dsh-clock-context
plugins.description: Give your DSH agent a clock: injects the current date and time into the runtime context on every turn, so the agent can read the time instead of inferring it.
plugins.zh: 为 DSH 代理注入时钟：在每轮运行时上下文插入当前日期和时间，使代理能直接读取时间而非自行推断。

plugins.name: dsh-inform
plugins.description: dsh-inform 是一款为 deepseek harness开发的任务提醒插件，能够在 DSH 完成任务、需要批准 或 需要回答 时自动调用系统通知发出提醒
plugins.zh: dsh-inform 是一款为 deepseek harness开发的任务提醒插件，能够在 DSH 完成任务、需要批准 或 需要回答 时自动调用系统通知发出提醒

plugins.name: dsh-notification-sound
plugins.description: 在弹出选项卡提问、请求工具权限、一轮对话结束时播放提示音；支持自定义音频。
plugins.zh: 在弹出选项卡提问、请求工具权限、一轮对话结束时播放提示音；支持自定义音频。

plugins.name: dsh-completion-playground
plugins.description: To play with DeepSeek's Completion API and check logprobs.
plugins.zh: 试用 DeepSeek 补全 API 并查看 logprobs。

plugins.name: dsh-codetime
plugins.description: CodeTime for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专用 CodeTime

plugins.name: dsh-za-warudo
plugins.description: JoJo-inspired time-stop transition for the DeepSeek Harness light/dark appearance switch
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浅色/深色主题切换的 JoJo 风格时间停止过渡动画。

plugins.name: dsh-mumuemulator-use
plugins.description: DSH plugin that drives the local MuMu Player 12 emulator
plugins.zh: DSH 插件，驱动本地 MuMu Player 12 模拟器

plugins.name: clinkai-dsh-web-search-fallback
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: SearXNG-first web search with automatic fallback to the built-in DeepSeek search
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：优先使用 SearXNG 进行网页搜索，并自动降级至内置 DeepSeek 搜索

plugins.name: dsh-cli-mode
plugins.description: Command-line mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a composer line starting with ！ or ! runs as a real command in the session workspace instead of being sent to the model.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的命令行模式：以 ！或 ! 开头的 Composer 行将作为真实命令在会话工作区执行，而非发送至模型。

plugins.name: dsh-t3-new-session-screen
plugins.description: T3 Code's New Session screen for DeepSeek Harness: the "What should we build in <project>?" headline with an inline project dropdown, a reasoning-effort picker, and a git branch picker.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的新会话界面：带有内嵌项目下拉菜单、推理力度选择器和 git 分支选择器的「我们要在 <project> 中构建什么？」标题

plugins.name: dsh-standalone-settings
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的设置入口从账号按钮的二级菜单里独立出来：在侧边栏底部 账号按钮的右端固定一个独立的设置按钮。
plugins.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的设置入口从账号按钮的二级菜单里独立出来：在侧边栏底部 账号按钮的右端固定一个独立的设置按钮。

plugins.name: galvanize-dsh
plugins.description: Triggers inside your DSH agent: wake a fresh DeepSeek Harness session when files, mail, webhooks, or git events happen. Native Cordis bundle, heartbeat-proved install.
plugins.zh: DSH 代理内部触发器：当文件、邮件、Webhook 或 Git 事件发生时唤醒新的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。原生 Cordis 打包，心跳验证安装。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search
plugins.description: dsh-web-search — Multi-provider web search for DeepSeek Harness: routes the native web_search tool through a configurable provider fallback chain (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Firecrawl/Jina/Kagi/SearXNG/DuckDuckGo), replacing the built-in deepseek-official backend, with a settings page for key management and ordering. Approach adapted from OMP.
plugins.zh: dsh-web-search —— DeepSeek Harness 多提供商网页搜索：将原生 web_search 工具路由至可配置的提供商故障转移链（Tavily/Brave/Exa/Firecrawl/Jina/Kagi/SearXNG/DuckDuckGo），替换内置 deepseek-official 后端，并提供用于密钥管理与排序的设置页面。方案借鉴自 OMP。

plugins.name: dsh-quick-reload
plugins.description: A one-click page refresh for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: it reboots the page against the freshly published module graph so a hot-injected client plugin appears immediately, purging the rebuildable caches first.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 一键刷新：重启页面以加载最新发布的模块图，使热注入的客户端插件立即生效，并先清空可重建缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-aionui-layout
plugins.description: AionUi-style two-column right sidebar for the DSH Web GUI, seeded on top of dsh-better-sidebar (preview + files/changes), no build step
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 AionUi 风格两列右侧边栏，基于 dsh-better-sidebar 构建（预览 + 文件/变更），无需构建步骤

plugins.name: dsh-houhuiyao
plugins.description: DSH Web「后悔药」插件：最后一条回答上的重新生成 / 编辑提问 / 删除这轮 / 版本翻页器（判据读全量日志，不受客户端 50 条窗口裁剪影响）
plugins.zh: DSH Web「后悔药」插件：最后一条回答上的重新生成 / 编辑提问 / 删除这轮 / 版本翻页器（判据读全量日志，不受客户端 50 条窗口裁剪影响）

plugins.name: dsh-paper-reader
plugins.description: Local paper reading for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar reader panel plus paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan tools, with a from-scratch pure-Node PDF text extractor (no third-party deps, no network).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地论文阅读：侧边栏阅读面板，附带 paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan 工具；内置从零开始的纯 Node.js PDF 文本提取器（无第三方依赖，无网络请求）。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-calendar-clock
plugins.description: Calendar clock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar: a live clock, an analog dial, and a month calendar. (dsh-plugin)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 侧边栏日历时钟插件：实时时钟、模拟表盘和月份日历。（dsh-plugin）

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud-usage
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show Ollama Cloud remaining quota (session/weekly) as a Settings section beside Account & Balance, with an in-page API key editor. · DSH 插件：在设置页“账号与余额”下方显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度，并支持在页面内填写 API Key。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show Ollama Cloud remaining quota (session/weekly) as a Settings section beside Account & Balance, with an in-page API key editor. · DSH 插件：在设置页“账号与余额”下方显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度，并支持在页面内填写 API Key。

plugins.zh: dsh 插件：从磁盘清除会话历史（工作区/全部/单个会话），支持作用域限定与确认后删除

plugins.name: dsh-scratchpad
plugins.description: Scratch pad: one shared floating text surface in the middle of the screen, opened by other plugins through the client service scratchpad.
plugins.zh: 便签：屏幕中央的一个共享浮动文本表面，由其他插件通过客户端服务便签功能打开。

plugins.name: dsh-paperdesk
plugins.description: DSH paper workbench: arXiv search → local library (metadata/PDF/full text) → L1/L2/L3 three-layer reading notes. Host + browser halves in one package, no build step.
plugins.zh: DSH 论文工作台：arXiv 搜索 → 本地图书馆（元数据/PDF/全文）→ L1/L2/L3 三层阅读笔记。Host + Browser 两半合一，无需构建步骤。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-free
plugins.description: 星桥模式：OpenCode 免费模型路线的前缀稳定与载荷控制 Agent 预设（配套 dsh-opencode-xdbridge）
plugins.zh: 星桥模式：OpenCode 免费模型路线的前缀稳定与载荷控制 Agent 预设（配套 dsh-opencode-xdbridge）

plugins.name: dsh-envelope-highlight
plugins.description: Restore syntax highlighting of read/write tool envelopes inside run_code (PTC / Code Mode) result cards
plugins.zh: 恢复 run_code (PTC / 代码模式) 结果卡片中 read/write 工具信封的语法高亮

plugins.name: dsh-token-rush
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 悬浮仪表：实时 token 消耗 / 估算金额 / 账户余额，高峰时段自动变橙红色。A floating token / cost / balance HUD that turns orange-red during DeepSeek rush hours.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 悬浮仪表：实时 token 消耗 / 估算金额 / 账户余额，高峰时段自动变橙红色。A floating token / cost / balance HUD that turns orange-red during DeepSeek rush hours.

plugins.name: DSHdesktop-restart-bottom
plugins.description: 给桌面DSH写的重启插件
plugins.zh: 给桌面DSH写的重启插件

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-topbar
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turns the sidebar into a compact top bar on mobile screens to save space
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在移动屏幕上将侧边栏转换为紧凑的顶部栏以节省空间。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-manager
plugins.description: Security-bounded Agent Skill management and GitHub marketplace plugin for DeepSeek Harness and DSH Desktop
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop 的安全受限智能体技能管理与 GitHub 市场插件

plugins.name: dsh-session-notice
plugins.description: DSH 会话 Bark 通知插件：会话头部按钮切换「会通知」状态（持久化），轮次停止时经 Bark 推送到手机；设置页配 server/key 并提供 ping→push→register 三步连通测试
plugins.zh: DSH 会话 Bark 通知插件：会话头部按钮切换「会通知」状态（持久化），轮次停止时经 Bark 推送到手机；设置页配 server/key 并提供 ping→push→register 三步连通测试

plugins.name: dsh-send-debounce

plugins.zh: 把聊天框里连发的几条短消息合并成一轮后再唤醒模型（DSH 插件）

plugins.zh: DSH plugin: connect to Futu (富途) MCP via OAuth 2.1 with deferred authorization; tokens stored securely outside the workspace (~/.dsh, 0600)

plugins.name: @wenqi_bian/dsh-web-search-anysearch

plugins.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的 WebSearchProvider（适用于 DeepSeek Harness dsh）：注册 AnySearch 的 /v1/search 接口，从插件页面配置中显式切换官方 DeepSeek 搜索端点与 AnySearch；兼容 dsh v0.1.5-alpha.1 及以上版本。

plugins.name: dsh-billing
plugins.description: DSH plugin: prices tokens with the official model price table, shows the running cost beside the composer context meter, and blocks a turn once spend passes the ceiling you set.
plugins.zh: DSH插件：依据官方模型价格表计算令牌成本，在编辑器上下文度量旁显示实时费用，并在消费超过你设定的上限时阻止下一轮生成。

plugins.name: dsh-session-delete
plugins.description: DSH 会话删除插件：会话行「…」菜单里的浅红色删除项 + 二次确认弹窗，确认后连同全部子会话移入可恢复的回收站（DSH 官方只支持归档）
plugins.zh: DSH 会话删除插件：会话行「…」菜单里的浅红色删除项 + 二次确认弹窗，确认后连同全部子会话移入可恢复的回收站（DSH 官方只支持归档）

plugins.name: dsh-session-eraser

plugins.zh: 从 DSH 侧边栏删除会话。DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-pomodoro
plugins.description: Pomodoro focus clock plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: ambient timer under the composer, daily rounds, local preferences
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的番茄钟专注时钟插件：作曲家下方的环境计时器、每日轮次、本地偏好设置

plugins.name: dsh-jp-translate
plugins.description: 「日语翻译」模式

plugins.zh: 将软换行视为硬换行

plugins.description: Queue Consolidation for DeepSeek Harness: merge queued follow-up messages into one consolidated formal prompt for the next turn instead of piecemeal one-message-per-turn rework.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 队列整合：将待处理的后续消息合并为一个整合的形式提示，用于下一轮交互，避免逐条消息碎片化处理。

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的预写复用防火墙：在 agent 编写新的 helper/service 之前，通过 Auto_code_audit 能力通道（确定性检索，无需 LLM）展示已覆盖该意图的现有实现。

Adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only, MIT.
plugins.zh: 将桌面上已有的浏览器 PWA 快捷方式转变为真正的启动器：双击静默启动 dsh web 并打开应用窗口，保留原图标。为 Web UI 添加重启和 dsh 自更新（含回滚）控制。仅支持 Windows，MIT 协议。

plugins.name: dsh-extras
plugins.description: Out-of-tree plugin suite for deepseek-harness (dsh): markdown tooling, relates tables, review-evals dispatch.
plugins.zh: deepseek-harness (dsh) 的外部插件套件：markdown 工具、关系表、review-evals 分发

plugins.name: dsh-skills-input
plugins.description: DSH Skill selector and skill browser for browsing user-invocable skills and inserting slash commands into the composer.
plugins.zh: DSH 技能选择器与技能浏览器：浏览用户可调用的技能，并将斜杠命令插入 composer。

plugins.name: dsh-dd-forge
plugins.description: Due-diligence document review for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic engine (documents → rule packs → risk report), evidence chain, docx/xlsx reports
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 尽职调查文档审查：确定性引擎（文档 → 规则包 → 风险报告）、证据链、docx/xlsx 报告

plugins.name: dsh-update-notifier
plugins.description: DSH 启动时检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh 可更新版本（npm + GitHub Tags 交叉验证）
plugins.zh: DSH 启动时检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh 可更新版本（npm + GitHub Tags 交叉验证）

plugins.name: dsh-live2d-pet
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Live2D 桌宠：页面内插件 + 系统全局悬浮外壳，状态与 harness 实时绑定
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Live2D 桌宠：页面内插件 + 系统全局悬浮外壳，状态与 harness 实时绑定

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a system toast when a tool needs authorization, a question or plan review is waiting, or a turn finishes.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的桌面通知：工具需要授权、等待问题或计划审查，以及回合结束时，均会触发系统 Toast 提示。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-tailscale
plugins.description: Tailscale identity and capability authorization adapter for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tailscale 身份与能力授权适配器

plugins.name: dsh-system-monitor
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮状态条：一行纯文字显示 CPU、内存、多 GPU 的温度与占用率，以及实时网速。零运行时依赖，数据仅在本机回环地址读取。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮状态条：一行纯文字显示 CPU、内存、多 GPU 的温度与占用率，以及实时网速。零运行时依赖，数据仅在本机回环地址读取。

plugins.name: dsh-rtl-chat-box
plugins.description: Adds an RTL chat box direction control to the dsh web GUI.
plugins.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 添加 RTL（从右到左）聊天框方向控制。

plugins.name: dsh-live-teams
plugins.description: A team of long-lived DSH Sessions: durable tasks, declared paths, review with evidence, and a Git-bound submission flow
plugins.zh: 一群长期运行的 DSH Session：持久任务、声明式路径、带证据的审查，以及与 Git 绑定的提交流程

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-layout
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 移动端体验套件：手机端阅读布局 + 极光玻璃换肤（文字对比度自动适配）+ 文件浏览器页签 + abort 自愈。零依赖，一个插件让 dsh web 在手机上好看好用。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-annotations
plugins.description: Codex-style DSH right-sidebar browser preview, element annotations, context notes, and debugging tools.
plugins.zh: Codex 风格的 DSH 右侧边栏浏览器预览、元素标注、上下文注释及调试工具。

plugins.name: dsh-model-caps
plugins.description: Fill blank context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers. | 给自定义供应商补上空白的上下文、输出上限、思考等级与线协议 compat。
plugins.zh: Fill blank context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers. | 给自定义供应商补上空白的上下文、输出上限、思考等级与线协议 compat。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-vajraclaw
plugins.description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
plugins.zh: DSH 本地工具调用故障安全：在执行前拦截高风险 shell 模式和凭证文件读取，附带按会话哈希链接的 JSONL 审计日志，并提供可选的外部 Gateway 用于集中策略管理。

plugins.name: dsh-shutdown
plugins.description: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程
plugins.zh: ❎Provide a shutdown button to quickly close tabs and dsh in the deepseek harness web interface 在deepseek harness网页界面中提供一个关闭按钮快捷关闭标签页和dsh进程

plugins.name: trading-agent
plugins.description: trading agent for dsh
plugins.zh: dsh 的交易代理

plugins.name: dsh-typesafe-ask
plugins.description: Ask TypeSafe (Jev) for structured decisions from inside DeepSeek Harness: typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out.
plugins.zh: 向 TypeSafe (Jev) 提问：在 DeepSeek Harness 内获取结构化决策，输入类型化问题，输出校准后的概率。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-notes
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能速查：用中文一句话说明每个技能是干什么的，点一行把 /技能名 插进输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-offpeak-inbox
plugins.description: Off-peak inbox for DeepSeek Harness: capture thoughts and todos whenever they occur, and the host launches each one as a real session only while the DeepSeek API bills at its off-peak rate.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 低谷时段收件箱：随时记录想法与待办事项，主机仅在 DeepSeek API 按低谷费率计费时启动真实会话处理这些内容。

plugins.name: dsh-tools
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包：自选组件一键安装（远程执行/执行前自动审核/GitHub/联网研究/本地git发布/沙箱逃生/Bug知识库/Blender/上下文压缩/自愈启动器）。组件独立、无个人信息、凭据安装时输入。

plugins.name: dsh-global-rules
plugins.description: Global AGENTS-style rules as many independent markdown files, with a settings GUI — fills the gap left by DeepSeek Harness's single hard-coded global AGENTS.md.
plugins.zh: 全局 AGENTS 风格规则，以多个独立 markdown 文件形式存在，配有设置 GUI——弥补 DeepSeek Harness 仅支持单个硬编码全局 AGENTS.md 的不足。

plugins.name: dsh-qianyuan
plugins.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server — shared pitfall/result records and capability lookup for agents.
plugins.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 QianYuan MCP 服务器——共享陷阱/结果记录及代理的能力查找。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-path-completion
plugins.description: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）
plugins.zh: deepseek harness path completion（deepseek harness @文件名自动补齐和发现）

plugins.name: dsh-force-motion
plugins.description: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效
plugins.zh: Keep DeepSeek Harness UI animations running despite prefers-reduced-motion / 强制开启 dsh 界面动效

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for OpenCode Go (zen-go route)
plugins.zh: OpenCode Go (zen-go 路由) 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM 提供商插件

plugins.name: dsh-output-style
plugins.description: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: 会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令 + Web 选择器，改变模型如何呈现答案（default/adhd-friendly/eli5/bluf）。Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: dsh-vision-assist
plugins.description: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容
plugins.zh: dsh视觉助手，辅助没有多模态的主模型识别图片内容

plugins.name: dsh-model-latency-test
plugins.description: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.
plugins.zh: DSH plugin: adds a 模型测试 (Model Test) settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model. Works in the DSH Web GUI and DSH Desktop.

plugins.name: dsh-top-drag
plugins.description: DSH Desktop (Windows): keeps the top of the window draggable and clickable at the same time.
plugins.zh: DSH Desktop (Windows)：保持窗口顶部同时可拖拽和点击。

plugins.name: dsh-md-reader
plugins.description: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader
plugins.zh: DSH Markdown 阅读插件：点击会话中的 MD/图片链接，在浏览器右侧以真三栏布局（侧边栏 | 会话区 | 文档）直接阅读 —— 目录 TOC、自动跟随磁盘变更、图片内联预览、复制原文、字号缩放。dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjx-ai/dsh-md-reader

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-hide
plugins.description: Show or hide workspaces in the DSH sidebar from Settings: hidden ones sink to the bottom and their sessions are archived instead of spilling into the ungrouped list. Local-only, reversible, nothing deleted.
plugins.zh: 从设置中显示或隐藏 DSH 侧边栏中的工作区：被隐藏的将沉底，其会话将被归档而非混入未分组列表。仅影响本地配置，可逆，不会删除任何内容。

plugins.name: dsh-vertex-gemini
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Gemini on Google Cloud Vertex AI through Application Default Credentials
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 Application Default Credentials 在 Google Cloud Vertex AI 上使用 Gemini

plugins.name: dsh-greet-plugin
plugins.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a greet tool.
plugins.zh: 一个最小化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于注册问候工具。

plugins.name: dsh-prompt-studio
plugins.description: Prompt & Agent Preset Evolution Studio for DeepSeek Harness: Git-style versioning, diff timeline, golden test bench, and one-click regression evaluation.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness的提示词与智能体预设进化工作室：Git风格版本控制、差异时间线、金标准测试集及一键回归评估。

plugins.name: dsh-antigravity-bridge
plugins.description: Google Antigravity conversations for DeepSeek Harness — list, read and import local Antigravity SQLite sessions as DSH sidebar sessions.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Google Antigravity 对话集成——列出、读取并导入本地 Antigravity SQLite 会话为 DSH 侧边栏会话。

plugins.name: dsh-request-error-dump
plugins.description: DSH 插件：模型请求报错时，把完整请求体 raw JSON 与上游错误响应 raw JSON 一起落盘 | DSH plugin: dump the exact raw request body and the raw upstream error response when a model request fails
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：模型请求报错时，把完整请求体 raw JSON 与上游错误响应 raw JSON 一起落盘 | DSH plugin: dump the exact raw request body and the raw upstream error response when a model request fails

plugins.name: dsh-failover-continue
plugins.description: Unified auto-continue + model failover plugin for DeepSeek Harness (RU/EN settings card)
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一自动续写 + 模型降级插件（含俄/英文设置卡片）。

plugins.name: dsh-tier-router
plugins.description: Automatic tier-based model routing for DeepSeek Harness: a virtual `smart` model classifies each request by difficulty (hard / normal / easy) and by vision need, then delegates it to the models you already configured. 三级难度 + 视觉自动路由，虚拟 smart 模型零配置接入。
plugins.zh: Automatic tier-based model routing for DeepSeek Harness: a virtual `smart` model classifies each request by difficulty (hard / normal / easy) and by vision need, then delegates it to the models you already configured. 三级难度 + 视觉自动路由，虚拟 smart 模型零配置接入。

plugins.name: dsh-work-done-bell

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：当 DeepSeek Harness 会话真正结束时播放 Windows 系统提示音

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-scanner
plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页扫描并管理本地 MCP 服务器与工具
plugins.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页扫描并管理本地 MCP 服务器与工具

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 社区波斯语语言包及 RTL 支持，含生命周期和浏览器测试

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-ponytail
plugins.description: ponytail (lazy senior dev mode) as a native DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-project rules, skills and a /ponytail level command.
plugins.zh: ponytail（懒惰资深开发者模式）作为原生 DeepSeek Harness 插件：支持按项目设置规则、技能及 /ponytail 级别命令。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-bot

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将 QQ 官方 Bot API 桥接至 dsh 智能体（无需第三方机器人框架）。

plugins.name: dsh-netease-music
plugins.description: 网易云音乐 DSH 插件：单曲/MV/歌词/笔记/歌手/图片抓取，歌单管理，以及 AI 私人电台策展。零 npm 依赖。
plugins.zh: 网易云音乐 DSH 插件：单曲/MV/歌词/笔记/歌手/图片抓取，歌单管理，以及 AI 私人电台策展。零 npm 依赖。

plugins.zh: DSH Browser Client — LLM 驱动的浏览器浮窗工作流工具（面向非研发人员的网页自动化）

plugins.name: dsh-llm-trace
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls, shows the request body as a collapsible size-annotated JSON tree in a Conversation View tab and on a loopback viewer page, and assembles SSE responses
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，捕获模型供应商调用的原始 HTTP 请求和响应体，在对话视图选项卡中以可折叠的尺寸标注 JSON 树显示请求体，并在环回查看器页面上展示，同时组装 SSE 响应

plugins.name: dsh-native-provider
plugins.description: Use DeepSeek Harness providers in Libre WebUI over a private local connection.
plugins.zh: 通过私有本地连接，在 Libre WebUI 中使用 DeepSeek Harness 提供商。

plugins.description: Webhook notifications for DeepSeek Harness sessions — POST on approval requests and turn ends (ntfy / Bark / generic JSON). By the author of Perch.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness会话的Webhook通知——审批请求和轮次结束时发送POST（ntfy / Bark / 通用JSON）。由Perch作者创作。

plugins.zh: 两台机器上 DSH 代理之间的注入式消息通道：消息落地到日志，并在下一个代理步骤中被注入为上下文。

plugins.zh: 将 Vaydeer 9 键键盘变为 DSH Codex Micro：键盘发送唯一组合，插件将其映射到 DSH 操作

plugins.name: dsh-whale-emote

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在聊天记录中自动将本地音视频/图片路径渲染为可播放的预览组件。When an assistant message or tool result contains a local media path, the path is replaced inline with a playable

plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: push a ServerChan3 (Server酱) notification whenever an agent turn finishes an answer — codex Stop-hook parity

plugins.name: dsh-azure-maid-skin
plugins.description: 蓝瓷女仆 · Azure Maid —— DSH Web GUI 主题皮肤。配色取自社区挂件 DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 的蓝发女仆形象：深蓝发色做品牌与交互、蕾丝冷白做正文与画布、发间青宝石做链接与强调。覆盖 90 个语义 token，亮暗各一套，支持亮色 / 暗色 / 跟随系统三种偏好切换。零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-model-extended

plugins.name: dsh-browser-vision
plugins.description: Browser tool for DeepSeek Harness that can SEE the page: browser-use over CDP driven by deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp. Reads canvas text, text inside images and rendered charts, returns schema-validated JSON, and reports per-run cost.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器工具，具备视觉能力：基于 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 通过 CDP 驱动 browser-use。可读取画布文字、图片内文字和渲染图表，返回经 Schema 校验的 JSON，并报告每次运行成本。

plugins.name: dsh-budget-guard
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: LLM cost metering with budget enforcement (deny/warn) and peak-valley pricing. 成本计量+超预算硬拦截，支持 DeepSeek 峰谷定价。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: LLM cost metering with budget enforcement (deny/warn) and peak-valley pricing. 成本计量+超预算硬拦截，支持 DeepSeek 峰谷定价。

plugins.name: dsh-pilot
plugins.description: Hands for your DeepSeek Harness agent — autonomous browser operation with a native permission model. Accessibility-ref page snapshots let a text-only model navigate, act, and test without vision or CSS-selector guessing.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能体的浏览器操作工具——原生权限模型的自主浏览器操作。基于无障碍参考页的截图快照，让纯文本模型无需视觉或 CSS 选择器猜测即可导航、操作和测试。

plugins.name: dsh-local-plugin-switch
plugins.description: DSH 插件：设置页「本地插件开关」区块 —— 列出本地已安装插件并实时/持久开关
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：设置页「本地插件开关」区块 —— 列出本地已安装插件并实时/持久开关

plugins.name: dsh-protect-eyes-skin
plugins.description: DSH-protect-eyes-skin - an eye-friendly green theme for DeepSeek Harness (full --dsw-* design-token reskin, light + dark).
plugins.zh: DSH-protect-eyes-skin - DeepSeek Harness 护眼绿色主题（完整 --dsw-* 设计令牌重绘，支持亮色与暗色模式）。

plugins.name: dsh-preset-zombie-guard
plugins.description: Preset-zombie guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auto-archive blank zombie sessions, warn on non-blank, pre-deletion dependency audit (preset_guard_check_remove).
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 预设僵尸守护插件：自动归档空白僵尸会话，非空白会话发出警告，并在删除前执行依赖审计（preset_guard_check_remove）。

plugins.name: dsh-chicken-pet
plugins.description: 🐔 A pixel chicken desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — naps, paces, pecks and spins a basketball on its own, and reacts to your agent's work. Original procedurally-generated pixel art, no third-party assets.
plugins.zh: 🐔 DeepSeek Harness 桌面像素小鸡宠物：自主打盹、踱步、啄食、转篮球，并能响应你的 AI 代理工作。原创程序生成像素艺术，无第三方素材。

plugins.name: dsh-followup-todo
plugins.description: Cross-session follow-up todo list for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话跟进待办事项列表

plugins.name: dsh-memory
plugins.description: DSH 跨会话语义记忆插件：智谱 embedding-3 + SQLite，提供 memory_add / memory_search 语义召回；配置可选、绝不因缺 key/缺库/缺服务而崩。
plugins.zh: DSH 跨会话语义记忆插件：智谱 embedding-3 + SQLite，提供 memory_add / memory_search 语义召回；配置可选、绝不因缺 key/缺库/缺服务而崩。

plugins.name: dsh-mac-cua
plugins.description: Computer Use for macOS in DeepSeek Harness: control desktop apps through the Accessibility API, driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中的 macOS Computer Use：通过 Accessibility API 控制桌面应用，由持久化的 JavaScript REPL 驱动。

plugins.name: @achasoft/dsh-advanced-sidebar
plugins.description: Advanced sidebar operations for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: git changes, multi-session terminals, a file browser, a dev-server preview, background tasks, Open in, Archive and Delete, in a resizable dock beside the conversation
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web Client 的高级侧边栏操作：git 变更、多会话终端、文件浏览器、开发服务器预览、后台任务、打开方式、归档和删除，集成在对话旁边的可调整大小停靠栏中。

plugins.name: @achasoft/dsh-worktree
plugins.description: Git worktrees and branches for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: a branch and worktree row above the composer that shows where the session is checked out, branch and worktree switching, and worktrees adopted as harness workspaces
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的 Git worktrees 与分支：编辑器上方显示当前签出的分支与 worktree 行，支持切换分支和 worktree，并将 worktrees 采纳为 harness 工作空间

plugins.name: @achasoft/dsh-memory
plugins.description: Persistent, searchable, per-project memory for the DeepSeek Harness: decisions, rules, and sprint context in a queryable DuckDB file, rules enforced on every model request, with a full management UI in the Web Client
plugins.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、可搜索的按项目记忆：将决策、规则和 Sprint 上下文存储在可查询的 DuckDB 文件中，每条模型请求都会强制执行规则，并通过 Web Client 提供完整的管理界面。

plugins.name: @achasoft/dsh-usage-info
plugins.description: Context occupancy and account balance for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: a session-header readout, a balance capability seam, and a DeepSeek provider
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web Client 的上下文占用与账户余额显示：会话头读数、余额能力接缝以及 DeepSeek 提供商。

plugins.name: @achasoft/dsh-add-assets
plugins.description: Composer add-assets plate for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: an options menu on the composer's + button (files, folders, slash commands) and a Claude Code-style draft attachment preview
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web Client 的 Composer 添加资产面板：Composer 的 + 按钮上的选项菜单（文件、文件夹、斜杠命令）以及 Claude Code 风格的草稿附件预览

plugins.zh: dsh会话预算守卫

plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 素材库插件：会话内容一键保存 + 自动采集，按时间/类型/会话/项目四轴归纳，本地 Markdown 存储，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-git-nexus
plugins.description: Unified Git + GitHub + workflow + files panel for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web profile. Community plugin tagged dsh-plugin.
plugins.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 配置文件的统一 Git + GitHub + 工作流 + 文件面板。社区插件，标签为 dsh-plugin。

plugins.name: dsh-bitwarden
plugins.description: Bitwarden/Vaultwarden credentials in every DSH session: vault tools + proactive prompt guidance + a settings card for the master password.
plugins.zh: 每个 DSH 会话中的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 凭据：保险库工具 + 主动提示引导 + 主密码设置卡片。

plugins.name: nightshift
plugins.description: Run an agent unattended for hours and get a morning brief that is an audit, not a summary. Signs a manifest before the work, prices every step at the execution boundary, rolls back a failed verification, and reports what the gate refused. DSH plugin + skill, zero dependencies.
plugins.zh: 长时间无人值守运行智能体，获取一份审查报告而非摘要的晨间简报。工作前签署清单，在执行边界对每一步定价，回滚失败的验证，并报告被门控拒绝的内容。DSH 插件 + 技能，零依赖。

plugins.name: relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-author
plugins.description: DSH Skill provider for discovering and safely creating Relay Monitor Bundles.
plugins.zh: DSH Skill 提供者：用于发现和安全创建 Relay Monitor 捆绑包。

plugins.name: relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-process
plugins.description: Read-only process identity capability for Agent-authored Relay Monitor Bundles.
plugins.zh: Agent 撰写的 Relay Monitor 插件包的只读进程身份能力。

plugins.name: relay-dsh-plugin-monitor-time
plugins.description: Time deadline Monitor Bundle extension for Relay on DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上 Relay 的时间截止监控捆绑扩展包。

plugins.name: dsh-pin-session
plugins.description: DSH「置顶对话」插件：会话头部与会话行内一键 📌，把重要对话钉在侧栏分组顶部。宿主端只存事实（原子写 JSON + 信任栅栏内的 HTTP 接口 + 配套 CLI），排序由客户端在 DOM 层完成——因为侧栏顺序由浏览器本地排序表优先决定，宿主端挪顺序在界面上无效。零运行时依赖、能力探测与熔断，面向跨版本升级设计。
plugins.zh: DSH「置顶对话」插件：会话头部与会话行内一键 📌，把重要对话钉在侧栏分组顶部。宿主端只存事实（原子写 JSON + 信任栅栏内的 HTTP 接口 + 配套 CLI），排序由客户端在 DOM 层完成——因为侧栏顺序由浏览器本地排序表优先决定，宿主端挪顺序在界面上无效。零运行时依赖、能力探测与熔断，面向跨版本升级设计。

plugins.name: dsh-thread-tools
plugins.description: Cross-session tools for DeepSeek Harness: list the deployment's other sessions and deliver a message to a live one
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话工具：列出部署的其他会话并向活跃会话发送消息

plugins.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web 远程受信访问插件：设置面板可视化配置受信域名，联动 /api 放行与页面受信判定，修复远程 Models/设置页 settings are unavailable in this browser

plugins.name: dsh-capture-window
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 旁路捕获插件：随手丢想法进独立的安静新会话，不打断主线上下文。
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness 旁路捕获插件：随手丢想法进独立的安静新会话，不打断主线上下文。

plugins.description: 一块可以配置余额、监测模型监控状态、以及配置模型多模态设置的插件
plugins.zh: 一块可以配置余额、监测模型监控状态、以及配置模型多模态设置的插件

plugins.name: dsh-tmux-cc
plugins.description: A persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DeepSeek Harness Web.
plugins.zh: DSH Web 的持久 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱。

plugins.name: dsh-insight-dock
plugins.description: Insight dock for the DSH Web GUI: lets an agent park a short, strictly-bounded side observation while it works, shows it above the composer, and lets the user ask to hear it later — with a context anchor that survives context compaction.
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 洞察停靠栏：让智能体在工作时停靠一条严格有界的简短侧边观察，显示在编辑器上方，并允许用户稍后听取——附带在上下文压缩后仍能保留的上下文锚点。

plugins.name: dsh-restart
plugins.description: DSH plugin: safe restart execution for DeepSeek Harness — request validation, checkpoint gating, restart locking, graceful shutdown, crash-loop breaking and an external supervisor. It never decides when to restart.
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全重启执行——请求验证、检查点门控、重启锁、优雅关机、崩溃循环中断及外部监督。它永不自主决定重启时机。

plugins.name: dsh-health-scheduler
plugins.description: DSH plugin: device/runtime health monitoring, restart-pressure scoring, maintenance scheduling and action decisions for DeepSeek Harness. It never restarts anything itself.
plugins.zh: DSH插件：DeepSeek Harness的设备/运行时健康监控、重启压力评分、维护计划及操作决策。它本身不会重启任何内容。

plugins.name: dsh-hidden-paths
plugins.description: Deny an AI agent access to .env files, credential stores, keys and any path you hide — across file tools, shell commands, search selectors and run_code. A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin.
plugins.zh: 从文件工具、Shell 命令、搜索选择器和 run_code 中阻止 AI 代理访问 .env 文件、凭据存储、密钥及任何隐藏路径——一款 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-youcom
plugins.description: You.com search + fetch provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), plus a research-focused agent preset
plugins.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 You.com 搜索 + 获取提供程序插件，附带专注于研究的代理预设

plugins.name: dsh-mcu-lab
plugins.description: DSH 插件：51 单片机开发闭环 —— Keil / 免费 SDCC 编译 + Proteus 仿真 + 确定性判定，含不依赖商业软件的离线判定后端。
plugins.zh: DSH 插件：51 单片机开发闭环 —— Keil / 免费 SDCC 编译 + Proteus 仿真 + 确定性判定，含不依赖商业软件的离线判定后端。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：在本轮统计与回合尾部显示花费的人民币金额，只读既有槽位与用量事件，不改宿主。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：流式复读熔断 —— 在流式输出里边收边判，命中退化复读就地掐断并消毒正文，避免白烧 token。

plugins.zh: DSH 插件：跨会话内容检索 —— 按关键词搜历史会话正文，带本地索引与预热，零第三方依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-x-opencode-session
